They create a dark, dense fog high in the air that descends on the target, engulfing them and creating a powerful barrier that seals them off from all outside forces, even death. The Sound Four use this technique to counter the effects of the Mind Awakening Pill, which kills those who ingest it in order to advance their cursed seal to its second level. The Dark Sealing Method can be used to contain the fog within a confined space, such as a coffin.

name: Formation Ino–Shika–Chō
description: Formation Ino–Shika–Chō are formations used by the members of the Yamanaka, Nara, and Akimichi clan members/Team 10 designed as a result of their long history of working together. These formations are designed to use each member's abilities in the best way possible that complements the others'. This formation is usually done with flawless accuracy, which comes after working together — another testament of how close-knit the three clans are. This formation is not limited to any one specific technique of any of the clans but the respective clan members can use several of their respective clan's techniques in tandem to create different versions of this formation. Formation #1: Mind Body Switch Technique + Shadow Imitation Technique + Multi-Size Technique Formation #2: Mind Body Disturbance Technique + Shadow–Neck Binding Technique + Partial Multi-Size Technique Formation #3: Mind Disturbance Dance Performance Technique + Black Spider Lily + Super Multi-Size Technique Formation #4: Mind Clone Switch Technique + Shadow Sewing Technique + Butterfly Bullet Bombing Formation E: Human Bullet Yo-Yo

name: Four Violet Flames Formation
description: A team of four stands in a square formation and then performs this technique, erecting a solid barrier between them. The barrier is made of purple flames, which will instantly engulf those who come into contact with it, thus preventing anyone from entering or leaving the area. Because the barrier relies on all four users to maintain, attacking any one of them can bring down the barrier. To prevent this from happening, members of the Sound Four extend secondary barriers around themselves, making breaking out even more difficult. When used by members of the First Division, the users position themselves outside the barrier rather than inside, at least ensuring their captive cannot harm them.

name: Four Symbols Seal
description: This technique requires a great deal of talent to perform. The user applies the seal's formula to an object or a human's body, sealing a large enemy or an evil spirit within them. If two Four Symbols Seal are used, a stronger seal is created; this is called the Eight Trigrams Sealing Style. If the Four Symbols Seals do not completely overlap with each other, this allows the enemy/spirit's chakra to merge with whoever they've been sealed into. This is how the Nine-Tails was sealed into the body of Naruto Uzumaki. The Four Symbols Seal is based on the fūinjutsu of Uzushiogakure's Uzumaki clan, the clan laying the foundation for the technique. According to Killer B, it is stronger than the Iron Armour Seal used to seal the Eight-Tails within him. The Four Symbols Seal is also left on the stomachs of those who perform the Dead Demon Consuming Seal.

name: Formation of Ten Thousand Snakes
description: With this technique, a countless number of summoned snakes crawl out of Orochimaru's mouth and hunt down the enemy. With such overwhelming numbers, a true "wall of snakes" is formed, making defence and evasion meaningless. The enemy can do nothing but become buried by the snakes. The snakes can bite the enemy with their poison fangs and open their mouths to extend Kusanagi-like blades, making them even more deadly. Furthermore, when the inexhaustibly crawling snakes gather together, they become a defensive wall, and can block any kind of attack.

name: Flying Swallow Barrage
description: Asuma uses his Flying Swallow and start a sequence of slashes finishing with a falling slash.

name: Flower Shuriken: Falling Blossoms and Scattering Leaves
description: This technique will make flowers hover in the air before hardening and spinning at high speeds. The flowers will then be launched at the target. Their hardened state will allow them to cut targets as effectively as metal shuriken.

name: Flower Ninja Art: Many Blooming Flowers
description: After surrounding the opponent with flowers, the user will ignite the flowers. These flames will then shoot towards and explode on the target.

name: Flower Ninja Art: Mirror Flower Water
description: The user casts an illusion which surrounds the target in flower petals and darkens the surroundings around them.

name: Flower Ninja Art: Many Releasing Flowers
description: This technique turns flowers into bombs that can be detonated like explosive tags.

name: Floating Bugs
description: Shino fires a cloud like projectile of destruction bugs at the opponent.

name: Four-Corner Sealing Barrier
description: This technique was designed by Tsunade for the purpose of sealing a tailed beast. The technique is performed with four separate scrolls and a sample of blood similar to a Summoning Technique. Shizune mentioned that good chakra control and concentration are needed to perform the sealing technique. To use this technique, a scroll is needed to seal the numerous amounts of chakra. This technique was supposed to seal the Three-Tails in its own dimension, permanently. While sealing the users are vulnerable to enemy attacks. This technique has three stages: "Search": the barrier is erected to locate the target. "Bind": the barrier is then stretched out above the target. "Lock": the barrier is lowered and the sealing begins.

name: Forbidden Technique: Impure World Seal Destruction
description: Orochimaru summons a coffin like the one used in the Summoning: Impure World Reincarnation technique. Ghostly hands come out of the coffin, extending through the body of the opponent, damaging them, until a larger hand grasps them, crushes them, and pulls them into the ethereal dark void within the coffin. The lid closes on the coffin and begins to sink into the darkness surrounding it. Orochimaru laughs sinisterly, watching as it vanishes.

name: Flower Ninja Art
description: is a subset of ninjutsu and genjutsu involving secret flower-oriented techniques used by a clan in the Land of Vegetables. The two known users of flower ninja art are Kikunojō and Yurinojō.

name: Flying Swallow: Cross Cut
description: Asuma punches the opponent a few times and finishes them with two final slashes.

name: Flying Nail Mist Soaring
description: The user exhales a flying stream composed of hundreds of very small nails from their mouth.

name: Flying Thunder God: Guiding Thunder
description: The Flying Thunder God: Guiding Thunder is a technique. This barrier technique incorporates the use of the Flying Thunder God formula to erect a barrier space capable of warping away anything that comes into contact with it. The subject of the technique is then directed to another location marked by the user’s formula. The barrier has proven to be powerful enough to warp away techniques as destructive as a Tailed Beast Ball.

name: Forbidden Summoning Technique: Fire Rats Cometh
description: Dōshin summons rats, immersed by fire, to burn any objects such as the forest or attack the opponents.

name: Forbidden Technique: Mud Golem
description: Dōshin can make duplicates of his opponents using his Earth Release. This technique, however, costs a significant amount of chakra and makes the user tired from using it.

name: Forbidden Technique: Gedō Seal
description: A kinjutsu developed by Orochimaru during the Second Shinobi World War. It combines the two powers of seal and confusion into one technique, giving them the names and when using them separately. Both techniques possess insidious effects on the target. The Gedō Seal: Seal is a juinjutsu that can seal a target's abilities, including the kekkei genkai, causing pain to the target, even when not using their ability. The Gedō Seal: Confusion causes blinding pain in the victim's head, which turns their body into a tool of the technique's caster. When used to fight another, they will feel no pain the victim's opponent has given them, and won't listen to what anyone says. This part of the technique can be cured without the use of a release command, if they defeat their inner self that is in their head. Hiruzen Sarutobi was troubled by the cruel effects of the Outer Path Seal, so he created a cure called the which can heal the effects of this technique from the target. Hiruzen Sarutobi then hid the scrolls containing the Outer Path Seal under the Memorial Stone, which he said is to be protected by heroes.

name: Flight of the Obliterating Water
description: Haku gathers a larger amount of water from the air and surrounding environment into more than a thousand needles. He then directs the needles to a specific opponent, and leaps back to avoid damage to himself.

name: Forbidden Technique: Dead Soul Technique
description: Kabuto summons two corpses in his image to attack his opponent with their chakra scalpel forward and backward and then he slashes his opponent with his chakra scalpel.

name: Four Symbols Puppet Shinobi
description: Akatsuki members are given a special human-shaped seal created by Nagato that takes a physical form known as the Four Symbols Puppet Shinobi, to fight or stall the enemy. The Puppet Shinobi goes to a faraway location to create numerous copies of itself. The only way to break the technique is to stop the Puppet Shinobi source.

name: Flower–Fruit Mountain
description: The Flower-Fruit Mountain is a Lava Release technique utilised by Son Gokū and its jinchuriki Rōshi. While in his transformed state, Rōshi creates a volcano which then explodes violently, sending molten rock flying up in all directions the effects of which resemble a giant flower. The lava produced is said to be able to melt anything in its path.

name: Flying Thunder God: Sequential Steps
description: Minato places his formula mark on the opponent and kicks them in the air where he teleports behind the airborne opponent and hits the opponent with a Rasengan, knocking them down towards the ground, where he then teleports again to the falling opponent to use his charged Rasengan to slam them to the ground, creating an enormous explosion.

name: Flower Dance
description: Kurenai creates a cherry blossom clone that spins around her, creating a barrier of cherry petals striking the opponent multiple times, and lifting them into the air.

name: Flying Attack
description: Ōnoki creates a rock to hit and send the opponent up, then he flies up to attack the opponent and then slams the opponent down.

name: Freight Bundle Bubble
description: Transformed into Saiken, Utakata forms a purple-coloured Tailed Beast Ball, mixed with his Soap Bubble Ninjutsu that he launches at the opponent.

name: Flying Thunder God Slash
description: A technique combining the use of a bladed weapon and space–time ninjutsu. The user teleports to a marked target, with weapon in hand, to instantaneously deliver a swift, devastating slash to his opponent. Because of the speed of the technique's execution, not even an individual wielding the Sharingan — a dōjutsu capable of predicting movement — has enough reaction time to defend themselves against this technique, especially if the user is already physically fast. In the anime, Tobirama used a marked kunai hidden with other thrown kunai, allowing him to attack a target that dodged his projectile attack.

name: Four Red Yang Formation
description: A powerful barrier formation noted to only be usable by those of Kage calibre, whereby four shinobi, standing in a square formation, erect a large barrier that is red in colour. It was stated to be several times stronger than the Four Violet Flames Formation, and is highly malleable and elastic. When assaulted by a Tailed Beast Ball from the Ten-Tails, the barrier simply distorted its shape, forcing the brunt of the attack upwards while it was left completely intact and reformed to its original position. Its users can create openings within the barrier to allow passage. This barrier is apparently very chakra-taxing since at least two of its users are limited in the usage of other techniques, such as clone techniques, while maintaining the barrier at the same time.

name: Flying Thunder God Mutually Instantaneous Revolving Technique
description: The Flying Thunder God Mutually Instantaneous Revolving Technique is a technique which can be utilised when at least two Flying Thunder God Technique users are present. Both persons will mark each other with their respective seals, this grants them the ability to switch their positions at any point in time during a battle. In one instance of use, Minato and Tobirama used this technique to take Obito Uchiha by surprise on the battlefield where Minato — who was originally struck by an attack — switched places with Tobirama to cause the attack to land on their intended target.

name: Flying Claw
description: Yugito lunges at an airborne opponent and delivers a powerful cross slash.

name: Forward Trampling Jump
description: Transformed as Kokuō, Han tramples his opponent with his front legs three times, from his left, right, and centre.

name: Fluttering Heaven
description: Utakata jumps up into the air, delivers a strike with his bubble blower, followed by two empty-handed swipes, and finishes it with a spinning kick which sends his opponent crashing down.

name: Flying Single Foot
description: After manifesting Chōmei's wings, Fū flies high up in the air and descends, landing a kick on her opponent.

name: Four Corner Seal Teleportation
description: The user places a sealing tag on the designated area. If anyone crosses it, whether it be an ally or an enemy, toads are summoned to stop them. This technique is useful to protect an object from falling into enemy hands, and it is said that only Jiraiya and Minato were able to remove it. Those wishing to release the seal must perform the required hand seals and then point at it, which will cause any summoned toad to depart.

name: Flying Thunder God — Second Step
description: The Flying Thunder God — Second Step is a technique developed by Minato from the Flying Thunder God Technique. Minato first throws a Flying Thunder God Kunai, be it a direct attack at his opponent; once the kunai has reached close proximity to the target, or even past them, he would then teleport to the said kunai, immediately attacking his target from their blind-spot. The speed at which this technique is executed along with the unpredicted secondary attack is such that even an individual who possesses the Sharingan is unable to react in time.

name: Flowing Blade
description: Shizune gets in close and uses a spinning sweep kick before she spins back to her original position. She then slashes the opponent with a chakra scalpel.

name: Flowing Wall Sand
description: After hitting his opponent with a barrage of sand, Gaara flows three walls of sand to end it.

name: Four Snakes Intimidating Thrust
description: Kabuto slashes his opponent with a chakra scalpel, and with three strikes from his navel snake. Three giant white snakes emerge from the ground in sequence, each biting his opponent, and in the end, four of those emerge behind Kabuto, raise themselves high, and lunge at his opponent.

name: Forbidden Individual Curse Tag
description: The Forbidden Individual Curse Tag is a juinjutsu utilised by Madara Uchiha. The cursed seal is placed directly on the target's heart and by design, prevents the branded individual from taking their own lives or removing the cursed seal themselves. A direct strike to the heart appears to be able to remove the seal — albeit risking one's life in the process. According to Obito Uchiha, the cursed seal also interfered with him becoming the Ten-Tails' jinchūriki.

name: Flying Revolving Sword
description: The wielder throws Kubikiribōchō at the opponent, dealing damage as it spins towards them. If the Kubikiribōchō gets lodged in something in its path, such as the trunk of a tree, a person can stand on it.

name: Flying Thunder God: Space–Time Hurricane Flash Sequential Steps: Style Zero
description: Minato throws several Flying Thunder God kunai at his opponent, teleports to one of them, and kicks the opponent, sending them flying back. While they are still in the air, he creates a shadow clone which teleports repeatedly to the Flying Thunder God kunai around the opponent, constantly slashing them. Minato then goes into Nine-Tails Chakra Mode, charging a Rasengan. The shadow clone catches the opponent and teleports them directly in front of Minato, who lands his Rasengan, sending the opponent a long way before the Rasengan expands.

name: Flying Thunder Formation Technique
description: This is a cooperation Space–Time Ninjutsu taught to the Hokage Guard Platoon by the Fourth Hokage to better aid in their duties of protecting the seated Hokage. All three members of the team are required to execute the technique. In doing so, they encircle the target performing the seal of confrontation so that their thumbs, middle, and index fingers are touching one another's. This allows them to teleport both themselves, and anything within the confines of the ring, to a marked destination. Since becoming the guards of the Fifth Hokage, they have marked her with the technique's formula so that they can teleport to her side at any time.

name: Four Black Snakes Formation
description: The four users stand in a square formation, erecting a large barrier between them. On command, it incinerates its contents.

name: Flying Thunder God Technique (Boruto)
description: The Flying Thunder God Technique is a space–time ninjutsu created by Boruto Uzumaki, inspired by the technique of the same name. Approximately two decades after the Fourth Shinobi World War, Boruto Uzumaki would take inspiration from his grandfather Minato Namikaze and use his inherent Ōtsutsuki teleportation ability to develop his own imitation of the jutsu. Though it produces nearly identical results it is technically different enough to be considered an entirely separate technique, and has more limitations. Boruto's version harnesses his teleportation ability to translocate to metal objects he previously marked with his chakra, allowing him to freely and instantly move wherever he chooses. The embedded chakra is more difficult for him to sense if they are still behind held onto, and can potentially be sensed by others, unlike the original technique. Metal objects, including weapons, accessories, and utensils, were chosen as the medium due to their chakra conductivity. The translocation is easier and more accurate when used on objects within visual range, however for objects that are far away the process is more difficult, and if they have similar shapes he may be unable to discern which is which. For this reason he prepared a variety of metal objects with distinct shapes to act as unique symbols that he could visualise in order to accurately translocate to his intended coordinates even over great distances. Some of the objects he has marked include Sasuke's sword, his shuriken, his metal jewelry and pins, and several metal symbols carried by Koji's scout toads.

name: Flight Mode
description: This is the mode in which Mecha-Naruto takes a plane-like form, allowing it to fly at high speeds, and its fingers into machine gun-like extensions.

name: Fire Release: Phoenix Sage Fire Technique
description: The user spits a volley of small fireballs into the air; at a glance, it can appear as though there was only one fireball that then burst into many. The many small flames move wildly through the area, potentially mesmerising targets as they're surrounded. The user controls each individual flame with their chakra, allowing them to guide each at the target and, consequently, making this technique difficult to evade. Shuriken can be hidden within the flames, not only making them more deadly upon impact but also, by controlling the flames' movements, giving users a means of controlling the shuriken as well.

name: Fire Sealing Method
description: The user first readies a scroll that they've previously inscribed with a special sealing formula, which has a blank space left in its centre. They then activate this technique, quickly sucking any nearby Fire Release into the blank space and sealing it there, signified by the appearance of the kanji for . Regardless of any special properties that the flames may have, such as those of Amaterasu, they will remain sealed until the user chooses to unseal them. Because this technique is designed for Fire Release, performing it requires expertise in not only using seals but ninjutsu as well.

name: Five Elements Seal
description: Orochimaru gathers "wicked" chakra to his five fingertips, which he forcefully applies over another seal. When this Five Elements Seal, being of an odd number, is applied over the Four Symbols Seal, being of an even number, the Four Symbols Seal is disrupted because of the odd—even imbalance. In Naruto Uzumaki's case, he loses access to the chakra of the Nine-Tails - which the Four Symbols Seal keeps stored in his body - and furthermore makes it difficult for him to use his own. When the Five Elements Seal is initially applied, Naruto is rendered unconscious. When Jiraiya is later shown removing the Five Elements Seal from Naruto, he is able to correctly guess that Orochimaru applied it in the first place, describing its use as "coarse".

name: Five Elements Unseal
description: This technique removes seals that are of similar power to itself. The user gathers chakra to their fingertips and hits the fingers against the seal that is to be removed, causing it to unravel and disappear. If the seal was applied to a person, the thrust of the hand that accompanies this technique will likely be painful. When Jiraiya uses this technique to remove a Five Elements Seal, it appears to be quite easy for him. In truth, this is a very advanced technique that even jōnin would find difficult to perform. In the anime, Kazuma uses the Five Elements Unseal on Sora, thus increasing his access to the Nine-Tails' chakra sealed in his body. In another episode, Orochimaru uses the Five Elements Unseal to break the Iron Armour Seal.

name: Five-Seal Barrier
description: The user connects five tags to each other using their own chakra. One of the tags is applied to a central location that the user wishes to prevent access to, while the other four are applied to surfaces in the surrounding area. So long as at least one of the tags remains in place, a barrier will be created over the central location that prevents it from being opened or in any way physically damaged. Those wishing to remove the barrier are advised to break into two small teams for maximum efficiency: one team focuses on removing the four surrounding tags, while the second team removes the central tag and immediately afterwards storms the stronghold. The Five-Seal Barrier erected over an Akatsuki lair in the Land of Rivers has tags spread across an incredibly wide area, with one tag being 500 meters northeast of the lair's entrance and another being 800 meters southwest of the entrance. This means having a sensor among those intending to breach a Five-Seal Barrier can save a significant amount of time. Because the tags, once located, are simple to remove, the Akatsuki leader pairs his Five-Seal Barrier with a booby trap.

name: Fire Release: Toad Oil Flame Bullet
description: This is a cooperation ninjutsu performed by a toad and a fire user who have achieved mental and physical harmony with each other. The toad (specifically a large toad such as Gamabunta) uses its large lung capacity to spray toad oil from its mouth at a target. The fire user then ignites the oil, increasing the attack's range and power; Jiraiya uses Fire Release: Flame Bullet for this purpose. In the anime, Naruto Uzumaki instead sets flame to the oil with an exploding tag. The resulting cloud of fire is great enough that it forces Manda to shed its skin to escape.

name: Fire Release: Great Flame Rasengan
description: Jiraiya creates a normal Rasengan, then spews fire onto it, causing it to turn black and be surrounded by a ring of flames. He then hits the opponent, causing a blazing maelstrom of fire, reducing the opponent to ashes.

name: Fire Release: Intelligent Hard Work
description: Kakuzu's fire-element mask fires a small fireball that erupts into a giant fire-storm after making contact with a surface, causing widespread destruction to the area. Since the flames travel along the ground, and cover such a wide area this is a difficult technique to evade. When combined with Wind Release: Pressure Damage, this technique is amplified to the point of being able to evaporate a large amount of water in an instant.

name: Fire Release: Mist Blaze Dance Technique
description: The user is able to create and blow a flammable gas from their lungs. Once it comes in contact with fire or spark, the gas ignites into a large fireball. Kagerō used this technique while disguised as Kabuto Yakushi.

name: Flaming Arrow of Amazing Ability
description: The Flaming Arrow of Amazing Ability is a technique used by Nagato through the Asura Path. Using the body modification ability of the Asura Path, the user compresses a high amount of chakra at the slit of its wrist before releasing it, causing its detachable hand to be fired with tremendous force. It has enough destructive power to easily break through thick bedrock. As the hand portion is protected with chakra, it allows it to remain unscathed. When the attack is complete, the hand is drawn back like a magnet by chakra in the wrist, reattaching itself.

name: Fire Release: Running Fire
description: This technique creates a stream of fire that can be manipulated into several forms (so far, rings of fire that run on the ground or a circle of fire flying through the air) before striking the target. It can also be used in combination with Wind Release: Divine Wind to create a tornado of flames, or with Wind Release: Divine Mountain Wind to release a massive inferno, the latter which is made even more powerful when used in an enclosed space created by Earth Release: Earth Corridor.

name: Flashing Bell Beams
description: Shion's bell flashes and sends a ray of flashing pink light towards the enemy. It is powerful enough to cleanly slice through three of Mōryō's Ghost Army soldiers.

name: Fire Release: Uchiha Great Flame Sphere
description: Sasuke and Itachi both perform Fire Release: Great Fireball Technique which when combined form a giant fireball that explodes on the opponent.

name: Fist Slam
description: A covers himself with electricity and slams both his fists on the opponent.

name: Flame Combo
description: Sasori shoots a barrage of fireballs from the flamethrowers on the palms of his puppet body.

name: Fire Whirlwind Vortex Technique
description: First, the user uses Fire Release: Flint Yagura to create a wall of fire in front of the enemy and then uses Wind Release: Whirlwind Fist to blow the flames into the enemy, creating a blazing firestorm that leaves the surrounding area scorched.

name: Flash Cross Sever
description: Asuma delivers multiple punches to the opponent before he slashes the opponent with his chakra blades in a cross-style.

name: Fire Release: Heavenly Prison
description: The Fire Release: Heavenly Prison is an used by Mui's clan. The ones who are subjected to this technique have a formula applied to them, which will prevent them from moulding chakra and from using techniques. It will also drain them of their chakra at a slow but steady rate. Mui uses this technique on the prisoners of the Hōzuki Castle. If the ones who have the seal on them leaves a certain radius from the applier, then it would cause the victims to burst into flames from the inside, burning them to ashes. The user can also ignite the seal at their own free will. However, for people with high amounts of chakra, such as Naruto, they can still mould chakra and use techniques to a certain extent. The techniques used, however, will be severely hampered, and the seal will cause the user in question intense pain, as though their bodies were on fire; if too much chakra is forced out, the formula will set the victim ablaze. It is possible for an individual to undo the Heavenly Prison placed by another, as Benga undid "Tsukiyo's" that was placed by Mujō. Being a fire technique, it cannot work in water, and the victims simply has to submerge themselves in a body of water to use chakra with ease; anyone set aflame by this technique can be saved if water is poured over them. Hozuki Castle was able to mitigate this by having their only body of water being situated down the cliff where there are whirlpools that threaten to drown anyone who tried to jump in. Also, this technique only suppresses normal chakra from within one's body; when enhanced with natural energy gathered externally, one is still able to use chakra. If anyone with the seal applied were able to create a shadow clone, the clone will not bear the seal.

name: Fire Release: Phoenix Sage Flower Nail Crimson
description: The user unleashes a volley of shuriken with one hand, and at the same time, exhales fire-infused chakra onto them in order to increase the weapons' destructive potential by making them capable of inflicting severe burns upon direct contact with either the intended victim, or any other object caught within their trajectories. Due to the chakra-based nature of the flames that surround them, the shuriken will continue to burn after impact, regardless of the flammability of the object that they ultimately collide with.

name: Fission Technique
description: The Fission Technique is a highly advanced ninjutsu which allows Mū to literally split his own body into two identical — yet entirely independent — duplicates of himself. Unlike clone techniques that only appear to be similar, the ability is instead a physical separation and so does not require hand seals to activate, making it faster in comparison as a result. This also means that even if one is incapacitated, the other remains completely unaffected as neither can truly be regarded as the original. Because the duplicates cannot be dispelled like normal clones, they will be unable to reunite if one is sealed. This poses a great risk to Mū as his chakra reserves are also halved in the process. In doing so, he is left unable to use more taxing techniques like his Dust Release kekkei tōta.

name: Fire Release: Prison Flame Mask
description: While in his long-range form, Kakuzu unleashes a torrent of fireballs at his opponent which explode on impact.

name: Fire Release: Wind Release: Blazing Wind Wild Wave
description: While in his long-range form and in mid-air, Kakuzu sends a powerful torrent of wind and fire.

name: Flash Revolving Foot
description: The spiral flash kick is a series of punches and slashes finishing with a spinning kick, sending the opponent flying.

name: Fire Release: Hiding in Fire Technique
description: Using this technique, a user can hide themselves inside a flame. Upon leaving concealment, flames burn, revealing the user. A member of the Nokizaru Group made use of this technique during a mission to retrieve a stolen scroll from Kumogakure shinobi.

name: Fire Release: Great Flame Technique
description: The Fire Release: Great Flame Technique is a hiden Fire Release technique utilised by the Sarutobi clan. The user kneads chakra in their stomach and expels a large stream of flames from their mouth that progressively widens with range. This technique can also be used collaboratively to create an enormous vortex of rapidly expanding flames. The flames are hot enough to quickly evaporate large quantities of water within a relatively short amount of time.

name: Five-Mountain Jump
description: Using the enhanced strength granted by his Steam Armour, Han delves a powerful punch to his opponent, sending them flying into the air. He jumps up after them and transforms into Kokuō, headbutts them, and using its hoof, smashes the opponent into the ground, which ruptures the ground and generates a fiery shock wave.

name: Flash
description: A swift ranged attack where the user swings their sword at a target after coating it in chakra, releasing a sharp crescent of chakra in the arc that the blade was swung.

name: Five-Seal Barrier Pass Technique
description: In order to enter the boundary created by the Five-Seal Barrier without dispelling the technique, Deidara used a technique which raised the rock blocking the entry to Akatsuki's hideout. It granted him and Sasori passage into the hideout, while keeping the barrier intact.

name: Fire Release: Hiding in Ash and Dust Technique
description: The user expels chakra-infused ash that blanket a wide area, burning anyone who comes in contact with it. The technique can also be used as a powerful deterrent from attacks as well as a highly effective smokescreen. This technique is a far more effective substitute for smoke bombs since the user doesn't need their hands to be free nor does this technique require hand seals.

name: Fire Release: Great Fireball Technique: Onibi
description: Itachi attacks his opponent with a series of mixed methods, including kicks, punches, and stabs with kunai. During the attack string, he creates a shadow clone, which attacks with a flurry of shuriken, and the real Itachi finishes with a fireball attack.

name: Fire Release: Great Flame Flower
description: Kneading his chakra and then converting it to fire, the user creates a multitude of fireballs at the same time which then rain down on the target causing severe, widespread damage around the field. These fireballs can easily destroy Earth Release-created shelters and even overpower Water Release attacks.

name: Fire Release: Smokescreen Gale
description: The user spits out a flaming tornado from their mouth, which was noted to be powerful enough to incinerate everything it comes into contact with like paper. When in contact with large volumes of water, the technique creates a dense cloud of steam.

name: Five Release Great Combo Technique
description: The user creates four shadow clones and, alongside them, launch a different base-elemental attack at the target simultaneously.

name: Flawless Three
users: Kakashi Hatake~~with~Obito Uchiha and Rin Nohara
Obito Uchiha~~with~Rin Nohara and Kakashi Hatake
Rin Nohara~~with~Kakashi Hatake and Obito Uchiha
description: Obito and Kakashi slash at their opponent, followed by Rin's back-flip kick. Rin cheers her teammates as they go forward. Emboldened by her support, Obito leapfrogs Kakashi, unleashing several small fireballs at the opponent. Kakashi slashes through the flames and the opponent, and Rin finishes by jumping and stomping at the opponent, before cheering her teammates again.

name: Flea Shuriken
description: The ninneko stretches its body and rolls the joint of its neck, launching its fleas at a target. The jutsu's effects after that vary depending on the target's tolerances: Kiba Inuzuka and Akamaru fall to the ground in painful itching; Shino Aburame finds it curious, but otherwise isn't bothered.

name: Fire Release: Nail Crimson Crow Leap
description: Shisui delivers a series of swift strikes to his opponent, then proceeds to toss a volley of fire-infused kunai, from an aerial perspective, at the opponent, the flames of which spark a devastating explosion.

name: Flight
description: While fully transformed with the Cursed Seal of Heaven, Sasuke attacks his opponent with punches, kicks, and a rotating wing attack, before swinging an electrified sword at them.

name: Flash Swallow Dance: Heaven Step
description: Minato kicks his opponent upwards, and throws several Flying Thunder God Kunai at them. He teleports between the kunai, striking his opponent, before finishing above them, where he stabs them with one.

name: Fire Release: Water Mist
description: Kakashi creates a bird of flames under his complete control that quickly flies into a designated water source, burning hot enough to cause the water to evaporate. The bird disappears as soon as the water is gone. Alternatively, the bird can release streams of fire from its mouth for offensive purposes.

name: Flaming Arrow Warhead
description: The Flaming Arrow Warhead is a technique used by Nagato through the Asura Path. Using the body modification ability of the Asura Path, the user detaches their hand, revealing a cluster of missiles. The further the hand is removed from the arm, the more missiles can be fired at once. These can fired to create widespread damage, or as homing devices seeking a single target. Even if the Asura Path has sustained significant damage, it can still produce missiles from its body, as it did when Pain attempted to kill Chōji.

name: Fire Release: Hurricane Oil Flame Bullet
description: The user creates two shadow clones that shoot oil while the original shoots fire, creating a flaming twister.

name: Flash Slice
description: From above the opponent, the user strikes the enemy with a kunai, stabbing them.

name: Fire Release: Phoenix Sage Formation Technique
description: Multiple users spit several fireballs while surrounding their opponent from above, making it impossible to avoid them.

name: Flame Circuit
description: Indra surrounds himself with flames, protecting himself and damaging any enemy that enters his surrounding area.

name: Fire Release: Two-Headed Dragon Fire: Heaven
description: Sasuke creates two shadow clones, who breathe dragon-shaped fireballs at his opponents while he throws a kunai above them. Sasuke switches places with the kunai, raining a circle of fire from above.

name: Fire Release: Roaring Flame Technique
description: Fugaku spews flames that envelop the opponent in a fiery sphere, bursting with them within it.

name: Fire Release: Soaring Flame Bullet Technique
description: The user gathers chakra from their stomach and spews a small ball of fire. The required hand seals needed for this technique have varied; Kawaki's first use required one hand seal (two in the anime) however, later in the anime, using four hand seals were used.

name: Flash Mode
description: Flash Mode is a recurring awakening mode used by Minato Namikaze throughout the Naruto Ultimate Ninja and Naruto Shippūden: Ultimate Ninja Heroes series. It greatly increases Minato's dash, attack and jump speed in all of its depictions. The flash mode moveset is not reliant on the use of Minato's trademark Flying Thunder God Kunai, which may imply it is based on his mastery over the Body Flicker Technique instead, which both his enemies and students confused with the Flying Thunder God Technique.

name: Flaming Fang: Petrification Poison
description: Garaga spits venom that is able to petrify victims moments after contact, an ability which Aoda links to Garaga's reverse scale.

name: First Axe Strike
description: The user, using Kabutowari, strikes an obstacle first with an axe, then strikes it from above with a hammer, destroying the obstacle, be it a wall or an opponent's sword.

name: Explosive Clay
description: Explosive Clay is the characteristic skill of Deidara, first used during his career as a terrorist bomber, and later as a member of Akatsuki. Deidara holds the belief that "art" is the moment in which something that has form is destroyed. In order to pursue this view, as well as to apply it towards combat, he stole a kinjutsu passed down in Iwagakure that allows its user to knead chakra into materials. Deidara feeds clay to one of his body's mouths – most commonly the mouth on his left palm – giving them shape and turning them into explosives. The power and type of explosion is determined by the chakra that he applies to the clay. In Akatsuki Hiden, the quality of the clay is also an important consideration, as inferior clays won't take the exact form that Deidara intends nor will their detonation be as impressive. The white clay used in Ceramic Village for Hanasaki ceramics is the best clay Deidara has found. The explosives are initially palm-sized, making them easy to prepare in advance and then carry into combat. To make practical use of them, however, it is necessary that Deidara enlarge them. This in turn brings the clay creation to life, which Deidara can control remotely depending on how large it was made: an average-sized bird can be sent flying at an opponent as an attack; a large bird can be used as a form of transportation, and once he reaches his destination he can send it flying at an opponent as an attack. To detonate the clay, he makes the Seal of Confrontation and says . Because Deidara relies on his clay to make his explosives, running out of clay severely limits his options in battle. Low chakra reserves also place Deidara at a disadvantage, as his mouths will struggle to shape the clay into usable forms. Deidara's clay is all earth-based, meaning that opponents can defuse the explosives with Lightning Release. Deidara ranks his clay by number, similar in fashion to the Composition C line of explosives: C1: Deidara's weakest explosive, these most often take the form of birds or insects. They are usually kept at a small size, making them ideal for sneak attacks or other covert operations. C1 is produced using one of the mouths in Deidara's palms. C2: a large, flight-capable dragon. Deidara rides atop it while it fires "smart bombs", smaller dragons that pursue their targets. The dragon also produces clay mines, which are used to force opponents to fight in a limited space. C2 is produced using both of the mouths in Deidara's palm. C3: a roughly human-shaped statue that Deidara drops on targets from above. They are designed to specifically maximise their destructive power, which is supposed to be great enough to destroy an entire village. C4: a giant doll, shaped like Deidara himself. When it ruptures, it releases a cloud of microscopic bombs, too small to be seen. When these bombs are inhaled, they flood the victim's bloodstream and detonate, destroying them at a cellular level. C4 is created using Deidara's normal mouth. C0: Deidara's . Deidara draws in chakra from every corner of his body to turn himself into a bomb. Everything within ten kilometres is destroyed, but Deidara dies in the process. C0 is created using the mouth on Deidara's chest, which is connected directly to his heart.

name: Extreme Decapitating Airwaves
description: This is a stronger version of Decapitating Airwaves, having greater power, range, and coverage angle. Using a large amount of chakra, Zaku Abumi emits a high-pressured mixture of sound waves and airwaves from the holes in the palms of his hands into the area ahead of him. It momentarily blocks visibility as the air and sound quickly travel forwards, carving up the ground and reducing everything in its path to dust. The sheer destructiveness of this technique prevents it from being used in quick succession, as it places a great burden on Zaku's arms.

name: Feigning Sleep Technique
description: Gaara uses this technique to force himself to fall asleep. This causes him to surrender control to Shukaku, who is sealed within him. While it is the dominant personality, Shukaku has complete access to its large chakra reserves, which it uses according to its inherently destructive tendencies. Before using this technique, Gaara creates a full replica of Shukaku out of sand for it to use. Gaara emerges from the replica's forehead in order to perform this technique, where his body remains even after he's asleep. This represents a vulnerability, as opponents can focus their attacks on Gaara with the goal of rousing him. If they do successfully wake Gaara, Shukaku's personality will be suppressed again.

name: Fang Beheading Fang
description: Kiba and Akamaru combine into a giant two pointed drill that runs through the opponent, launching them into the air where Kiba strikes the opponent with one of the drill points and running through them, throwing them aside.

name: Fang Passing Fang
description: An Inuzuka and their ninken companion both perform the Passing Fang, whereby they rotate their bodies and deliver a series of rapid body blows to a target. In order to coordinate their attacks, thus ensuring targets have no opportunity to defend themselves, Inuzuka and their ninken synchronise with each other as much as they can: breathing in unison; using the Four Legs Technique; using the Beast Human Clone. As the users cross back and forth for this attack, the surrounding area is damaged as well, crushing rocks and shaving sections off the ground.

name: Fang Wolf Fang
description: After an Inuzuka and their ninken combine into a Double-Headed Wolf, they begin spinning extremely rapidly towards their target. Because of how fast they spin, they are not able to see while using this technique, necessitating that targets be marked beforehand so that they can be tracked by smell. In the anime, Kiba and Akamaru are eventually able to overcome this handicap. Regardless of how targets may try to evade them, the Double-Headed Wolf pursues them until it's finally able to strike. Even without a direct hit, targets will receive extensive cutting damage from the vacuum vortex that's created by the Fang Wolf Fang's rotation. The Fang Wolf Fang is powerful enough to sever Ukon from Sakon and leave a dent in the Summoning: Rashōmon. But such power places a great strain on the users' bodies, limiting the number of times that they can perform Fang Wolf Fang.

name: Fang Violent Fang
description: Like the original version of Fang Passing Fang, Akamaru becomes Kiba through Beast Human Clone but instead of jumping off his back and then attacking, Akamaru jumps from Kiba's back towards the enemy and uses Passing Fang to launch the enemy into the air, then he and Kiba do the same several times on the airborne enemy, then attack several more times as they fall.

name: Finger Carving Seal
description: The user concentrates chakra into their finger and using the heat from that, can apply writing of whatever they want to a surface. This technique however requires them to be very delicate with their chakra control. This technique causes slight discomfort for a living target and if it is on flesh, it will scar, presumably remaining on the subject's flesh for the rest of their life.

name: Fighting Tongue Slash
description: By kneading senjutsu chakra, Fukasaku's long tongue gains utmost solidity and sharpness. It then leaps from his mouth with tremendous speed and force, enough to tear a hole through bedrock and metal pipes with ease. With that ground-splitting power, the enemy is cut in half. The way that both the enemy and the ground itself are cut apart is reminiscent of the strike of a great sword.

name: Fighting Tongue Bind
description: After focusing senjutsu chakra to it, Shima's tongue grows to its maximum limit and is reshaped with a face. The tongue will then seek out the scent of its target. When the target is found, she ensnares it to prevent escape and marks it with a corrosive chemical. After the enemy is found, Fukasaku can use the Fighting Tongue Slash on it.

name: Fangs of Lightning
description: By drawing together his twin swords, Raiga can send an electrical essence into the clouds, allowing him to create lightning strikes in any desired location.

name: Falling Wrapping Thrust
description: In his four-tailed form, Naruto leaps into the air and wraps his tails around himself. He then crashes to the ground, spinning like a piledriver. This move can block close-range techniques.

name: Fairy Tale Destruction
description: This is a cooperation ninjutsu with Naruto farting and Sakura getting enraged (summoning her Inner Sakura), it does major damage to the opponent and also poisons them because of Naruto's Fart.

name: Explosive Clay Dolls
description: Deidara releases a glob of explosive clay from both his hands that he forms into deformed human-like figures. Deidara then uses them to fight his opponent in close combat. Their body structure allows them to extend their body parts and not be sliced by normal means, however, a lightning-infused chop or sword will suffice. If a clay figure loses a body part, Deidara can simply attach a clay cord to it and form another clay figure. As the clay figures are made from explosive clay, Deidara can also detonate them at any moment while they are fighting the opponent.

name: Explosive Landmines
description: After creating the C2 Dragon, Deidara has the clay dragon spawn numerous clay mines and has his partner bury them underground, thus allowing unsuspecting victims to walk on the mines which then explode. These landmines explode automatically when they're stepped on. As such, they're not under Deidara's control.

name: Fang Heaven Wolf
description: Kiba and Akamaru hit the opponent with Fang Passing Fang, sending them airborne and criss-cross to further damage the opponent in the sky.

name: Final Move
description: Shikamaru gets the opponent caught with his Shadow Sewing Technique while Asuma extends the chakra on his Chakra Blades and slashes the opponent.

name: Face Copying Technique
description: The user becomes a near-perfect copy of another. In addition to appearance, it also makes them copy their target's scent, chakra signature, and general personality. The technique is considered to be a flawless Transformation Technique as even the copied person's allies won't be able to tell the difference. Despite the extensive aesthetical recreation of the technique, the user can't use the techniques or unique abilities of the target. It also appears to render the user very weak to attacks, both striking and enduring. In order to copy someone with this technique, the user needs to wear a special mask and stay close to the target for a long time. When the technique commences, the user's eyes begin to glow. The transformation lasts only a few days and is unique to the Kedōin clan.

name: Fang Insects Fang
description: Kiba and Akamaru perform Fang Passing Fang with Shino covering himself with his kikaichū and attack the opponent.

name: Explosive Flower
description: Ino throws a bouquet of flowers with explosive tags hidden in them, which detonate upon making contact with the opponent.

name: Explosive Clay: Twin Birds
description: Deidara creates a clay owl and eagle, that explodes on impact with an opponent.

name: Fang Rotating Fang
description: The user and their ninken partner roll at a ferocious speed in a buzz-saw like shape, and deliver many powerful beast-like attacks when contact is made with the target.

name: Eye Mind Reading
description: Eye Mind Reading is a technique that allows the user to read another's mind. By subtly weaving signs with their eye, the user can delve into the mind of their target without them noticing — even on a target that is currently infiltrating the user's mind. The user is also able to perform this on themself to dive deeply into their own memories and restore or remove information in their own mind and others.

name: Feather Bombardment
description: San's bird releases numerous feathers with pin-point accuracy that act like explosive tags.

name: Fantasy
description: Itachi activates his Mangekyō Sharingan, and uses Tsukuyomi on the opponent. The illusion is similar to his original Tsukuyomi genjutsu, as he attacks with his clones, the pinned down opponent which he mentions is going to be for about three days, while it actually lasts for a few seconds in reality.

name: Feather Launching
description: Satori launches its feathers towards opponents at high speeds, capable of piercing stone ground and chakra-enforced wood. Near the end of his life, Muku, in his human form, fired a barrage of feathers straight from his mouth via a screech when Satori attempted to take over a second time.

name: Falling Fire Scatter
description: Sasuke, whilst in the cursed seal Level 2, flies through the opponent and then into the air, where he releases a series of small fire shots that rain down upon the opponent.

name: Falling Vortex Interment
description: Gaara manipulates his sand to create a small body of sand in mid air and cause it to come crashing down into the opponent.

name: Fanned Flame Great Fire
description: The user fans their gunbai to unleash three fire whirls that blast the opponent.

name: Fanned Calamity Flames
description: After shooting fire onto the opponent, Tobi uses his gunbai to strengthen the flames, which creates a vortex of fire that knocks them into the air.

name: Fan Wind Roaring Wall
description: Temari waves her Giant Folding Fan, sending a whirlwind towards her opponent. Upon it reaching her opponent, she waves her fan again, which causes the whirlwind to throw her opponent upwards.

name: Fangs of the Monkey King
description: Hiruzen charges at his opponent, landing a kick in their gut, then he enlarges and extends Enma in his staff form. Enma manifests himself at the end of the staff and attacks the opponent with his fangs.

name: Falling Chain
description: Obito jumps up in the air, lands a kick and two punches, and finishes by throwing his opponent back down with his chains.

name: Fiery Paper Star of God
description: Through the Deva Path, Nagato imprisons his opponent with Chibaku Tensei. Once the sphere is complete, Konan embraces it with her paper wings, covering it in billions of explosive tags. She then sends a single origami bird that sets off the explosions.

name: Fire Leaping Windhole
description: Tsunade punches the ground, creating a massive shockwave. Using it as a cover, Orochimaru summons three Rashōmon gates, creating them in the form of a triangle, trapping the opponent in between. Then, Orochimaru and Jiraiya use Wind and Fire Release respectively to create a huge fiery vortex. Tsunade jumps into the flames and, after activating her Yin Seal, delivers a punch strong enough to break the gates in an explosion.

name: Explosive Clay: Snake
description: Using explosive clay, Deidara creates snakes and sends them to slither towards the opponent and explode on contact.

name: Fairy Tale Get
description: Inner Sakura appears and Sakura rushes forward with her fists raised, pushing and hitting the target multiple times. Afterwards she finishes with a kick.

name: Fierce Snake
description: Stretching both his arms, Mitsuki delivers a rapid fire barrage of punches to his opponent.

name: Fierce Snake Trample
description: Anko summons snakes and repeatedly swings her opponent around, before releasing them into the air, and striking them away with snakes.

name: Fierce Attack Wind Sphere
description: Asura cups his hands to gather chakra into a small floating spiraling sphere.

name: Explosive Great Ball Roll
description: Konohamaru brings out a giant explosive ball from a scroll and kicks towards to the opponent, exploding momentarily.

name: Favourable Wind
description: Manipulating her dimension, Kaguya creates a twister of sand that sucks in the opponent.

name: Fanned Flame Great Fire: Circle Pocket
description: Madara fans his gunbai, surrounding himself with six fire whirls that rotate around him.

name: Explosive Parachute
description: Shikamaru sends out three parachutes with explosive tags attached, which float toward the opponent and explode.

name: Falling Aerial Blossom Explosion
description: Kurenai vanishes in a gust of cherry blossoms and then reappears in the air in front of the opponent, throwing explosive tags at them.

name: Fang's Rush
description: Ameyuri Ringo utilises Kiba in combination with agile spinning movements, sweeping through her targets while rotating around herself, hitting all enemies around her.

name: Fat Couple Attack
description: Sabu sits astride Ponta as he attacks the enemy with a powerful paw slash, then leaps up and finishes them off with his axe. The attack can also be performed when Ponta rears up on his hind legs: he grabs the enemy with his forepaws, and Sabu delivers a sweeping blow with his axe.

name: Extinction: Still Water Slash
description: Itachi first attacks using the Fire Release: Great Fireball Technique, then pelts the enemy with a barrage of kunai, and finally finishes them off with a powerful sword strike.

name: Fire Escape Technique
description: The user produces a massive wall of flames to distract the enemy. In the same moment, the user will make their escape.

name: Eternal Rival (Ultimate Ninja 3)
description: Kakashi uses his Sharingan to copy Guy's Dynamic Entry, and then the two of them perform it together.

name: Ephemeral
description: This technique allows Itachi to put his opponent within a genjutsu by using his finger as a medium. This induces the genjutsu. When the technique was used on Naruto Uzumaki, crows flocked from Itachi and turned into shuriken after he performed the ram seal which bombarded Naruto, and then attempted to put him to sleep. When he resisted the sleep command, Naruto then experienced the sensation of his body parts turning into his closest friends who then tortured him psychologically. This is implied to be an extra stage of the genjutsu caused by Itachi after performing the ram seal. The same goes along with his use of shuriken.

name: Enma Summoning: Adamantine Monkey Dance
description: Hiruzen summons Enma to slash the opponent with his claws until he launches them into the air. He then dives onto them and transforms into a staff that Hiruzen uses to slam the opponent into the ground from midair.

name: Evil Sealing Method
description: This technique suppresses the power of a cursed seal. Because applying cursed seals in the first place requires a great deal of skill, suppressing one with this technique also requires a great deal of skill. The preparations needed for this technique are quite arduous: users write several long lines of symbols in their own blood, which trail from the cursed seal through the surrounding area. Once this is completed and the technique is activated, the symbols converge towards and surround the cursed seal, the blood acting as a chain that prevents the cursed seal from spreading. Applying the Evil Sealing Method is quite painful, and recipients are likely to pass out after receiving it. The Evil Sealing Method can only suppress cursed seals, not remove them. Its power also relies on the will of the recipient: if the recipient wants it to work, then it will fight off the cursed seal's effects as much as it can; but if the user would rather the cursed seal activated, the Evil Sealing Method will be powerless to prevent it. For this reason, after Kakashi Hatake suppresses Sasuke Uchiha's Cursed Seal of Heaven, Kakashi takes efforts to train Sasuke so that he won't be tempted by the cursed seal's power, notably teaching him the Chidori. This ends up not being enough for Sasuke and he willingly accepts the Cursed Seal of Heaven's influence. Over the following years, the Evil Sealing Method remains imprinted upon him, but inert since Sasuke has no need for it. When the cursed seal is ultimately removed, the Evil Sealing Method is removed as well. In the anime, Kurenai Yūhi uses this technique to hold back the Kurama Clan's Kekkei Genkai.

name: Evilest Assassins
description: Itachi creates a water clone to punch and hold the opponent. Kisame slashes them into the air while using the remains of the destroyed water clone to summon a water shark to strike the opponent. The opponent falls in the wake of Itachi's Tsukuyomi in which the opponent withers away as though they were water.

name: Execution by Kiss
description: This ability allows Fūka to absorb all of an opponent's chakra and techniques by kissing them, giving her multiple elemental affinities, as well as enforcing the ones she already has and gaining access to all of her victim's elemental techniques. After absorbing her opponent's chakra, she could steal their soul. This technique could also be used to determine what elemental affinities the target has by licking them. Due to one body being unable to handle so much chakra, Fūka distributes the chakra she absorbed into multiple bodies, and uses Colour Course Change to switch to another if needed. When she tried using this against Naruto Uzumaki however, she began absorbing the chakra of the Nine-Tails, but the pure rage and malice in its chakra proved too much for her that she stopped the technique.

name: Exploding Flame Shot
description: By creating a spark from their hands, this technique allows the user to throw multiple balls of flames, which are able to either cause fiery explosions on impact or set the target on fire.

name: Exploding Sasumata Attack
description: Gamaken attacks the opponent using his Sasumata, which causes explosions.

name: Evil Greatness
description: Orochimaru first punches the opponent in the face and knocks them back. He then wraps the opponent with countless snakes which creates a dome around them and holds them. He then jumps and stabs them with his Sword of Kusanagi, finishing them off.

name: Exploding Sand Boulder
description: Gaara condenses his sand into many floating boulders. Once formed, he can use them both as projectiles and as explosives, setting them off both at will or when an opponent gets near them.

name: Exploding Dragon Strike
description: Tenten opens one of her scrolls and releases a large flaming dragon that explodes upon contact.

name: Explosion Release: Landmine Fist
description: After establishing direct contact with their opponent through a simple punch, the user utilises Explosion Release to subsequently generate an enormous explosion from the opponent's insides. This explosion is powerful enough to completely obliterate an opponent far larger than the user. Due to the directionality of the blast, the user minimises any potential repercussions, such as being struck by resultant debris and even recoil appears to be completely negated. In the anime, Gari also uses a less-destructive version of this technique, creating a puff of smoke instead of an explosion.

name: Explosion: Ice Mountain Destruction
description: Mizore uses his Retractable Cable Arm to launch his metal hand to grab the opponent, spin them in the air, and launch them to an ice mountain that breaks and parts of its ice fall down on the opponent.

name: Explosive Bubble
description: After Utakata blows dozens of bubbles, they make their way towards opponents. Upon popping, they create bright yellow and white flashes along with variably strong explosions that knock back the enemy and everything nearby. The explosions also produce a large amount of smoke, which can be used to obstruct the opponent's vision. It differs from the Soap Bubble Ninjutsu technique in that this ability does not require Utakata's will to explode.

name: Erupting Interment Dust
description: Gaara manipulates his chakra to generate multiple small pillars of sand to rise up from the ground beneath the opponent and lift them into the air.

name: Evil Releasing Method
description: The Evil Releasing Method is a direct counterpart to the Evil Sealing Method. It is used to release technique-induced seals on a person rather than sealing it. Compared to the Evil Sealing Method, the Evil Releasing Method requires far less preparation. Sasuke Uchiha used this technique to revive Orochimaru, mixing a piece of Kabuto Yakushi's modified flesh to create a physical body for the consciousness of Orochimaru that was left in Anko Mitarashi's Cursed Seal of Heaven.

name: Exploding Circle
description: Hanzō performs a spin with his kusarigama, releasing a circle of exploding tags in the process, which then explode on impact with his opponent.

name: Explosion Release: Defence Technique
description: The user creates a small explosion in their palm. If properly timed and angled, it can be used to send thrown kunai back at the enemy. Gari has also used this to cut the length of binding cloth that Maki used to restrain Pakura.

name: Exploding Insect
description: The user blinds the enemy with a smokescreen to scatter larvae that if inhaled, will grow inside their bodies into a spider-like parasite that explodes, killing the host. The insect's growth depends on how much chakra the host is using and a massive amount of chakra can speed up the growth process. The insect can however be removed by the means of surgery, though it is difficult, as one mistake could cause the insect to explode. The Nokizaru Group, notable users of this technique, regularly taunts their victims into attacking after being exposed, thereby accelerating the process.

name: Erupting Strong Foot
description: After increasing his chakra temperature to boiling point, the user releases boiling steam from his body and delivers a powerful kick to his opponent with enhanced force via Steam Armour. This attack has enough force to generally send his opponent reeling backwards.

name: Exploding Tree Spear
description: Danzō unleashes roots that sprout from his arm to attack the opponent.

name: Erupting Formation Body
description: Han releases steam from his armour that damages the nearby opponent.

name: Erupting Falling Stomp
description: After throwing his opponent into the air, Han jumps up and stomps them into the ground using his Steam Armour to increase his attack.

name: Existence Beheading
description: Mifune performs a powerful strike, quickly drawing his sword and cutting through his opponent. His opponent only feels the attack as Mifune resheaths his sword.

name: Erupting Dust Sand
description: Gaara performs an uppercut, creating a pillar of sand that launches the opponent into the air.

name: Erupting Propulsion Fist
description: After increasing their chakra temperature to the boiling point, the user releases boiling steams from his body and delivers a steam-enhanced punch that sends his opponent flying far away.

name: Erupting Revolving Foot
description: Han delivers a few punches, hits the opponent up, jumps up into the air, and does a spinning downward kick that's accelerated by his steam to the opponent.

name: Erupting Revolving Arm
description: Han delivers a series of strikes, and while aided by his steam, he spin kicks, kicks down, and lands several punches on his opponent as he spins, hitting them upwards.

name: Erupting Thrust Cannon
description: Han jumps into the air, and while spinning, lands a kick, a punch, and a steam blast on his opponent, sending them crashing to the ground.

name: Ensnaring Exploding Flame
description: Obito lands a couple punches, followed by a hit with his gunbai, a gust of wind, another set of hits with the gunbai, which lift the opponent up in the air, and as they fall, Obito throws kunai with explosive tags attached, which explode upon impact.

name: Evening Elephant
description: The Evening Elephant is a high-level, forbidden taijutsu that can be performed by those who have opened all Eight Gates. This technique is a continuous assault of five punches, with each — as they are referred to — being performed faster than the one before. Each "foot" creates a cannon of pressurised air bearing the appearance of an elephant's leg, causing devastating damage to the opponent. The first punch alone was capable of tunnelling a massive and deep hole in the ground, and the final punch proved strong enough to shatter a Truth-Seeking Ball defence. The strength of several of these punches was enough to temporarily immobilise Madara Uchiha as the Ten-Tails' jinchūriki.

name: Evil Deeds
description: Obito goes intangible, rushes at his opponent, and at the last moment, materialises himself, slashing his opponent with a kunai.

name: Eternal Rival (Ultimate Ninja Storm Revolution)
description: Kakashi and Guy both attack their opponent with Dynamic Entry. Kakashi reveals his Sharingan and Guy opens the Gate of Wonder, after which the two simultaneously send out a giant-sized Lightning Release: Lightning Beast Tracking Fang and Daytime Tiger. Kakashi's technique envelops Guy's, and their combined form bites the opponent, resulting in an explosion.

name: Event Recording
description: This is an unnamed ability possessed by Black Zetsu that allows it to record events that it has personally witnessed. When used in conjunction with its signature Mayfly technique, Black Zetsu can gather data from battles without being detected. In order to show these recordings to others, it must first merge with the recipient. Black Zetsu, over the centuries, claims it was able to record the entire history of shinobi to later show its creator, Kaguya Ōtsutsuki, after her revival. The Ten-Tails' sealing. The creation of the moon. Hagoromo Ōtsutsuki teaching ninshū to his sons, Indra and Asura Ōtsutsuki. Its own temptation of Indra. The fight between Madara Uchiha and Hashirama Senju. Madara's first revival and subsequent implantation of Hashirama's DNA. Madara awakening the Rinnegan and summoning the Demonic Statue of the Outer Path for the first time. Its own initial merging with White Zetsu. In the anime, the death of one of Kakuzu's former partners. The fight between Naruto Uzumaki and Sasuke Uchiha. The fight between Itachi Uchiha and Sasuke Uchiha. The fight between Kisame Hoshigaki and Killer B. Kabuto Yakushi and Obito Uchiha teaming up for the Fourth Shinobi World War. Naruto Uzumaki and Sasuke Uchiha's fight with Madara Uchiha.

name: Evil Disturbance Waltz
description: Clad in Susanoo, Madara hurls his chakra sword at the opponent, swirling like a shuriken. During his battle with Hashirama Senju, Madara had cloaked Kurama in his Susanoo, and pierced through the beast's Tailed Beast Balls for a more damaging result.

name: Expansive Truth-Seeking Ball
description: The Expansive Truth-Seeking Ball is a kekkei mōra used by Kaguya Ōtsutsuki. It is composed of all five elemental nature transformations as well as Yin–Yang Release. Kaguya Ōtsutsuki used the God Tree to absorb chakra from all the people trapped inside the technique to create a maximised Truth-Seeking Ball. A vast expanding mass of chaos with power to reshape the world by obliterating it to nothing first. Unlike the standard Truth-Seeking Ball, which a user starts with a set amount of spheres that cannot be regenerated if lost or destroyed, this technique does not have such limitations and can be generated from nothing. The sphere will continue to expand until it overwrites the previous dimension, completely annihilating it. If this happens, even previously synced Space–Time Ninjutsu will be unable to return to the new dimension.

name: Evasion Technique
description: Using her dōjutsu, Yome is easily able to see attacks coming, allowing her a better chance to dodge or launch a counterattack.

name: Enclosing Technique
description: Using this technique, a wide variety of objects and even living things can be stored within scrolls, and can be released when the scroll is opened or meets a specific condition. It is possible to seal ninjutsu into a scroll, as demonstrated by Kisame Hoshigaki, who placed sharks into his Water Prison Technique that he sealed into a scroll, which would activate and imprison anyone that tried to read the scroll upon opening it. To save chakra, instead of sealing a nature element into a scroll that was created through chakra, one could just use pre-existing nature elements, like water from an ocean, and seal it within the scroll. Though a scroll is the most common use of sealing something, as demonstrated by Ajisai in the anime, this technique can be used to seal things into a small sheet of paper too.

name: Exploding Mucus Shot
description: The user sprays yellow acidic paste on the ground, which can raise up to create a wall-like formation, capable of either damaging a target or providing effective coverage.

name: Exploding Human Technique
description: This technique was created by Chino after the Fourth Shinobi World War, who used information within minerals springs that came into contact with White Zetsu as a to structure the technique. When a Ketsuryūgan-wielder makes physical contact with a target, they can infuse some of their chakra into the target. The said chakra becomes poisonous to the target, making their bodies unstable. Should the target then begin to bleed, the chakra will be set off, causing the victim's body to become consumed in a pitch-black substance before inflating in a grotesque manner and finally exploding on a large and on a very destructive scale. Only by blocking the chakra flow of the target or rendering them unconscious will nullify the mutation and following explosion. With proper medical aid, the poisonous chakra can be extracted, saving the victim completely.

name: Evening Shower Heavenly Crush
description: Sarada kicks her opponent away, moves herself to where they'll land, and kicks them up in the air. She jumps up above them and proceeds to perform a Lion Combo on them toward the ground. She proceed to throw a Great Fireball and finishing it with a Cherry Blossom Impact on them.

name: Eruption Legs
description: The user rushes towards the opponent with a kick and follows with an upward kick boosted by their body modifications on their legs.

name: Explosion Release: Impact
description: Gari punches the ground, the explosion causing the earth to upturn, unbalancing his opponents.

name: Engraved Tsukuyomi
description: A variation of the Tsukuyomi used by Nanashi Uchiha. By reflecting the light of her Sharingan off of the moon, similarly to the Infinite Tsukuyomi, the user is able to brand all those caught in the light of their eyes with a blemish in the shape of their Mangekyō Sharingan. This allows her to prepare for a mass usage of Yachihoko.

name: Eternal Lightning
description: Indra sends out a large ball of electricity, which hovers above the opponent and strikes down bolts of lightning.

name: Explosion Release: Quick Explosive Kick
description: Gari creates an explosion under his foot, which greatly increases his speed and increases the impact of his kick on the opponent.

name: Explosion Release: Instantaneous Incineration
description: Gari concentrates the maximum explosive element in his fist, and when he strikes an opponent's body, it does not explode, but completely incinerates them in an instant.

name: Empty Flaming Prison of Coiled Snakes
description: Ichi summons snakes that surround the enemy in large numbers, creating a kind of prison, after which San sends his bird towards them, dropping its exploding feathers on the prison, creating a massive explosion that destroys the enemy along with the prison of snakes.

name: Exclusive Summoning: Zero-Tails
description: Shinnō summons the Zero-Tails, then fuses with it and unleashes a massive attack with his shadow arms, trying to crush the enemy. However, the fusion is time-limited, and Shinnō is unable to perform more than two attacks.

name: Evernight
description: Obito makes several rapid movements towards a target while simultaneously readying his sword. Once he reaches the target, he slashes them once.

name: Eight Trigrams Vacuum Palm
description: This technique is similar in practice to Eight Trigrams Palms Revolving Heaven, but has a specific target rather than a general area. To perform it, the user precisely pinpoints the enemy's vital points with the Byakugan and releases a high-speed palm thrust. A "vacuum shell" compressed using the Gentle Fist is formed to attack the opponent's vitals from a distance, blowing them off their feet with tremendous force before they even notice they were hit.

name: Eight Trigrams Palms Revolving Heaven
description: This is a secret taijutsu of the Hyūga clan's main house, traditionally only known by the head of the clan and the clan's heir. Neji Hyūga, a member of a branch house, was able to learn this technique through mere observation, a testament to his genius. Combining their taijutsu with the Byakugan, which the technique is only said to be possible with, the moment before the Hyūga is struck by an attack, they emit chakra from all of their body's tenketsu to block it. They then spin rapidly, repelling the attack (and anything else in the vicinity) away and creating a protective shield for as long as they continue to spin. The greater the force of an attack, the greater the force with which it's repelled. The user is capable of defending not only themselves but multiple people. Revolving Heaven is meant to compensate for the blindspot of the Hyūga's Byakugan. But in this regard it is quite effective, leading Tenten to describe it as an absolute defence superior to the Shield of Sand. While normally a short-range manoeuvre, with greater skill one can increase both the range and momentum of the rotating chakra shield as Hiashi Hyūga can repel attackers from several feet away and did so with such force that it ploughed the ground around him, cratering the terrain he was on save for the location he was standing at. The only effective means of countering the Revolving Heaven is to prevent the Hyūga from spinning; the anime sometimes depicts it being used without spinning.

name: Eight Trigrams Sixty-Four Palms
description: This is a secret taijutsu of the Hyūga clan's main house, traditionally only known by the head of the clan and the clan's heir. Neji Hyūga, a member of a branch house, was able to learn this technique through mere observation, a testament to his genius. Using their Byakugan's near-360° field of vision, the Hyūga envisions themselves within the centre of an Eight Trigrams symbol. The user then delivers a series of attacks to a target that is within the symbol's perimeter, striking sixty-four of their tenketsu. Those sixty-four tenketsu are subsequently blocked, stopping the flow of chakra within the target's body and making it difficult for them to move. Alternatively, the sixty-four strikes can be split amongst multiple targets, such as to to deflect incoming projectiles. The sixty-four strikes are broken into six smaller sets. Users perform each set of strikes within the same length of time, but because each set has more strikes than the one before it, the set's strikes become increasingly faster. The last set, during which thirty-two strikes are performed, is especially difficult, demanding great resolve and a strong step forward to pull off. As targets are struck, they are increasingly knocked backwards, with the combined force of the final sets being great enough to push them through tree trunks. The six sets of strikes are: Two consecutive strikes. Two more consecutive strikes, totalling four. Four consecutive strikes, totalling eight. Eight consecutive strikes, totalling sixteen. Sixteen consecutive strikes, totalling thirty-two. Thirty-two consecutive strikes, totalling sixty four.

name: Eight Trigrams One Hundred Twenty-Eight Palms
description: The Eight Trigrams One Hundred Twenty-Eight Palms is a technique of the Gentle Fist fighting style. It is essentially a seventh step to the Eight Trigrams Sixty-Four Palms, doubling the previous barrage total and at twice the speed. To perform, the user crutches down while extending both arms outward, one in front and the other behind while angled like propeller blades. This adds another row of kanji to the envisioned Eight Trigrams symbol, extending the technique's perimeter. This technique is used to close off the flow of chakra through one hundred and twenty-eight chakra points of an opponent's Chakra Pathway System. This eliminates their ability to use chakra for quite some time and makes it difficult for them to move. Alternatively, it can be used to hit a great number of targets very quickly.
