description: This shinjutsu allows the user to reflect any incoming attacks back at the opponent. Even the thought of attacking the user will reflect the predicted move back at the attacker. The stronger the attacker's killing intent, the more powerful the reflection will be. In order to activate this ability, Daemon's palms must be touching another person, which extends the ability to them as well.

name: Revolving Blade Dance
description: Using the Scientific Ninja Tools integrated into their blood stream, the user forms a blade from their arm to slash the enemy.

name: Reverse Scale
description: With microscopic Scientific Ninja Tools in their blood stream, the user is able to modify their flesh for multiple purposes, such as blades, claws, shields, and throwable projectiles. Kawaki's affected limb are his arms, Delta's are her legs, and Code's are his hands. Unlike Code and Kawaki, Delta can modify her legs to enable her jet propulsion, granting her flight. Should an affected limb be lost, the user is not incapable of shaping their flesh and can simply extend it around where the limb used to be, such as in Kawaki's case from when he briefly used a prosthetic before gaining a new arm.

name: Rising Thorn
description: Using their modified body, the user stomps their foot into the ground, transforming into a large thorn that rises beneath the opponent.

name: Red Secret Technique: Red Sea
description: Using the flamethrowers attached to the puppet Sasori, the user fires a spreading wave of flames at the opponent.

name: Right Pinching Melody
description: While the opponent's attention is on Sakon, Ukon jumps behind them to slam his fists down on their head.

name: Resonance Blast
description: Obito grows a large tree from beneath the ground with four flowers that forms four large Tailed Beast Balls. To ensure the balls would not miss, Obito had used Six Red Yang Formation to contain the blast, although the Allied Shinobi Forces had teleported outside the barrier to avoid it. The resultant explosion was strong enough to completely distort the shape of the unbreakable barrier.

name: Rasenshuriken: Orange: Pursuit Attack
description: Naruto forms three orange coloured Rasenshuriken by himself and throws one after the other at the opponent.

name: Red Orbs
description: In his grayish humanoid form, Haido can use four red orbs floating behind his back and shape them to his liking. They can be shaped into shields, black tendrils or wings that allow him flight.

name: Rasengan
description: The Rasengan is a jutsu that takes form as a spinning ball of chakra, invented by Minato Namikaze. Minato came up with the idea for this technique after seeing a Tailed Beast Ball being used. Because his lover, Kushina Uzumaki, was a jinchūriki, she would inevitably be deployed to fight opponents who would use Tailed Beast Balls against her. Minato therefore wanted to develop a technique that Kushina could use to match against those opponents, which also worked with her chakra volume as a jinchūriki. Minato struggled with the original concepts for the technique, as they were either too weak or too unstable for use. It was only from a conversation with Jiraiya that Minato thought of a way to make the technique usable. Because of Jiraiya's inspiration, Minato wanted to call the technique , but both Jiraiya and Kushina felt it was too long and lame. Kushina suggested "Rasengan" instead, which Minato agreed was a better name. Minato would continue refining the Rasengan, ultimately taking three years of development time to perfect it. The Rasengan is an application of shape transformation, where chakra emitted from the palm is rotated in multiple directions simultaneously to contain it within a sphere. No hand seals are involved, in theory making it easy to learn and use, nor does it require additional chakra to maintain once it's properly formed. The Rasengan grinds into whatever it comes into contact with, doing extensive damage until the spinning chakra dissipates; Jiraiya describes it as more powerful than the Chidori, an assessment that Sasuke Uchiha agrees with after comparing the two. If users thrust the Rasengan into targets, they can be propelled away from the user until they eventually collide with some obstacle. The Rasengan's various attributes have earned it recognition as the pinnacle of shape transformation. The Rasengan is in principle a simple application of shape transformation, but manipulating the motion of chakra in so many directions at once makes it extremely difficult to learn in practice. Additionally, as the technique is simply a mass of chakra, the technique is primarily suited for users with very high reserves of chakra. For this reason, Jiraiya breaks up the process into three steps when he teaches it to Naruto Uzumaki. Naruto subsequently uses these same three steps when he teaches it to Konohamaru Sarutobi, who in turn later uses them when he teaches it to Boruto Uzumaki: 1. Rotation - the user learns to spin their chakra in multiple directions at the same time. Users may be given a water balloon while they practice, to help them mark their progress by the churning water. The step is completed when users are able to burst the water balloon with their chakra. In theory this should be done with one hand, but Naruto initially uses chakra from both of his hands to increase the agitation via rapidly moving his free hand to form the multiple rotations, thus saving time. It can be useful to know in which direction one's chakra naturally spins, in order to avoid impeding oneself, as otherwise the chakra flow will divide and cause resistance; identifying the natural rotation direction of the user/practitioner can often be determined by the cowlick on their head. 2. Power - the user increases the volume and density of chakra they output. To help in this regard, users may be given a rubber ball: there is no water inside to help them burst the exterior and the rubber shell is thicker than a balloon's. It's important that users are able to actually destroy the rubber ball, not merely rupture it, as only by destroying the ball will users know that their chakra is sufficiently concentrated. This step can be painful for users, as they may not be accustomed to emitting so much chakra from their hands at once, and in fact they may end up injuring themselves in the process of destroying the ball. 3. Containment - the user must combine the first two steps into a contained sphere. To help in this regard, users may be given a balloon to help them visualise the intended shape; if the balloon is popped or otherwise moves, mastery is not yet achieved. This is by far the most difficult of the three steps because of how refined the user's chakra control must be. Initially Naruto and Konohamaru have ended up using shadow clones as a shortcut, being able to solely focus on holding the sphere in their hands while using their clones' additional attention and extra hands to help contain and shape the chakra. Both do eventually learn to perform the Rasengan without the need for shadow clones, Naruto during the Fourth Shinobi World War, Konohamaru by the time he begins leading Team 7. Once learned, the Rasengan appears largely identical from one user to the next. The only potential difference is its size: when Boruto first learns to use the Rasengan, it's noted to be quite small. With greater proficiency, the size of a user's Rasengan grows to be about the size of their hand. Because of how useful the Rasengan is once it's been learned, many users end up inventing variants or additional applications based upon it. Creating larger versions of the Rasengan is one of the more straightforward methods, as seen with its Big, Ultra-Big, and Super-Ultra-Big versions. Another option is to increase the number of Rasengan that the user creates: most users are limited to two (one in each hand), but Naruto also develops a practice of having his shadow clones perform their own Rasengan, giving him dozens of Rasengan to attack with simultaneously. In the anime, Boruto devises a way of compressing the Rasengan, thus increasing its penetrative strength. The Rasengan, being a simple though extremely advanced application of Shape Transformation, lends itself to being combined with nature transformations. In fact Minato created the Rasengan with the intention of combining it with his own nature, a task that proved too difficult for him to complete prior to his death. Kakashi Hatake also failed to combine the Rasengan with his own lightning-nature, prompting him to invent the Chidori instead. Naruto encounters similar struggles to combine the Rasengan with his wind-nature, which he describes as needing to look left and right at the same time. He is eventually able to overcome this obstacle by using a second shadow clone to provide the nature transformation while he and another shadow clone form the Rasengan. This ultimately leads to the creation of the Wind Release: Rasenshuriken, which is most notable for its ability to be thrown. Years later, Boruto unknowingly adds his own lightning-nature (wind in the novel) to his Rasengan, which causes it to turn invisible if thrown, potentially lowering an opponent's guard before it strikes them. Sometime later, while possessing Boruto, Momoshiki Ōtsutsuki condensed the technique into a tiny projectile able to pierce clean through targets from great distances and at great speeds. When in Sage Mode, the user can use a senjutsu-enhanced version known as . It is fundamentally the same as the normal version, but the addition of natural energy into the mix the users chakra makes it notably stronger. For Naruto, it is while using Sage Mode that he is first able to throw the Wind Release: Rasenshuriken, which previously would sporadically lose its shape if he didn't hold on to it. Naruto, as a jinchūriki, can use the Nine-Tails' chakra to assist in using the Rasengan. While using a version 1 cloak in Part I, he makes a Rasengan without the aid of a shadow clone, using the cloak itself to contain it. Due to the Nine-Tails' influence, this Rasengan is darker in colour and much stronger. Different video games have called it , , , and . After learning to use the Nine-Tails Chakra Mode in Part II, Naruto uses chakra arms in place of a shadow clone to help him create the Rasengan. Because he can manifest multiple chakra arms at once, this in turn means he can use multiple Rasengan simultaneously, such as for the Spiralling Strife Spheres. The Nine-Tails is uncooperative when Naruto first starts using the Nine-Tails Chakra Mode, preventing him from using the Tailed Beast Ball. He tries to create an alternative in the Tailed Beast Rasengan, but he's unable to do so. The Nine-Tails does eventually agree to work with him, allowing him to use Tailed Beast Ball and thus making the Tailed Beast Rasengan unnecessary. Naruto is later given access to the other tailed beasts' chakra, whose natures he can apply to the Rasengan and its variants, such as the Sage Art: Magnet Release Rasengan.

name: Rain of Spiders
description: Kidōmaru summons Kyodaigumo high above his target. Kyodaigumo then produces a sac of baby spiders, which Kidōmaru cuts open to release them. The many baby spiders rain down on the target, spinning out strings of chakra as they fall. Because the baby spiders are so numerous, targets cannot avoid all of them, inevitably leading them to be wrapped in the chakra strings. Once caught by the strings, it is extremely difficult to escape; upon falling prey to this technique, Neji Hyūga was unable to spin for his Eight Trigrams Palms Revolving Heaven.

name: Quicksand Waterfall Flow
description: Using his personal sand, Gaara grinds up rocks and minerals underground into a huge volume of sand that he brings above ground. The earth shakes as the sand surfaces, which Gaara then manipulates like a tsunami that he crashes against his targets. Targets are battered multiple times by the waves of sand as it spreads throughout the area. When the sand settles, the landscape is dramatically altered, taking on the appearance of a barren desert. Gaara can then use this sand to perform additional attacks, such as Sand Waterfall Imperial Funeral. Because of how much sand Gaara uses for this technique, the Fourth Kazekage assumes he can only use it in Tailed Beast Mode in order to gain access to the full power of Shukaku. He is subsequently surprised to see Gaara using it on his own.

name: Puppet Technique
description: The Puppet Technique is the core skill of a fighting style, whereby they control a puppet. The modern version of the Puppet Technique used by shinobi was first created by Monzaemon Chikamatsu of Sunagakure. Monzaemon originally intended the Puppet Technique for purely entertainment purposes, but by collaborating with shinobi he adapted the skill for combat. In the years following the technique's creation, Suna's shinobi became pioneers in the art of puppetry, with its Puppet Brigade being given the specific mandate of finding new ways to use and exploit puppets for battle. Performing the Puppet Technique involves emitting from a user's fingers to connect to a puppet, with the fingers' movements controlling the puppet's actions. Less experienced users will connect all ten of their fingers to a single puppet, with each finger controlling a specific joint or mechanism. As a user becomes more experienced they require fewer threads to control a single puppet, until finally they can control a puppet using only one thread. With this growing mastery, users also become able to control multiple puppets at a time, ten being the normal limit (one per finger). No matter how many threads are being used per puppet, the user's will plays a large role in a puppet's movements, thus creating an inevitable time lag between the user's commands and the puppet's response. Controlling a puppet requires most of a puppeteer's attentions and maintaining the threads is a constant drain on their chakra. Not only does this mean a puppeteer is vulnerable when they are controlling a puppet, it also tends to mean they cannot fight very well without one, as their combat style relies so heavily on them. As such, puppeteers try very hard to hide or at least keep their distance from opponents. In the event that an opponent gets too close, some puppeteers have devised countermeasures: certain puppets created by Sasori, such as Sanshōuo and Hiruko, are intended to be controlled from the inside, acting as shields for their puppeteers; Chiyo replaced one of her arms with a Mechanical Light Shield Block, giving her a defensive option to use in emergencies; Kankurō is in the habit of disguising puppets as himself, causing opponents that attack him to instead fall into his puppets' clutches. It should also be noted that, while the Chakra Threads are difficult to notice, it is possible to cut them, effectively disabling the puppet in the process. The threads can also be used to wrap around opponents in order to restrict their movements. Because puppeteers rely on their puppets for almost all aspects of combat, keeping the puppets safe is of paramount importance. At the simplest, this means not allowing the puppets to be destroyed or otherwise disabled. More than that, it is also vital to keep how a puppet works secret from opponents. If an opponent knows what weapons or traps a puppet is outfitted with, the puppeteer will lose the advantage of surprise that so often gives them the upperhand. If an opponent knows how a puppet is designed – which, unlike weapons and traps, cannot be greatly altered by the puppeteer – they can focus their attacks on the puppet's structural weaknesses. If a puppeteer does lose their puppet in battle (or if they merely opt not to use one), the chakra threads remain a versatile tool. The threads can be connected to opponents to impede their movements, such as by tripping them, or to take control of their body, using them as a puppet. To prevent opponents from noticing that they're being manipulated, puppeteers will use a minimal amount of chakra to create the threads, rendering them invisible. If chakra threads are attached to weapons, such as kunai, this not only allows users to throw multiple weapons at a time, but also allows them an easy method of connecting their threads to distant targets. Puppeteers can attach chakra threads to faraway targets even without this subterfuge, giving them a quick way to bring objects to their side. Centuries before Monzaemon created his version of the Puppet Technique, the Ōtsutsuki clan used a different version that had fewer of the above drawbacks. The Ōtsutsuki were able to control their puppets (or other people) remotely from seemingly any distance. The novelization of The Last: Naruto the Movie explains that this was achieved by placing orbs of chakra within the puppets' bodies, allowing the Ōtsutsuki to control their puppets through thought alone. Over time, these puppets became mostly autonomous, requiring no conscious effort to control and only needing the Tenseigan to power their movements. In Gaara Hiden, after Kankurō studies reports of the Ōtsutsuki's puppets, he achieves a similar effect by using imperceptibly thin chakra threads; although this doesn't make his puppets autonomous, it does significantly increase the range he can control them from. - practised by Monzaemon and Chiyo. - practised by Sasori and Kankurō. - practised by Kankurō and Shinki.

name: Rasengan Connection
description: Naruto creates a shadow clone that charges chakra in his palm while kicking the enemy before disappearing, leaving the real Naruto to use the fully charged Rasengan.

name: Rain Tiger at Will Technique
description: The Rain Tiger at Will Technique is a contact-type perception ninjutsu, allowing one to freely manipulate rain infused with the user's own chakra. The rain falls from rain clouds, formed with Pain's own chakra. During this technique, the falling raindrops are closely linked to Pain's senses. When the rain is obstructed by a chakra belonging to someone not of the village, the existence of the intruder can be detected. The detection of the rain, however, is not specific as Pain can only know if someone has entered the vicinity of the rain but not where specifically they are. Upon knowing an intruder has entered the rain's vicinity, he needs someone who specialises in covering large areas to find the intruder's specific location. The rain will keep on falling until Pain uses the seal to cancel it. When Pain is away from Amegakure, he always uses this technique to keep a close eye on the village. He also made it rain every Sunday. Assuming that no one in the village knows about the sensory nature of this technique apart from Nagato and Konan, outsiders will think the rain is a natural occurrence and will not be aware they will be detected once the raindrops fall upon them.

name: Puppet Scatter Shot
description: Kankurō uses Karasu to shoot multiple poison covered kunai from its body at his opponent.

name: Puppet Smoke Bombs
description: Kankurō jumps and then makes his puppet Karasu shoot smoke bombs at an angle the poison smoke will spread and damage them nearby.

name: Raging Thunder
description: is a sword technique utilised by Temujin by drawing energy from the Stone of Gelel. By focusing gelel energy onto his sword and after dealing a blow with it, Temujin can create a powerful Gelel barrier before him. This technique was used in an attempt to negate Naruto's Rasengan. The two attacks resulted in a massive explosion that destroyed the mountain peak that Naruto and Temujin were fighting on.

name: Puppet Performance: Skilful Achievement with a Human Body
description: A puppet performance technique where chakra threads are attached to various spots on a person's body; the head, torso, both arms, and both legs. The person being manipulated gains the ability to not only use their own techniques, but the skills of the puppeteer as well. The origins of this technique lie on the battlefield. When a puppeteer's puppets were all destroyed, they would begin using corpses. To perform this technique with a living person would normally require both parties to cooperate with each other. However, a highly skilled user can control the target by force if the person is severely weakened or damaged, rendering them unable to resist. In Gaara Hiden: A Sandstorm Mirage, Kankurō was able to combine this technique with his knowledge of the chakra pathway system to develop the ability to use the chakra threads to disrupt his victim's flow of chakra, thus hindering their ability to use techniques and causing them extreme pain.

name: Puppet: Iron Sand Prison Mass
description: Sasori uses the Third Kazekage puppet to release a spike of Iron Sand at the opponent that then drills them into some rocks. He then makes a huge cube of iron sand to fall on the opponent, crushing them.

name: Puppet Technique: Bishamon
description: While inside his puppet Hiruko, Sasori sends the puppet's iron tail towards the opponent, hitting them repeatedly and causing them to fall to the ground. Finally he stabs them in the torso with a powerful thrust of the tail.

name: Puppet: Dance of the Cherry Blossom
description: Chiyo uses chakra threads to control Sakura and dozens of kunai at the same time. Sakura runs at the opponent and Chiyo launches the kunai behind her, using Sakura to hide them from the opponent's view. At the last second, Sakura is pulled back by the threads, the opponent taking the shower of kunai. Then, Sakura jumps up high and comes down at the opponent preparing a chakra-enhanced punch, Chiyo adding extra momentum by pulling her down with the strings. Finally, Sakura punches the opponent creating a gigantic crater.

name: Puppet: Degeneration
description: Kankurō sends his puppet, Crow, rapidly dashing toward the opponent. Crow's six hands then project spikes and stab the opponent, sending them crashing to the ground. Crow then slams them with the spikes when they are on the ground.

name: Puppet: Spewing Bullet
description: Kankurō detaches the head of his puppet, Karasu, just as the opponent is approaching. Its head then projects a spike from its mouth, stabbing the opponent.

name: Puppet: Inexhaustible Explosive Blades
description: Karasu's four arms open and shoot a barrage of kunai with explosive tags attached, which home in on the opponent and explode on impact.

name: Puppet: Revolving Blade Heavenly Drill
description: Kankurō has Karasu sprout many poison-covered blades on his arms and mouth and sends them spinning towards the opponent like a tornado, slashing them several times. After launching the opponent into the air, Karasu explodes near them. Karasu is unharmed by this explosion.

name: Puppet Curse
description: Hiruko uses this technique to take control of people. It can be activated long after the technique is first applied. The appearance is a red eye with another circle in it resembling the pupil, with four lines stemming from the upper line of the eye and two big thick lines stemming from the side of the eye. This power seems to control the minds of others as it appeared on Kakashi Hatake's forehead, vanished, then took control over his body. The eyes of the person who get caught by this technique turn red while they are being controlled. The technique works in a manner similar to controlling a puppet; using hand motions to guide the target to its destination.

name: Raging Snakes
description: Orochimaru, in his true form, attacks the opponent with a multitude of white snakes from his own body and finishes the opponent with a slash from his Sword of Kusanagi that came out of his mouth.

name: Puppet Technique: Prosthetic Arm Senbon
description: While inside of his puppet Hiruko, Sasori fires the puppet's torpedo-shaped left arm towards the enemy. The arm rotates at high speed, launching the wooden cylinders attached to it. The cylinders then open, each one releasing a large amount of senbon, creating a quick rain of poisoned needles in all directions.

name: Puppet Water Release: Dance of Mystic Rain
description: The puppeteer wraps the enemy with chakra strings in an effort to bind and restrict their movements, and then has their puppets spew water onto the opponent. This technique was especially effective on Gaara as it prevented him from manipulating his sand which was soaked in water.

name: Quicksand Waterfall Flow: Poison
description: Gaara performs Quicksand Waterfall Flow with Kankurō coating the sand wave with poison.

name: Rapid Fire
description: Kusune uses Tsurukame to fire massive amounts of thick senbon.

name: Puppet Performance: One in Body and Soul
description: Chiyo uses the Mother and Father puppets to attack the opponent with a flurry of attacks.

name: Puppet: Early Summer Rain
description: Kankurō uses Karasu and Kuroari to shower the opponent with bombs.

name: Pure Land of Paradise
description: Tsunade punches the ground, creating a shockwave that launches her opponent in mid-air. Then using her chakra enhanced strength, she punches the falling opponent in the gut with such force that it sends them flying up into the sky.

name: Puppet Technique: Heavy Blade Warehouse
description: While inside his puppet Hiruko, Sasori summons two large torpedo-shaped containers. When opened, the two containers release thousands of kunai that pierce into the target's body. Then, another set of kunai are loaded into the wooden cylinders attached to the containers. When opened, a full load of kunai with multiple explosive tags attached to each are shot to the ground near the target. They then detonate, causing a large explosion.

name: Puppet: Rotation Attack
description: This is a technique used by Mukade while in his Ultimate Form. By taking advantage of his puppet body, Mukade extends additional blades and spikes on his centipede-segmented body. He then spins his own body at every joint, creating powerful gusts of wind and inflicting massive area damage to his vicinity.

name: Puppet: Spring Punishing Strike
description: Using her Puppet Performance: Skilful Achievement with a Human Body, Chiyo launches Sakura high into the air to deliver a chakra-enhanced punch. It was powerful enough to destroy Sasori's ultimate defence, Hiruko.

name: Quaking Leg
description: Sakura concentrates chakra into her foot and then stomps down on the opponent with tremendous force. A follow-up kick can be used directly after the stomp.

name: Puppet: Burning Blade
description: After using Karasu and Kuroari to strike the opponent, Kankurō then proceeds to use his Sanshōuo puppet to launch a burning attack towards the opponent causing massive damage.

name: Pulverisation
description: Jūgo grows many jet-like appendages to propel himself towards his opponent, and lands a series of punches and swipes.

name: Rabbit Hair Needle
description: The Rabbit Hair Needle is a Kekkei Mōra taijutsu used by Kaguya Ōtsutsuki. Kaguya hardens her lengthened hair to launch many needles with enough ferocity to pierce even Sasuke's Susanoo. By using her Byakugan, she targets the vital points of her enemy. It's a technique that effectively seals the movements of an enemy.

name: Puppet-Cursing Sphere
description: Toneri moulds his chakra into the form of a green-coloured sphere. The sphere can be used for various purposes such as controlling targets by entering their body, rendering a target unconscious, absorbing chakra from a distance, and detonating if needed.

name: Puppet Reincarnation
description: As a last resort, Toneri summons countless Byakugan from the disintegrated Energy Vessel and infuses them into himself. The Byakugan seemingly grants him immense power, which he claimed to be capable of bringing about the end of the world. However, the true power of this technique is never shown as he was exposed to sunlight, affecting the chakra in the Byakugan and surpassing his chakra capacity limit, making the technique highly unstable and impossible to control. The sunlight also caused the technique to go berserk and mutate the user into an unstable white mass with a large mouth protruding from the back, which would lead to Toneri either melting or exploding.

name: Puppet Imitation Technique
description: After taking a sample of the target's hair with the use of a puppet, the user forms a specific hand seal, and takes control of the target.

name: Rampaging Barrage
description: In his initial jinchūriki form, Naruto delivers a series of punches to the opponent and finishes with a kick.

name: Puppet: Corpse Crow
description: Kankurō has Karasu tackle the opponent, breaking its own body apart in the process. Kankurō then uses the puppet parts to deliver a series of swift strikes to the opponent, after which Karasu picks the target's body up and carries them through the air, with the finishing blow being a strong slam into the ground.

name: Puppet: Demon Castle Mask
description: Kankurō has Karasu deliver a few swift slashes to the opponent, after which Kuroari opens itself up, dropping a bunch of explosives onto the opponent. Kankurō proceeds to take cover within Sanshōuo as the grenades detonate.

name: Puppet: Father and Mother
description: The Mother and Father puppets join hands, extending a razor wire that Chiyo uses to initiate a flurry of deadly attacks. The wire is strong enough to slice cleanly through the Third Kazekage puppet's Thousand Hands technique.

name: Puppet: Shadow Actor
description: Kankurō attacks his opponent using close-range taijutsu, then, as his face begins to crack, Kankurō is revealed to be Kuroari in disguise, and the real Kankurō is controlling the puppet from within the cloth on his back. Kankurō then uses Kuroari to capture the opponent.

name: Puppet White Attack
description: While under the control of Kaguya, Hamura kicks his opponent into the air then activates his Byakugan and leaps after them, unleashing a rapid barrage of punches and then a single powerful strike with his right hand, knocking them back to the ground.

name: Quarantine Wall
description: Using his shield as a medium, Renga creates a massive chakra barrier. It is strong enough to withstand a bomb detonation.

name: Rasengan: "Unison"
description: While activating their respective Kāma, one person channels their energy into the other, greatly increasing the size and explosive power of the Rasengan.

name: Rasengan: "Ensemble"
description: Naruto, in his Six Paths Sage Mode and Kawaki utilising his Scientific Ninja Tool alterations, attack the opponent and finish them by attacking from both sides with a Rasengan and a chakra blast from Kawaki's Kāma.

name: Rasengan: "Uzuhiko"
description: Rasengan: "Uzuhiko" is a unique Rasengan variant developed by Boruto Uzumaki that harnesses the user's own chakra along with what Boruto calls planetary chakra—energy generated by the centrifugal force that works alongside the planet’s rotation and orbit—to infuse the attack with theoretically unlimited power. As noted by Jura, the principles of how this technique functions is similar to the Tailed Beast Ball. In order to prepare this technique the user must maintain contact with the ground, ensuring that they can directly take in planetary chakra through both feet. The power and effects of the attack on the target depend upon how much planetary chakra the user gathers, and are therefore proportional to the amount of time spent accumulating it. As the user absorbs this planetary chakra it visibly coils around their limbs and torso, and can be passed into the bodies of others by simply touching them. This can result in mild disorientation for those affected, making it more difficult to effectively move and attack. In order to complete the technique the user strikes the enemy with their palm, typically aiming for their chest or stomach, and forcibly infuses the planetary chakra into their body. At maximum output, "Uzuhiko" is capable of killing the target with a single blow, erupting into a swirling vortex of chakra that forcefully blows away and tears apart their body, effectively disintegrating them. At lower output levels, it deals damage similar to a standard Rasengan, along with the planetary chakra rushing through the target's body continuously inflicting internal damage and leaving the enemy in a perpetual state of vertigo, destroying their sense of balance and diminishing their motor skills. As these effects persist semi-permanently, ending only if the user rescinds "Uzuhiko" or the planet itself stops spinning, it causes not only physical harm but immeasurable psychological damage, making it an effective tool for interrogation and coercion. For this technique to be initiated, the user must have both feet firmly planted on the ground. Also, one who can use the Tailed Beast Ball can utilize the similar principles as a countermeasure to nullify the effects of this technique.

name: Puppet Technique: Sword
description: Using a puppet in the form of himself, Araya makes it fight quickly and effectively with a long sword.

name: Puppet Technique: Spear
description: Using a puppet in the form of himself, Araya makes it fight quickly and effectively with a long spear, easily inflicting injuries even on an opponent with the Sharingan.

name: Puppet Technique: Combo Attack
description: Using a puppet in the form of himself, Araya makes it fight quickly and effectively with a long sword (or spear) from different sides, after which he himself jumps into the air with a sword, and together with the puppet they fall on the enemy, piercing him.

name: Raging Pounce
description: Hana attacks her opponent with rapid strikes, slicing them with her sharp claws. A more powerful version of this technique allows Hana to summon the Three Haimaru Brothers, who fall upon the opponent from above, pinning them to the ground before tearing them with their fangs.

name: Prepared Needle Shot
description: Shizune wears a device on her forearm that's loaded with five senbon. While contained within the device, the senbon are immersed in a poison potent enough to leave victims near-death from a mere scratch. The device is fired by pulling an attached string, which quickly shoots the five senbon at any target Shizune aims at. Because of how the device is configured, the senbon cannot be fired individually. However, by channeling her chakra into the string, Shizune can alter the trajectory of the senbon, either to concentrate them on one point, spread them over a larger area, or even change the direction of the senbon from what the device is aimed at. Shizune generally uses this as a surprise attack, as the device is hidden by her sleeve, is not bulky enough to be noticed, and furthermore she does not give the impression of being able to fight, thus lowering an opponent's guard.

name: Peregrine Falcon Drop
description: The user grabs a falling opponent by their waist, wraps their legs around their upper body, and drives them head first into the ground, similar to the Front Lotus.

name: Protecting Eight Trigrams Sixty-Four Palms
description: Created by Hinata, this is a highly versatile technique which affords both offensive and defensive capabilities whereby she emits a constant stream of chakra from her palms, which are formed into extremely thin, sharp, blades. While using this technique offensively, Hinata shapes the chakra into thin, sharp, flexible blades allowing her to hit hundreds of targets with extreme precision and can cut smaller targets, like bees, into pieces. When used defensively, Hinata creates much larger, stronger, more flexible, arc-shaped chakra blades that spread out across her entire attack range, effectively forming a barricade between herself and her opponents, rebuffing even the largest and smallest of targets. With the addition of Hinata's flexibility, the technique creates an "absolute defence" effect similar to that of the Eight Trigrams Palms Revolving Heaven, though the cutting nature of the chakra prevents any outside force from restricting it.

name: Prison Sand Burial
description: Using his chakra, Gaara breaks open the earth and uses his sand to pull a target up to two hundred metres underground; targets are dragged down so quickly that they cannot escape it. Because of the depth that they're buried at, targets are rendered unable to move even a finger. Gaara then applies additional pressure to them with the sand, crushing them to death. Tō no Sho likens this technique to the larva pits of antlions.

name: Poison Mist Hell: Hundred Continuous Firing
description: Using his Puppet Technique, Kankurō spins Karasu and Kuroari around his target at high speed. Karasu launches poison gas bombs at the opponent, surrounding them with a gas cloud. Then both puppets fire a barrage of senbon from their arms at the now blinded victim.

name: Poison Mist
description: This technique combines ninjutsu, chemistry, and medical knowledge, thus requiring fine chakra control and advanced ability in medical ninjutsu. The user converts chakra in their body into a special chemical that they then exhale from their mouth. When the chemical comes into contact with the air, it becomes a cloud of poison. Breathing in even a small amount of the poison will cause immediate death. The Poison Mist used by Ibuse differs from that used by Shizune. Rather than kill those that inhale it, Ibuse's causes victims to become paralysed after only a few seconds, allowing Hanzō to attack them at his leisure with his kusarigama. Ibuse must first generate and store the poison within his body for five minutes before he can use it.

name: Petal Diversion: Chakra Rope
description: Ino rushes forward to the opponent and disappears in a curtain of purple petals. She appears behind the opponent and concentrates her chakra into a rope of petals, then hits the opponent with a powerful punch.

name: Petal Diversion: Flower Fireworks
description: Ino runs forward to the opponent and then disappears in a curtain of purple petals. She appears behind the opponent and concentrates chakra into a rope of petals, then kicks the opponent and throws a kunai attached to an explosive tag at them.

name: Psycho Mind Transmission
description: The user enters the target's subconscious by placing a hand on the target's head and extracts any information needed, even if the target has forgotten it or has had it blocked. A special device can be used to decrease the time it takes to read the target's mind and allows other ninja to assist. Memories that have mental blocks on them will require longer periods of time to probe through and obtain however. Depending on the skill of the user and their level of experience, they will be able to go through days worth of the target's memories in a matter of moments and sift through until they find what they want while others may have to go through each memory in its entirety.

name: Plasma Ball
description: is a technique utilised by Ranke by drawing energy from the Stone of Gelel. By converting the Gelel energy into electricity, Ranke can create a plasma barrier around her to serve as a defence which protects her from incoming attacks. The shield can be used offensively, by discharging the electricity in the direction of her choice in a wave. While Ranke is in her transformed state, the Plasma Ball is strong enough to defend her from something as wide-ranged as the Quicksand Waterfall Flow, and she can rush at her opponents even if the barrier is active. However, if her electricity is drained, she cannot form the barrier and will be left vulnerable.

name: Poison Moth Genjutsu
description: Fuen first uses poison that is thin and tiny enough to be taken in the air. Her target will inhale the poison and start to see the things that Fuen chooses, like caves, moths, or allies of the target trying to kill the target. When her target is imprisoned in her genjutsu, Fuen charges and kills her target.

name: Prepared Puppet: Eight Waves of Needles
description: Sasori, while inside of his puppet Hiruko, makes the puppet spit a rapid stream of countless senbon from its mouth, in a fashion similar to a machine gun. These senbon can be poisoned for increased lethality.

name: Preta Path
description: The grants the user the ability to absorb chakra in any form. Pain channelled the Preta Path through the corpse of a Kusagakure shinobi. This ability is primarily defensive in nature as it is capable of absorbing chakra from an individual through physical contact. In addition to this, the Preta Path is able to absorb ninjutsu-based techniques that are pure chakra or chakra based, thereby nullifying their effect. It doesn't absorb physical attacks, like Gaara's sand, but does drain the sand's chakra. This is done by forming a barrier around the user's entire body, allowing them to absorb attacks from all directions. Although the ability is able to absorb senjutsu chakra, the user is still vulnerable to the effects of turning into a stone statue from absorbing too much of it. During the Fourth Shinobi World War, Nagato used the Preta Path to absorb Killer B's chakra while he was in his Version 2 form. He then apparently used the chakra to revitalise his body to its state before it was emaciated by the Demonic Statue of the Outer Path. It also restored his hair colour back from white to red, as well as the damage done to his legs. However, presumably due to loss of muscle memory, he was not able to use the legs completely. This ability can be nullified if an opponent uses specific techniques that can either suppress the user’s movements or their chakra. In Buddhism, the Preta realm (also known as the Hungry Ghost realm) is a reincarnation based on strong possessiveness and desire which were cultivated in a previous life or lives. The Preta are humanoid creatures which are perpetually hungry and thirsty, but are unable to satisfy themselves, living lives similar to those of hopeless addicts trying to appease their unyielding hunger. In appearance, the Preta are deathly pale, emaciated figures, which contrasts with Pain's Preta Path's hefty stature. In Hinduism Preta could also mean ghosts this also relates to the technique the Preta path uses.

name: Piercing Showers
description: Komachi throws multitudinous needles at the opponent, causing major damage.

name: Pressure Points of Harm and Death
description: Guren releases two tenketsu points to greatly increase her chakra and physical capabilities for a short time by changing her life force into chakra. This allows the use of taxing techniques such as Crystal Release: String of Glory. The amount of chakra released is so much that it becomes visible and causes water to form a vortex around her, similar to the one caused by opening the "Sixth Gate of Joy" from the Eight Gates. Her eyes also turn completely white momentarily.

name: Protective Sphere of Light
description: This is a technique in which Shion's bell illuminates and negates any negative occurence. It was powerful enough to protect Shion from Mōryō's darkness.

name: Piston Fist
description: While using his Sage Transformation ability, Jūgo can alter his arm into a piston to increase his attack power. To increase it even more, Jūgo can form jets on his hands or elbows.

name: Piston Fist: Style One
description: The user uses their transformation to grow jet booster-like arms that increases his attacking and throwing power. This is a more powerful version of Piston Fist, with the combination of the Jet Booster Jump.

name: Projection Technique
description: This technique enables the user to make a hologram of themselves in order to send a message.

name: Power of the Sage
description: Jiraiya uses his Wild Lion's Mane Technique to extend his hair, then swings it 360 degrees to slam the opponent and send them flying into the air. He then uses the Fire Release: Fire Dragon Flame Bullet on the opponent and slams his Rasengan onto them, absorbing the fire chakra and forms into the Fire Release: Great Flame Rasengan with a white orb inside instead of black. The Rasengan is released from Jiraiya's hand, and instead of an explosion of fire, when the opponent hits the ground like the Great Flame Rasengan, a small cyclone composed of flame appears and after disappearing for a few seconds, rain made of fire falls to the ground at a dramatic speed.

name: Power of the Hokage
description: Tsunade enters Sannin Mode and punches her enemy's abdomen (warning them to brace themselves) with such might that in slow motion it appears as though he or she will be snapped in two. They're pushed backwards at tremendous speed, however, razing through a field of trees until they're finally stopped by a large boulder, which causes Tsunade's opponent to take even more damage. Shortly afterwards, a volcano erupts in the background as a result of the punch's power, dyeing the battlefield crimson. Tsunade, straightening herself up, is left wondering whether she perhaps went too far.

name: Protecting Eight Trigrams One Hundred Twenty-Eight Palms
description: This is the upgraded version of the Protecting Eight Trigrams Sixty-Four Palms. This technique sends out an outward burst of the chakra dome created.

name: Perfume Spray
description: Karin sprays a massive amount of pink perfume that does low to medium damage while poisoning the opponent in the process. Besides poisoning the opponent, it can also lower her opponent's speed and defence. While in Awakening Mode, it also acts as a guard breaker.

name: Petal-Dancing Flower Garden
description: Ino skates towards her opponent with chakra on her feet and purple flowers surrounding her. She then knees them into the air, jumps after them, and twirls gracefully before delivering a powerful, chakra-enhanced kick.

name: Poison Cloud
description: Sasori while inside Hiruko swirls around spraying a green poison cloud around himself affecting nearby opponents.

name: Poison Missile
description: Hiruko slams the opponent with his tail and fires a poison missile at them. If the missile itself does not kill the opponent then the poison most likely will.

name: Piston Fist: Style Zero
description: Jūgo punches the opponent and then rushes up to them to deliver a more powerful punch.

name: Planetary Rasengan
description: Naruto Uzumaki — while in Nine-Tails Chakra Mode — creates a Big Ball Rasengan in one of his hands, which is then surrounded by three regular-sized Rasengan, in a similar manner to moons around a planet. When coming into contact with a target, the disordered rotations of the individual Rasengan, created by the central and smaller ones spinning in different directions, interact with each other to form a massive and turbulent wave-like vortex. The strength of this technique is so great that it even took a shinobi reincarnated by the Impure World Reincarnation technique a significant amount of time to regenerate, which they normally do instantly. In Naruto x Boruto: Ultimate Ninja Storm Connections, this technique is considered an enhanced version of the Spiralling Strife Spheres.

name: Piercing Burning Emotions
description: Lee unlocks several chakra gates, and then charges into the opponent, lifting them upwards into the sky like a rocket. After reaching a certain distance, Lee crashes back into the ground.

name: Poison Mist Needle Shot
description: Shizune first uses her Poison Mist on her opponent and then attacks with her chakra scalpels a few times. Finally, she jumps in the air and throws senbon at her opponent.

name: Protective Cloth Dome
description: Maki uses her cloth for defensive means by wrapping it around her and any nearby allies, she can form a protective barrier. The cloth can be made around a nearby object such as a rock, to better hold down the fortification. If the cloth is made wet by a Water Release technique, it allows the dome to defend against powerful heat-based attacks.

name: Poison Cloud Technique
description: Torune puts his hands together to form a small poisonous smokescreen sphere from his rinkaichū between his hands, Torune can then blow the smokescreen across the area in front of him, the poisonous smokescreen when spread gets bigger. If touched or inhaled, it is a guaranteed fatality.

name: Piercing Separation Spring
description: Transformed as Isobu, Yagura pounds the ground, causing water to spring up at his opponent, throwing them up in the air.

name: Piercing Stab
description: Mifune slashes at his opponent a few times, kicks them away, and them stabs them down with a reverse grip of his sword.

name: Pinching Rage: Rasengan
description: Naruto charges at his opponent, swiftly generating two shadow clones. The clones efficiently craft Rasengan, and with precision timing, the original Naruto propels his opponent towards the clones. This sets the stage for a simultaneous Rasengan assault from both directions, culminating in a decisive finish as the opponent gets caught between Naruto and his clone's Rasengan.

name: Power Bomb
description: The user jumps up into the air, lands a couple powerful physical attacks, grabs there opponent, and powerbombs them.

name: Pressurisation
description: Jūgo grows his hand to great proportions and swats at his opponent.

name: Possession
description: Possession is a unique ability possessed by Black Zetsu allows it to take advantage of its malleable body to coat itself over a target. This technique is mainly used to restrict the movement of the target by coating a target's body, and forcibly make them do its bidding by directly channelling its will through them. In possession of the target's body, Black Zetsu is also able to use target's techniques, kekkei genkai, as well as any other ability they may possess. By using this technique, Black Zetsu can perform various feats including controlling the target, and even stabilising their life force allowing them to live following a mortally-taxing event. Once in contact with a target, they can also absorb the target's chakra and transfer it to others, and even show the target events it has recorded. One drawback of this technique, is that if the target has a strong enough will as in the case of Obito they can suppress Black Zetsu's influence, and take advantage of Black Zetsu being attached to them.

name: Problem Children of the Academy
users: Iruka Umino~~with~Konohamaru Sarutobi and Naruto Uzumaki
Konohamaru Sarutobi~~with~Iruka Umino and Naruto Uzumaki
Naruto Uzumaki~~with~Iruka Umino and Konohamaru Sarutobi
description: Naruto, Konohamaru, and Iruka throw their fūma shuriken at the opponent. Then Naruto and Konohamaru perform their Sexy Technique, sending Iruka flying towards the opponent, knocking them out of the sky. Afterwards, Iruka hits both Naruto and Konohamaru in the head.

name: Prison Gate Palm Bottom
description: A delivers a series of palm strikes to the opponent, with the last one sending the opponent into the air.

name: Polarised Sand Formation: Hot Sand Camouflage
description: The user infuses chakra by placing both hands on the ground, making sand particles polarise which is able to bend light, they erupt in the direction of the users comrades, covering them and rendering them invisible and much harder to detect, save by a sensor. This technique appears to require ample time to perform for the build-up of chakra.

name: Pheasant Hunter
description: The user creates a giant flamed pheasant that they direct at a target. In Boruto: Naruto the Movie, the pheasant merely grapples with Naruto Uzumaki's Tailed Beast Mode until it is torn apart by Naruto. In the Boruto anime, it explodes on impact with its target, doing extensive damage to the surroundings.

name: Poison Senbon
description: The user jumps up and throws the some amount poisoned senbon into the opponent with a swing.

name: Prison Flame Funeral
description: Sasuke slashes his opponent with both an electrified sword and a black flame sword, before using Amaterasu.

name: Pink Lightning
description: The user creates high-impact lightning with a pink hue from their hands. Tsukiyo was able to launch bolts of this pink lightning from his fingertips, powerful enough to shatter rock. A single precise blast to the head apparently will cause instant death. It can also be channelled through other techniques, allowing for even greater versatility.

name: Prisoner Cursed Seal
description: The user applies a red seal on the prisoner's neck, should they be granted limited movement outside prison. The user can instantly activate the seal to kill the prisoner should they disobey orders. Also, if they are a certain distance away from the user or the user is killed, the seal will automatically kill the branded. If close enough and facing it, the user can remove it with a Seal of Confrontation.

name: Poisonous Claw
description: User rushes at the enemy and attacks with poison-lubricated Metal Gauntlets, leaving a trail of poisonous claws.

name: Piercing Funeral Foot
description: Isshiki uses his immense strength to deliver a fast and powerful dropkick to the opponent, strong enough to knock a Susanoo user out of their avatar.

name: Piercing Cloud Spear
description: Chiriku powers up the spear with golden chakra, similar to that emitted by Welcoming Approach: Thousand-Armed Murder, and then delivers a slash, first from top to bottom, then from bottom to top, and finally leaps into the air, where she throws the spear with great force, impaling the opponent.

name: Parasitic Destruction Insect Technique
description: Shortly after a member of the Aburame clan is born, thousands of insects are allowed to colonise his or her body. In exchange for getting to feed off of their host's chakra, the insects follow the host's every command: from attack to defence to reconnaissance, and everything in between. The insects inevitably become the core ability of the Aburame's entire fighting style, upon which all of their other jutsu rely. This technique, alternatively translated as "Kikaichū Technique", is named after the kikaichū, the species of insects that Aburame are most commonly colonised by. But they are not the only option: Torune uses rinkaichū and Yōji used kochū. Aburame are not even restricted to a single species: Shino uses both kikaichū and kidaichū; Muta uses kikaichū and shōkaichū.

name: Passing Fang
description: The user moves at a target at high speeds and delivers a body slam. Because of how quickly they move, the user travels in a fairly straight line, necessitating that they anticipate the target's movements in order to ensure a successful strike. As they move at the target, the user spins rapidly in order to pierce targets, drilling even through stone. Unlike the Fang Passing Fang, this technique is performed alone; users therefore require additional training to raise its attack power enough to compensate for this.

name: Parasitic Destruction Insects: Spear
description: Shino's kikaichū combine into two spear-like forms that spiral towards the enemy and carries them into the air, where they brutally feast upon their chakra.

name: Partial Multi-Size Technique
description: This is a more practical application of the Multi-Size Technique. Rather than increase the size of their entire body, the user increases the size of only specific body parts, typically the arms and legs. Because of the larger size, physical attacks made with the expanded limbs do greater damage than normal. The limbs' growth is very fast, giving users a way of taking opponents by surprise. In the anime, the expanded mass can also be used a powerful defense from blunt-force assaults, cushioning the impact to negate it. As with other techniques of the Akimichi clan, its chakra requirements are quite high, to the point that, in Part I, Chōji takes one of the Three Coloured Pills before using this technique.

name: Parasitic Destruction Insects: Eclipse
description: Shino manipulates his kikaichū to form a giant pillar that collapses into a wave that engulfs the opponent. The bugs then turn into a whirlpool that drag the opponent below ground before spouting out as a pillar that implodes.

name: Partial Super Multi-Size Technique
description: Chōji uses the Super Multi-Size Technique only in one part of his body, similar to the Partial Multi-Size Technique.

name: Parasitic Destruction Insects: Hollow
description: Shino manipulates the kikaichū to form a large airborne cloud that descends on the opponent. After the insects are on the ground surrounding the opponent, the insects swarm upon them, and quickly erupt into an explosion of insects.

name: Paper Shuriken
description: A technique that consists of using chakra to harden and shape paper into shuriken. The user can increase the power of the shuriken by further altering its final shape. Konan could fold the paper shuriken into different shapes, including the normal four-pointed star shape and a more kunai-like shape. By combining it with Nagato's Wind Release: Gale Palm, the duo were able to increase their lethality.

name: Parasitic Destruction Insects: Hail
description: Shino releases hundreds of thousands of kikaichū from his body into the air. On his command, the insects attack the opponent in five waves. They then coalesce into a large cloud and rain down on the opponent, and then the insects form a giant meteor-like insect sphere crashing down on the opponent.

name: Parasitic Destruction Insects: Whirl
description: Shino uses his kikaichū to form a funnel that traps the opponent, spins them around violently, and then throws them away.

name: Outer Path
description: The is one of the seven abilities of the Six Paths Technique granted to the wielder of the Rinnegan, standing out from the other six Paths. It grants the user the power to control and transcend life and death. With this power, the user is able to revive the dead, transmit their chakra into black receivers, and manifest chakra chains. One who wields the Rinnegan is said to exist outside the realm of life and death. They are regarded as the seventh Pain, the Outer Path, and wield the power to control life and death itself. With this power, the user is able to revive the dead through the Samsara of Heavenly Life Technique, though doing so comes at the cost of the user's life. The Rinnegan allows for the creation of black receivers, and by transmitting their chakra into these receivers, the user can bind anyone they touch through the power of the Outer Path. The user can also manifest the chakra chains of the Demonic Statue of the Outer Path to restrain those who touch the receivers with an even greater binding power. By implanting black receivers into corpses or reincarnated individuals, the user can reanimate and remotely control the bodies as the Six Paths of Pain. These bodies, as well as the King of Hell and the creatures summoned through the Animal Path, all have reflections of the Rinnegan in their eyes and share visual information with the user through the Outer Path. During the Fourth Shinobi World War, Hagoromo Ōtsutsuki demonstrated the ability to recall the souls of the previous Kage from the Pure Land to assist him in summoning Team 7 and the tailed beasts back from Kaguya Ōtsutsuki's core dimension. When summoned in this manner, the deceased person does not have an actual body, but appears as a mass of flickering chakra in full possession of their personality and memories. Once the user ends the technique, the summoned souls dwindle and ultimately disappear completely. Hagoromo was also able to undo another person's use of the Impure World Reincarnation technique, releasing the reincarnated souls from their vessels and sending them to the Pure Land.

name: Parasitic Destruction Insect Fang
description: Kiba uses his Passing Fang to send the opponent flying, then Shino uses his Insect Pillar to send the opponent flying and Akamaru uses the Beast Human Clone to become Kiba and finish with the Fang Passing Fang.

name: Paper Clone
description: A technique which employs the use of Konan's ability to manipulate the shape and colour of her paper by forming it into one or more replicas of herself. When a clone is hit, it will merely turn back into sheets of paper. If need be, Konan can conceal explosive tags within her paper clones to allow for a deadly surprise attack.

name: Parasitic Destruction Insects: Round Mass
description: This technique is a larger and more powerful version of the Floating Bugs technique.

name: Parasitic Destruction Insects: Bind
description: Shino creates a cloud of kikaichū that lifts the opponent into the air. Then, many spheres of them repeatedly strike the opponent before sending them crashing to the ground.

name: Pampas
description: Kimimaro uses his bone sword to strike the opponent with amazing speed at different vital areas of their body. This attack can be used repeatedly in succession to not give the opponent a chance to attack back.

name: Parasite Demon Demolition Technique
classification: Kekkei Genkai~Sakon and Ukon's Kekkei Genkai
description: Ukon can only perform this technique after activating his cursed seal's second level. Using his chakra, he disassembles his body on a cellular and proteinic level so that he can enter a target's body. He then starts reforming himself, taking over certain parts of their body and gradually corroding the parts he hasn't entered yet. Ultimately, the target dies, achieving this technique's primary purpose: assassination. Ukon had previously been very successful in this regard, as the only way that victims could stop him would be by attacking their own bodies, something that none were willing to do. Kiba Inuzuka, however, experiences no such unwillingness; he badly injures himself, doing the same damage to Ukon, and in trying to kill himself drives Ukon from his body so that Ukon will not suffer the same fate.

name: Outer Path — Samsara of Heavenly Life Technique
description: The Outer Path — Samsara of Heavenly Life Technique is a reincarnation ninjutsu used through the Outer Path, which can infuse new life into the bodies of the dead in exchange for the user's own life by reuniting the separated soul to the body using . When this technique is activated, the King of Hell emerges from the ground and releases the souls of the deceased from its mouth. These souls may be recalled from even the crossroad between life and the afterlife, and are then returned to their rejuvenated bodies. The exact limitations of this technique are unknown, but on one occasion, it was able to resurrect a large number of individuals who had recently died. While using this technique, the caster is severely weakened; for instance, Nagato's hair turned white as a result of overexerting his power. Ultimately, once the technique is finished, the user invariably dies. This technique can also be used to transform the corpse vessel of an individual revived by Summoning: Impure World Reincarnation into a real body of living flesh and blood. However, whereas the rest of the reincarnated Madara Uchiha's body was made real, his eyes instead crumbled into dust upon his resurrection. This method does not require the King of Hell to appear. The revived individuals are seemingly revived with a fully restored chakra level, as Kakashi did not require hospitalization to recover after revival, and was able to carry Naruto after he nearly passes out after his fight with Pain.

name: Peerless Great Wind Formation
description: While in his Level 2 Cursed Seal form, Sasuke kicks upward to launch the opponent into the air. He then glides after them and performs another flipping kick to slam the opponent into the ground, then finishes up with a Chidori.

name: Pair of Maidens
description: Kankurō summons Kuroari to sneak up behind the opponent, pinning their arms. Kankurō then uses a mouth-bomb wielding Karasu that rushes toward the opponent, causing the bomb to explode.

name: Parasitic Destruction Insects: Pupa
description: Shino uses his kikaichū to form a tornado that traps the opponent. He then walks into the tornado and sends another cluster to crush the opponent.

name: Parasite Clone
description: The Parasite Clone technique is one utilised by Akatsuki's White Zetsu. This technique allows White Zetsu to biologically produce clones of himself, of which he is able to communicate and control remotely. Being his perfect duplicates, they resemble him closely, aside from pants, sandals, and his flytrap like appendage. Unlike normal clones, they don't dispel when they are dealt damage or killed. Even if the original user is killed, they will not dispel. They can also be used with White Zetsu's Substitute Technique to assume the form of any individual that he has touched, even copying their unique chakra and items. The independent, living nature of the clones is further exemplified by the fact that they can be used as sacrifices for the Impure World Reincarnation.

name: Peacock Whirlwind
description: Utilising the Takumi Village special Weaknessless Soaring Shortswords, the user swings one of the blades to create a powerful whirling gust of wind.

name: Peacock Whirlwind Formation
description: This is a technique utilising the Takumi Village special Weaknessless Soaring Shortswords, to create a vortex to push away materials covering the user's body. Seimei used it to free himself of Gaara's sand.

name: Paper Person of God Technique
description: Konan disguises six hundred billion explosive tags as the surrounding scenery, be it earth or water, with enough sophistication that even the Sharingan cannot see through it. When the target is in position, Konan causes the scenery to split in half, resulting in the rapid creation of a huge abyss beneath the target. Due to the sudden lack of any available foothold, the target inevitably descends ever deeper into the depths of the chasm. As the target falls, Konan guides the explosive tags to stick to their body and detonate, with six hundred billion being enough for ten minutes of consecutive explosions — more than enough to counter the five minute time limit on Obito Uchiha's intangibility.

name: Palm Bottom
description: This attack consists of a quick, precise thrust of the user's palm to the opponent's body. The attack sends chakra into the area of the foe where struck to either stun them, or if a more sufficient amount of chakra is used, cause severe internal damage.

name: Pachinko Technique
description: By using the Chakra Liquid that bound their hands together, Naruto and Sasuke stretch the sticky substance, and launch a golden statue at the target like a slingshot with enough force to knock them out.

name: Peacock Wisdom Queen
description: After forming the neccessary hand seals and reciting an incantation, On Mayura Girante Sowaka, Mukade absorbs the seal placed by the Fourth Hokage, allowing him to time travel. Those caught in the blast are also sent through time. Specifically, Mukade travelled back twenty years, six years before the seal was placed, though Naruto Uzumaki and Yamato arrived six years later.

name: Peerless Great Flame Bullet
description: Sasuke headbutts his opponent, and jumps over them, kicking them in the head. He then kicks them up in the air, punches them back on the ground, and finishes with a Fire Release technique.

name: Parasitic Bugs
description: Shino manipulates his kikaichū to swarm around the opponent and absorb their chakra and then providing the stolen chakra to Shino, allowing him to replenish his own.

name: Partial Multi-Size Leg Technique
description: The user expands their leg and sends the opponent flying with a kick.

name: Paper Chakram
description: Konan gathers a large quantity of paper sheets into a single chakram-like shape, which she then throws at the intended target. While in flight, the disc spins with tremendous speed, with its trajectory and inclination being freely manipulated by her. This presents opportunities to attack an enemy from all angles, even if the disc is initially avoided. The discs spins so fast that a collision between the two result in a considerable impact.

name: Peony Snow
description: Kurenai attacks her opponent first by lowering her stance and then spinning into the opponent to deal a knee strike, followed with a kick that pushes the opponent backwards, where she then grabs the opponent, lifting them into the air. She finally delivers a barrage of several kicks to their stomache, kicking them into the ground.

name: Pacification of the Grounds
description: Jūgo hits the enemy at extreme speeds while part of his body is transformed.

name: Parasitic Giant Insect — Bug Bite
description: Following an Aburame clan member placing a number of kidaichū onto the skin of an enemy, these insects immediately burrow into the victim's body and begin to devour its flesh and chakra. This process causes the insects to grow rapidly in size, until the host body is completely eaten away from the inside out.

name: Parasitic Destruction Insects: Arrowhead Swarm
description: Shino reveals several kikaichū behind his opponent, which begin to wrap around them. At the same time, Shino sends more insects in a spiralling pattern. All the insects swarm at the opponent, damaging them, and then dispersing.

name: Parachute
description: Naruto punches his opponent into the air, creates two to four shadow clones that jump in the air as well, before jumping himself. The clones hold his opponent down as they fall, with Naruto landing on them knee-first.

name: Overwhelm: Rasengan
description: Naruto delivers a string of punches and kicks using shadow clones. The penultimate of these attacks are enhanced with natural energy, which stuns his opponent. Naruto then jumps at his opponent and kicks them down, bouncing off them, going up high, and comes crashing down with a Rasengan.

name: Palm Wave
description: Shizune attacks her opponent a few times, then spins around with her arm outstretched to hit them with a chakra scalpel. She finishes by hitting her opponent high into the air with another chakra scalpel.

name: Peerless Hurricane Formation
description: Sasuke kicks the opponent. He then dashes behind and punches the opponent from behind. He then jumps into the air and performs an axe kick. He then rushes behind the opponent again and sweeps off their feet, upward flip kicking the opponent as he does. He then jumps once more, this time behind the opponent, and punches them into the ground face-first. Finally, falls with a heel drop on his foe akin to the Lion Combo.

name: Parent and Child Rasengan
users: Naruto Uzumaki~~with~Minato Namikaze or Boruto Uzumaki
description: The Parent and Child Rasengan is cooperation ninjutsu where two shinobi — a parent and a child as the name suggests — combine their Rasengan to create a massive one. Naruto and Minato, while both in Tailed Beast Mode, and Naruto in Sage Mode as well, collaboratively create a Rasengan of their chakra avatar's size, then ram it into the target. This attack was strong enough to push back Obito Uchiha as the Ten-Tails' jinchūriki. Boruto starts off by generating a tiny Rasengan. Clasping Boruto's hand, Naruto then adds his own chakra to the Rasengan, forming a gargantuan sphere, which dwarfs both of them in size. Boruto used this technique to kill Momoshiki Ōtsutsuki, on top of obliterating his Rinnegan-enhanced Rasengan and Tailed Beast Ball, as well as a God Tree.

name: Past Vision Sharing
description: This technique allows the user to share their past and experiences with a Byakugan user. The user will expel a glowing bubble from their mouth that releases blinding violet rays, which reacts to the person's Byakugan to project images into their mind. However, only those who are worthy are capable of seeing the vision while those from outside the determined targeted area are incapable of doing so. After the vision is transferred, the sphere can be retracted to the user.

name: Paralysing Flute Genjutsu
description: An illusion that relies on the sound of the flute. After the user plays a melody though the flute, whoever hears it will become paralysed as if their bodies became heavier.

name: Pair's Kamui
description: Kakashi and Obito use Kamui to transport the opponent inside their pocket dimension, where they strike their target with a series of cooperative taijutsu attacks. After gaining enough distance, Obito creates a Black Receiver, through which Kakashi channels his Lightning Cutter. Obito launches the receiver, electrocuting and piercing them, both with the thrown receiver and the new ones which branch from it upon impact.

name: Overwind Raid
description: Using his Kote, Boruto sends a Wind Release-infused shuriken at his opponent, pushing them back. Boruto then uses a Kote Water Release technique to flood the place, holding the opponent in place, and while surfing on the waves, sends a Vanishing Rasengan through the water, pushing the opponent up when it hits.

name: Paper Drizzle
description: After creating wings out of her paper, Konan uses them to launch a multitude of paper in rapid succession at the target. In the anime, this attack was strong enough to overpower Jiraiya's Fire Release: Flame Bullet technique.

name: Owl Drop
description: Obito jumps up in the air, attacks his opponent with three kunai slashes and kicks them down.

name: Paralyzing Chakra Field
description: The user strikes the ground with his fist and releases a large amount of chakra, creating a pulsating field that paralyzes anyone it hits.

name: Parasite Technique
description: The user spits out parasites at a target, which will burrow inside them. This allows the user to kill the target, inflict great pain, or take control over their movements. It is possible to resist it, though quite painful, and is preferable to remove the parasite before it burrows completely.

name: Owl Guardian Pursuit
description: Motoi summons Fukuemon and gives him commands mentally, and owl attacks the enemy with rapid strikes from his wings and beak.

name: Ninja Art: Profusion of Flowers
description: Ino casts an illusion that tricks the enemy, causing them to see a storm of flowers. This technique has different variations ranging from a field of flowing petals to an overflow of petals surrounding the enemy. With a clear shot, she throws the poisonous wolfsbane flower at the enemy hitting them in the head.

name: One Thousand Years of Death
description: The user tightly clasps their hands together and extends their middle and index fingers, resembling the Tiger hand seal. Using the full weight of their body, the user thrusts these four fingers between the target's buttocks. Despite the technique's dramatic name, it is not actually harmful. The pain is fairly extreme, however, so much so that, when Kakashi Hatake uses it on Naruto Uzumaki, Naruto comically leaps into the air, travelling a fair distance. Sakura Haruno blushes to see it used and Sasuke Uchiha declares both Kakashi and Naruto "buffoons". The anime shows those who are familiar with One Thousand Years of Death are very unwilling to be subjected to it. It has no effect on unconscious targets. Naruto later uses this technique against Gaara. Instead of his fingers, Naruto uses a kunai with an exploding tag attached. Unlike previous responses to the technique, Pakkun calls Naruto's attack "brilliant".

name: Ninja Art: Shuriken Giant Body Technique
description: The user throws a fūma shuriken towards the opponent and uses their chakra to massively enlarge it, brutally striking the opponent and sending them flying.

name: Outcry of Earth
description: Sakura summons a giant Inner Sakura to deliver a series of punches.

name: Orochimaru's Juinjutsu
description: Orochimaru's Juinjutsu is a transformation-based cursed seal that Orochimaru can apply to others for various purposes. By studying Jūgo's body, Orochimaru discovered that it has an innate ability to passively absorb natural energy. It also secretes special bodily fluids that react to contact with senjutsu chakra, causing immediate physical alternations with further controlled shape-shifting quality to the user's body, along with greatly enhanced physical capabilities. By isolating an enzyme from Jūgo's special fluids and mixing it with his own senjutsu chakra, Orochimaru created a cursed seal he could brand others with. Orochimaru typically gives his cursed seals to either his more powerful followers or those he would like to use as his host body. To apply a cursed seal, Orochimaru bites the recipient's neck, causing the seal to appear near the puncture wound. Recipients are rendered unconscious while their body either accepts or rejects the cursed seal. From extensive practice, Orochimaru established a 10% compatibility rate for the cursed seal; those whose bodies aren't compatible with the cursed seal will die. If they do survive, the recipient will have access to the cursed seal's power boosts, access that grows through repeated use. If unused, cursed seals will grow dormant, though Orochimaru can forcefully activate them if he gains access to them. Cursed seals seen in the anime tend to have fatal consequences even if the recipients survive the initial application. Mizuki's seal, which was a failed prototype that required extra procedures to activate, nearly kills him due to its incompleteness and causes him to lose all his powers. The cursed seals administrated to Team Guren kill them if they do not take the required medication periodically, preventing them from escaping Orochimaru's clutches. On the other hand, the seals given to the Iburi clan partially stabilised their otherwise unstable ability. Once applied, removal of the cursed seal is apparently difficult. Kakashi Hatake and the Third Hokage have on separate occasions opted to suppress the cursed seals rather than remove them outright. The only times the cursed seal have been fully removed have been as a side-effect of removing Orochimaru's consciousness from the recipient's body, fragments of which are embedded in each of the cursed seals: Itachi Uchiha does so with the Sword of Totsuka; Sasuke Uchiha does so with the Evil Releasing Method. So long as part of his consciousness remains in a cursed seal somewhere, Orochimaru can never truly die. When they first receive the cursed seal, recipients cannot control their access to it, and as such they draw on its power unwillingly. Until they become accustomed to it, use of the cursed seal will cause them intense physical pain, though they may be able to briefly ignore this. While active, the cursed seal feeds off their chakra and replaces it with Orochimaru's own senjutsu chakra, increasing their chakra levels ten-times and making their jutsu stronger. So long as they have at least some chakra of their own, this gives them a back up reserve that they can call on, though if not employed carefully this may have fatal consequences. Prolonged use of the cursed seal corrodes the mind, making them more susceptible to Orochimaru's influence. In exchange, the cursed seal synchronises with their body, exponentially enhancing the abilities of their normal state. Recipients initially only have access to the cursed seal's . When active, the seal's design spreads across at least half of their body from its point of application, glowing and replicating as its coverage grows. The degree to which this occurs is up to the user, and the degree to which it spreads is proportionate to the overall effect it has. In order to increase the advantages of using the cursed seal, as well as to eliminate some of the risks and discomfort that come from using its first level, Orochimaru developed Mind Awakening Pills to advance cursed seals to their next stage. Under normal circumstances, the pills kill those who take them, requiring that they be placed in a near-death state after taking the pill while their body acclimates for the heightened transformation.
