description: Nurari is able to manipulate the strange liquid from his special suit. He is able to contort his body in various ways and even summon extra limbs. Nurari is able to shed layers of his suit, making him immune to techniques like Parasitic Destruction Insect Technique and also seems to be able to manipulate the liquid's viscosity and stickiness. He can extract this liquid in the form of projectiles to throw at his opponents in order to trap them, incapacitate them, or to pin them down. He can also form the membrane into barriers in order to nullify incoming projectile attacks.

name: Water Prison Shark Dance Technique
description: After using the Water Release: Great Exploding Water Colliding Wave, Kisame forms the water into a gigantic prison. Because he acts as the centre of the dome of water, the dome alters its position in order to reflect the direction of his movements, making it difficult for his target to escape as long as he continues his pursuit. Fusing with Samehada provides Kisame a tremendous advantage. This fused form grants him the ability to breathe underwater while his target continues to drown as they attempt to futilely escape the large body of water. This technique is extremely effective in one on one fights, but the user would probably not be able to contain two enemies fleeing in opposite directions.

name: Unknown Ability
description: Tobi teleports behind the opponent and prepares to throw a bomb, only to accidentally drop it at his feet. As he quickly makes a run for it, the bomb detonates, creating a huge explosion.

name: Unsealing Technique: Segmented Iron Dome
description: Tenten summons a large segmented iron dome from one of her scrolls to shield herself or allies from incoming attacks. The dome resembles the shell of an armadillo.

name: Water Release: A Thousand Feeding Sharks
description: A much more powerful version of the Water Release: Five Feeding Sharks, where the user creates one thousand sharks out of water that replicates a giant wave to swarm down and attack the opponent.

name: Water Release Genjutsu: Demonic Phantom Fog Prison
description: After Kandachi performs the necessary hand seals, the Conch King opens its shell and releases a mist that puts the opponent under a genjutsu. In the genjutsu, the Conch King licks the opponent until they're frozen, which results in the opponent being overcome with fear and going into a mental breakdown in a matter of time. The power of the genjutsu was greatly increased by the magnetic forces of the trees surrounding the swamp they were in.

name: Violent Stabbing Face Slap
description: Karin charges and slaps her opponent with a explosive tag. The force of the slap knocks the opponent across the field, and the explosive tag detonates after the opponent hits the ground.

name: Vacuum Sword
description: The user swings their sword and a gust of wind is released in the arc that it was swung in. The technique is strong enough to stop projectiles that are thrown at the user.

name: Violent Heavenly Earth Needle
description: After using the Earth Release: Earth Flow Wave technique to shape and form the earth, the user creates a large needle out of it to impale the opponent.

name: Unstoppable Blade Shuriken
description: The user throws the Kubikiribōchō at the opponent like a shuriken.

name: Violent Headspinner
description: Karin gets up close to her opponent and does a combo of violent slaps.

name: Water Gun Technique
description: The Water Gun Technique is a technique used by the Hōzuki clan. The user makes a finger gun with their hand and, through the Hydrification Technique, compresses a drop of water in their index finger, firing it with tremendous force and speed similar to a gunshot — enough to easily pierce through a sand clone.

name: Violent Whirlwind
description: The user produces a powerful stream of wind from their mouth. This technique was powerful enough to dispel several shadow clones in an instant.

name: Violent — Leaf Adamantine-Strength Whirlwind
description: Guy deals a severe roundhouse kick to his opponent after entering his Eight Gates state.

name: Uzumaki Sealing Technique
description: After forming the necessary hand seals, the user slams their hand on the ground after which a sealing formula, that originates from the user's hand, forming underneath the target. When the seal activates, anything above the inscription is sealed within the formula itself.

name: Water Palm Blade
description: Tobirama attacks the opponent with a combination of taijutsu and Water Release. He begins with a simple punch followed by three kicks and then lifting the opponent into the air where with his mastery of the Water Release, Tobirama materialises from his palm, a blade of water that he uses to blast the opponent through the air.

name: Water Pillar Thrust
description: Tobirama uses his mastery of the Water Release to materialise a small body of water to rise up beneath the opponent and thrusting them into the air.

name: Water Release: Azure Dragon Palm
description: Ao dashes towards his opponent pushing his hands forward and when his hands come in contact with them, he unleashes a spiralling torrent of water.

name: Very Hiden: Venomous Insect Venom
description: Torune lands a series of hits on the opponent, poisoning them with his rinkaichū.

name: Watchful Eye's Torrent
description: Kakuzu uses his Earth Grudge Fear to lift his opponent into the air with his threads. He then use his masks to attack the opponent with a triple elemental blast of lightning, fire and wind.

name: Water Release: Archerfish
description: The user simply creates a jet of water that can be used to extinguish fire.

name: Water Clone Combo
description: Attacking the opponent with a series of punches and kicks to force them backwards, Tobirama then creates a small pool of water from which a clone of himself emerges. The clone, alongside Tobirama then buffets the target with a series of more kicks and punches before delivering a final kick and the clone then dissipates back into water.

name: Water Balloon Technique
description: Gengetsu creates a puddle of water mixed with oil, which he uses to produce bubbles that float up into the air. On his command, the bubbles launch themselves toward Gengetsu's enemy with such speed and force, they can cause great blunt-force trauma upon bursting.

name: Water Gun: Two Guns
description: A more lethal version of the Water Gun Technique, where, instead of using one hand, the user uses both hands and fires two powerful shots of water simultaneously as if dual-wielding. This technique was powerful enough to destroy part of Tobi's face.

name: Water Gun Technique: Two-Handed Magnum
description: Gengetsu creates a barrage of water bullets and sends them at the opponent. Then he forms one big water bullet and shoots the opponent with it.

name: Water Gun Technique: One-Hand Magnum
description: Gengetsu jumps and creates a few water bullets, shooting the opponent with them in quick succession.

name: Water Gun: Quick Shot
description: Gengetsu jumps up in midair and fires several water bullets at his opponent.

name: Watch Your Steps!
description: Kushina creates a barrier seal on the ground. If the opponent steps on the barrier seal, two frying pans appear in the sky and fall on the opponent, knocking them unconscious.

name: Water Droplet Reflection Sight
description: By dilating her pupils, Yome is able to track down enemies via the reflection on tiny water droplets. According to Sen, once Yome has fixated her sight, her visual range reaches several dozen kilometres. Yome can also use this ability to augment her evasion-skills during combat. Downsides of this technique are the evaporation of water droplets caused by the sun, which complicates the usage of the technique and shortens its period of time and her sensitivity towards blinding light, for example caused by a flash bomb.

name: Unsealing Technique: Paper Snowstorm
description: Using a piece of paper with a sealing formula on it, the user generates thousands of tiny pieces of paper to engulf the target, robbing them of their sight and enabling the user to hide in their presence.

name: Unsealing Technique: Shuriken
description: Using the sealing formula contained on a sheet of paper or a scroll, the user summons multiple shuriken from it, which are launched directly at the target.

name: Vanishing Rasengan
description: The Vanishing Rasengan is a Lightning Release version of the Rasengan, that was created by Boruto Uzumaki, and named by Sasuke Uchiha. After creating a small Rasengan, Boruto subconsciously adds Lightning Release to it, before throwing it. As it glides, the nature transformation abruptly kicks in, resulting in the technique disappearing from sight. This adds an element of surprise to the attack, as an opponent may lower their guard, assuming that the technique has dispersed, only to find themselves struck by the invisible attack. The size of Boruto's Vanishing Rasengan has seen a significant increase after the Mujina Bandits Arc, where it was shown to be around the size of a regular Rasengan. With enough chakra added to it, the Rasengan can become giant. In the anime, Kakashi Hatake notes that the invisible nature comes by a loss in offensive power, rendering this technique as incomplete. Momoshiki Ōtsutsuki himself later noted that it is too weak to cause a mortal wound, but is quite painful when it strikes a vital point. At the time of the Mujina Bandits Arc, it was noted that the regular Rasengan emphasised strength in comparison, for Boruto, when he had learned both, with it being his strongest technique at the time.

name: Water Release Bullet: Orca
description: The user sends a huge surge of water crashing down onto the enemy, which restricts their movements, given the intensity and pressure of the waves produced.

name: Water Characters
description: This technique allows one to send messages through water. By throwing water on a surface, even a vertical one, the water will rearrange itself into a readable message, which will fade after a while.

name: Water Release: Angry Bitter Rain
description: After water has been shot into the air, such as with the Water Release: Water Bullet Technique, this jutsu turns the water black. When the black water falls on a target it clings to their body and covers their eyes, blocking their vision. Because of the name ("doku" meaning "poison"), victims are intended to believe the water is poisonous. In truth the water is harmless, and the name is only meant to distract victims long enough for the user to follow up with another attack and/or escape.

name: Water Prison Bead Binding Technique
description: After thrusting their palm out, the user creates a large bubble in front of them, which then disperse into smaller Water Prison Technique traps when targets are near enough to it.

name: Water Flow Sensing Technique
description: The user is able to create a stream of water that enables them to sense the surroundings of the flow of water. The technique presumably causes great strain to the user, as prolonged usage caused sweating and a bloody nose.

name: Uzumaki Twin Striking Palms
users: Boruto Uzumaki~~with~Naruto Uzumaki and Hinata Hyūga
Naruto Uzumaki~~with~Hinata Hyūga and Boruto Uzumaki
Hinata Hyūga~~with~Boruto Uzumaki and Naruto Uzumaki
description: Boruto, Naruto, and Hinata charge at their opponent. Boruto accidentally drops his Extreme: Shinobi Picture Scrolls cards, rushing to recover a specific card, while Naruto helps him. Hinata spots a Santa version of her card by the opponent, and embarrassed by it, pushes her husband and son towards them with the Gentle Fist to keep them from seeing it. She is still embarrassed when Naruto recovers the card.

name: Vanishing Many Spiralling Serial Spheres
description: Boruto creates four shadow clones that form Vanishing Rasengans that are thrown at the opponent.

name: Vanishing Rasengan: Waxing and Waning
description: The user forms a medium sized Vanishing Rasengan and fires it at the opponent, vanishing and then reappearing upon hit. Targets close to it will be drawn into the jutsu. Charging it further will increase its size, damage, and drawing radius.

name: Violent Arm
description: The user enlarges their fist and stretches their arm out, swinging in a punch.

name: Veteran Taijutsu
description: When in front of the opponent, Chiyo kicks them and finishes with a spinning upward kick.

name: Water Mirror Colliding Bullets
description: Hagoromo forms a mirror of water, which breaks up into small projectiles of water that are shot at the opponent.

name: Twin Snakes Mutual Death Technique
description: This technique was taught to Anko Mitarashi by Orochimaru. The user grabs one of their intended victim's hands and forces it to assist in performing the necessary hand seals. Once this is done, the user and the victim die, which Rin no Sho likens to a lovers' double-suicide. It's not actually clear how death occurs because the technique has never been seen performed successfully: when Anko uses it on Orochimaru, she stabs his hand to hers to prevent him from escaping as she performs the hand seals. When she realises he's merely a shadow clone, the technique is aborted. Naruto: One Decade, One Hundred Ninja illustrates this technique as two snakes coiling around Anko and Orochimaru.

name: Typhoon Water Vortex Technique
description: This cooperation ninjutsu uses the wild rotation of the thrown Wind Release: Rasengan to swallow up the water current created by the Water Release: Tearing Torrent, creating a large quantity of water vapour. Once invoked, a strong wind whirls around inside the highly concentrated mist, turning it into a solid barrier. The mist created by the violent rotation of the Rasengan also has the effect of taking away the enemy's field of vision. Of course, the mist can be used as a smokescreen when escaping, but the confusion it creates can also be used, for instance, to launch a surprise attack. If one can use multiple natures, it is possible to perform this technique alone.

name: Ultimately Hard Absolute Defence: Shield of Shukaku
description: Using his chakra, Gaara gathers the densest minerals in the soil, compresses their size, and then mixes them together. The resulting sand is formed into a protective shield in front of Gaara, shaped to resemble a miniature Shukaku, the . The Shukaku shield, because of how meticulously it's constructed, is incredibly strong, to the point that not even the Dance of the Clematis: Flower can penetrate it.

name: Ultimately Hard Absolute Attack: Spear of Shukaku
description: The Spear of Shukaku is the attack counterpart of the Shield of Shukaku. Like the shield, Gaara crushes the hardest materials from the ground using sand, this time in the form of a halberd, in the shape of the Shukaku's hand. Just like the shield which has yet to find anything that could break its defence, the halberd has yet to find a defence that it can't break through.

name: Ultra-Big Ball Rasengan
description: The Ultra-Big Ball Rasengan is a more powerful version of the Big Ball Rasengan. In an instant, the user creates a Rasengan of gigantic proportions. When it impacts, there is a large shock wave unleashed that can send unsuspecting shinobi flying. As with many Rasengan variants, Naruto needs the help of a shadow clone in the Ultra-Big Ball Rasengan's formation. By the time he's Hokage, Naruto can perform this technique with one hand and even pass it on to Boruto Uzumaki to use. This jutsu is so chakra-intense that it was capable of overwhelming Delta's shinobi-ware's formidable chakra absorption capabilities. When in Sage Mode, the user can perform a senjutsu-enhanced version known as . It is said that its destructive power – were it to explode – would easily carve away an entire mountain. Fittingly, upon its first successful use it blasted through a God Tree and kilometres of mountainside before bursting in the upper atmosphere, killing an empowered Momoshiki Ōtsutsuki.

name: Two Calm Kusanagi
description: Sasuke first hits the opponent into the air. Orochimaru spits his Kusanagi to Sasuke, and it slashes the opponent on the way. Sasuke grabs the Kusanagi with his free hand and jumps towards the opponent, slicing them repeatedly with his and Orochimaru's swords.

name: Ultimately Hard Absolute Attack: Sand Waterfall Spear Interment
description: Gaara claps his hands together, causing a giant mound of sand to rise up from below the opponent, trapping and restraining every part of their body except for the head. He then summons a large amount of sand in the form of Ultimately Hard Absolute Attack: Spear of Shukaku, which he then sends towards the giant mound of sand at intense speed, aimed at the opponent. Due to the size of the spear, it rips the enemy apart, killing them and causing the mound to explode.

name: Twinkling Maiden's Heart
description: Sakura smiles at her opponent before glaring and summoning her giant inner self. Inner Sakura yells "I'm speaking from the heart!" as she punches her opponent. The screen shatters, revealing it all to have been a genjutsu and Sakura herself punched her opponent. The foe flies off into the distance. Sakura smiles and says "You should be nice to girls."

name: Twin Swift Rasengan
description: Firstly, Jiraiya performs a single Rasengan, deforming the ground. After a moment, while the first one is still in contact with the opponent, he creates a larger Rasengan and combines both of them. Due to the massive power, the slightly deformed ground gets destroyed.

name: Ultimate Art (game)
description: While riding his C2 Dragon, Deidara creates a clay clone and the clone strikes down on the opponent from the sky, Deidara sets off the clone causing a huge explosion.

name: Ultra-Many Spiralling Serial Spheres
description: After creating a multitude of shadow clones, Naruto and his clones each create a Rasengan to bombard their target with devastating effects.

name: Ultra-Fast Regeneration Technique
description: The user gathers a large quantity of chakra to rapidly regenerate any damage done to the body. Mukade utilises this technique with his unlimited resource of Ryūmyaku chakra, repairing any and all damage done to his puppet body, and resealing his ultimate form's weak point should it be exposed, allowing him to recover from fatal wounds and severe chakra drainage. So long as he has enough chakra, he is near immortal.

name: Ultimate Reverse Lotus
description: This technique is almost identical to True Reverse Lotus, but Guy slams the opponent down and then tosses them into the air, instead of just kicking them into the air. The light beams are also larger and the punch used at the end is much more intense.

name: Ultimate Summoning Beast's Genjutsu
description: This genjutsu, which is emitted from the beast's eyes, sends rainbow-coloured rays to the targets which immobilises them.

name: Two-Tails Exploding Orbs
description: Matatabi creates large orbs of flame-like chakra, similar to the flame covering its body. It then manipulates these orbs in order to chase the enemy before they explode. Enemies hit by the explosions of one of these orbs will have their offensive capabilities lowered for a time. This has only been shown used by a false Two-Tails.

name: Uchiha Flame Formation
description: After manifesting small chakra flames on each finger of one hand, the user then slams their palm on the ground, resulting in the creation of a cylindrical barrier of flames enveloping a location of their choosing. Should the enemy come into contact with the barrier's exterior, they will be quickly set ablaze. This powerful barrier uses the ground as catalyst to keep burning while using only a small amount of chakra. The flames are powerful enough to deflect a punch from the Eight-Tails.

name: Uchiha Return
description: By utilising the Gunbai Uchiwa to block an incoming attack, the user nullifies the effects of the attack by converting the incoming chakra into Wind nature transformation, which is then reflected. As this reflection of an attack occurs both suddenly and unexpectedly, the reflected attack can prove difficult for opponents to evade.

name: Twin Swallow Cut
description: Tenten repeatedly hits her opponent with a pair of tonfa, then strikes them into the air with a three-section staff which she separates to deliver a final blow to the falling opponent.

name: Ultra-Viscous Slime Battering Ram
description: Hiruko used strange viscous liquid in his surrounding during the eclipse immortality ritual. He's able to manipulate the viscosity of the liquid, so he can control it. The movement of the liquid is similar to a metal spring. These chunks of liquid can hit an enemy with enough force to temporarily knock them out.

name: Ultimate Poison Scattering
description: While transformed as Saiken, Utakata releases poisonous gas around himself, poisoning any opponent in close proximity.

name: Uchiha Style: Dance of the Sun Halo
description: Shisui coats his tantō in fire and with a quick gesture unleashes a wave of flame towards the opponent.

name: Unite
description: Mecha-Naruto attaches his mechanical body to Naruto, who wears him as sort of a mechanised suit. Doing this gives the wearer added strength and a few added abilities.

name: Ultimate Death Beyond Terror
description: After riding on one of Kakuzu's masked beasts towards the enemy, Hidan slashes the opponent with his scythe and curses them with his Curse Technique: Death Controlling Possessed Blood. Kakuzu then uses Fire Release: Intelligent Hard Work, Lightning Release: False Darkness and Wind Release: Pressure Damage on Hidan, creating a great explosion. Because of Hidan's curse, the opponent takes the same damage as he did.

name: Uchiha Shuriken Formation: Spring Lightning
description: Sarada attacks her opponent with a Fire Release: Phoenix Sage Fire Technique. She jumps out of the smoke, and with her Sharingan, she throws out several shuriken, which ricochet from one another, hitting her target. She finishes them off with a Thunderclap Drill.

name: Typhoon Release: Consecutive Bursting Strong Winds
description: A Typhoon Release technique used by Nowaki through his kekkei genkai. After forming the necessary hand seals, he releases a storming vortex that can be used to simply limit his enemy's field of vision or do massive damage to his surroundings, mowing down anything around him. With effort he can increase the scale and intensity of the storm, being capable of covering an entire island.

name: Typhoon Release: Great Consecutive Bursting Extreme Winds
description: Nowaki summons a massive tornado, intense enough to not only dwarf Sasuke Uchiha's Complete Body — Susanoo, but to also be capable of forcing it to the defensive. Despite its power, the technique has an exploitable flaw. The user is left defenseless at the eye of the storm. Should the enemy reach it, they can easily counter with a surprise attack.

name: Uncontrollable Power
description: After entering his initial jinchūriki form, Naruto creates a giant claw out of Kurama's chakra, and slashes the opponent. Afterwards, he enters his Version 2 state.

name: Twinsword Technique: Crushing Hammer
description: Chōjūrō unleashes his Hiramekarei, forming a hammer, with which he attacks his opponent.

name: Twinsword Technique: Cut to Pieces
description: Chōjūrō unleashes his Hiramekarei, forming a long-sword, with which he slices his opponent.

name: Uchiha Style Shurikenjutsu: "Lightning": Triple
description: The user throws three shuriken, infused with Lightning Release chakra, at the opponent. The addition of lightning-natured chakra increases the lethality and cutting power of the weapons.

name: Uchiha Blaze Sword: Fire Possession
description: The user breathes a fireball and then slices through the opponent with their sword.

name: Uchiha Style Shurikenjutsu: Hazy Wheel
description: Shisui plants a closed Fūma Shuriken into the ground, connected to him by a string. When he pulls on it, the shuriken flies back to him while spinning, fanned out and hitting any opponents on the way back.

name: Umbrella Shock Wave
description: After swinging his umbrella, Aoi produces a torrent of water large enough to attack a group of targets. The pressure generated is strong enough to ground his target and crack stone.

name: Uchiha Shurikenjutsu: Spring Storm
description: Sarada jumps high and throws an explosive tag laden Fūma Shuriken at her opponents, while also throwing healing seal laden kunai at her allies.

name: Uchiha Cherry Blossom Thunderclap
users: Sarada Uchiha~~with~Sasuke Uchiha and Sakura Haruno
Sasuke Uchiha~~with~Sakura Haruno and Sarada Uchiha
Sakura Haruno~~with~Sarada Uchiha and Sasuke Uchiha
description: Sasuke manifests his Complete Body Susanoo, striking the opponent with its sword, which launches several portions of the floor in the air. Sakura jumps between these floor portions to close the distance with the target, punching them back towards the ground. Sarada finishes it by landing a Chidori.

name: Twisted Truth-Seeking
description: The user gathers their Truth-Seeking Balls to shape them into a drill to drill the opponent.

name: Uchiha Imprisonment Sealing
description: During the Warring States Period, the Uchiha clan would place seal tags surrounding where they are imprisoning their captives. If the prisoners were to touch the bars in their prison, they would catch fire. Any attempts at using ninjutsu would drain the prisoner's chakra.

name: Ukon's Mad Dance
description: Ukon separates from Sakon, kicking the opponent and then finishing them by slicing them with his claws.

name: Typhoon Rotating
description: The user gathers wind to create a large tornado that swirls towards the opponent. The user can also form the tornado beneath the opponent.

name: Typhoon Impact
description: Asura expels a gust of slashing wind that swirls towards the opponent.

name: Uchiha Family: Trinity Technique
users: Sakura Haruno~~with~Sasuke Uchiha and Sarada Uchiha
Sasuke Uchiha~~with~Sakura Haruno and Sarada Uchiha
Sarada Uchiha~~with~Sakura Haruno and Sasuke Uchiha
description: Sasuke and Sarada expel two fireballs, following with Sakura jumping down on the opponent with a powerful punch.

name: Uchiha Style: Dance of the Sun Halo – Flame Formation
description: Itachi slashes the opponent with his sword coated in flames, following with putting them under a genjutsu where they are hit with flame twisters.

name: Typhoon Flame Formation
description: Hagoromo surrounds himself in raging winds, which he promptly ignites.

name: Uchiha Style Kenjutsu
description: The is a unique style of kenjutsu developed and mastered by Sasuke Uchiha, who passed on the skill to his student Boruto. This style of kenjutsu utilises moves similar to Japanese iai, where the enemy is slashed at the same moment the user draws their sword from its sheath. Lightning Release chakra can also be used to coat the blade and increase its sharpness.

name: Two Rays of Light Among the Clouds
description: Ginkaku and Kinkaku stand on the front and back sides of the opponent, the former starting by releasing a fire ball with Bashōsen, following with the latter using the suction of Benihisago to kick the opponent and then finishing them by raising the opponent with earth through Bashōsen and channeling electricity through Shichiseiken, releasing an electric surge by slamming down on them.

name: Ultra-Big Ball Rasengan: Heaven Destruction
description: While possessing Boruto's body, Momoshiki creates three shadow clones to fire Spiralling Bullets at the opponent. The clones then pin them down while Momoshiki creates a large Rasengan to slam down on them.

name: Uchiha Style Blade Technique: Hagoromo
description: By continuously flowing chakra into it, this technique increases the blade's sharpness and durability, preventing it from chipping. At the same time, it is a delicate technique, requiring constant focus to keep active.

name: Two Lights Beams of Kumogakure
description: Entering the first stage of the Jinchūriki form, Kinkaku and Ginkaku deliver several powerful blows to the enemy with increased strength and speed, after which they begin to spin like tops and, pinning the enemy from both sides, destroy them.

name: Uchiha Style: Four Directions Slash
description: Shisui powers up his tantō with Fire Release and, using the Body Flicker Technique, attacks the enemy from four sides, burning them with a fiery blade.

name: Two-Tailed Cat Flame Incineration Slash
description: Matatabi begins to build up a Tailed Beast Ball while Yugito attacks the enemy with quick slashes from her long claws, after which the Tailed Beast Ball hits the enemy, and in the finale, Yugito, having coated her sword in Matatabi's blue chakra, delivers a double strike, leaving a trail of chakra behind.

name: Tsukuyomi
description: Tsukuyomi is a Mangekyō Sharingan dōjutsu and one of the most powerful genjutsu in existence. Said to represent the , it is the antipode to Amaterasu. After making eye contact with a target, Itachi Uchiha traps them in an illusion of his design. Through his unprecedented ability to alter targets' perception of time, he uses Tsukuyomi to subject victims to days' worth of torture in a matter of seconds; examples include continual stabbing or reliving traumatic events over and over. Tsukuyomi's illusions are usually represented as an inverted grey scale; in the anime, there is usually also a red moon in a red sky. Because of the power of the Mangekyō Sharingan and the speed with which Tsukuyomi works, normal methods of countering genjutsu are ineffective against it. Using Tsukuyomi requires a great deal of chakra, making it inadvisable for Itachi to continue fighting after using it. Like all Mangekyō Sharingan abilities, Tsukuyomi also places strain on Itachi's eyes when performed, blurring his vision. However, victims of Tsukuyomi have it far worse, as they are ordinarily rendered comatose as soon as Tsukuyomi's illusion is completed. Sharingan users can briefly resist unconsciousness, but only particularly skilled Sharingan users can actually break free of Tsukuyomi's influence. Tsunade is the only person known to be capable of healing the psychological damage caused by Tsukuyomi. In Akatsuki Hiden, Itachi theorises that love can be used to revive victims, his reasoning being that, since Tsukuyomi destroys the spirit, feelings that reconnect the spirit can undo Tsukuyomi; Kodaka does indeed do this in order to resuscitate his younger brother, Kiiro. According to Itachi Shinden: Book of Dark Night, "the time that passed within this genjutsu was one one-hundredth of one one-thousandth of one one-millionth of that of the real world." In the novel, Itachi uses Tsukuyomi on Izumi Uchiha, causing her to live through decades of a happy life in the span of a few moments. When she dies of old age within the illusion, her actual body dies as well. is the kami of the moon in ancient Japanese myth and the Shintō religion. He is one of the "three noble children" (alongside the sun goddess Amaterasu and the sea and storm god Susanoo) born when Izanagi cleansed himself of defilement after escaping from the underworld, with Tsukuyomi born when Izanagi washed out his right eye. According to the Nihon Shoki, Amaterasu's wrath over Tsukuyomi's killing of the goddess of food led to the sun goddess refusing to ever look at Tsukuyomi's face again, forever moving to another part of the sky while Tsukuyomi's fear of his sister's wrath makes him hide during the day (hence explaining why day and night are separate). According to some modern interpretations, Tsukuyomi is thought of as a god of time, or at least of the calendar; the basis for this is the interpretation of "moon reading" as reading the movements of the moon, an act paired with reading the calender(=day), and the verb being used in the Man'yōshū and other books to refer to counting the days of the month. This connection may be referenced by Itachi's ability to manipulate a victim's sense of time within Tsukuyomi's dreamscape.

name: Transformation Technique
description: The Transformation Technique allows the user to take the appearance of whatever they choose. This technique is most often used to disguise the user as another person, but they can also turn into an animal, plant, or inanimate object; according to Sasuke Retsuden, inanimate objects are the most difficult to transform into, and users are shown familiarising themselves with an object's weight and feel before assuming its form. Users will gain the attributes and physical features of whatever they transform into, such as a weapon's sharpness or an animal's fangs. To be able to assume so many different forms makes this technique invaluable for not just combat, but intelligence gathering and diversionary tactics as well. In Sasuke Shinden, some transformations are shown to take some getting used to, such as if the assumed form has a different height than the user or if the assumed form wears clothes that the user isn't accustomed to. Being able to use the Transformation Technique does not necessarily mean one can use it well. Ideally, the user's transformation should be indistinguishable from the original, so that if they were placed together they could not be told apart. Inexperienced users, particularly Academy students, will often have obvious discrepancies in their transformations, making them useless for deception. Even practised users, though their transformations may lack any serious flaws, can overlook small details of whoever they're impersonating (such as minor scrapes or blemishes), thus enabling careful observers to expose them as impostors. Even if a transformation is a perfect likeness, users can still inadvertently reveal themselves if they don't act the same way as their subject. Users can also be identified as fakes if their scent is wrong. When a transformed user has been found out and attacked, they ordinarily allow the transformation to dispel. Some users may maintain the transformation in a final attempt to keep their cover, only dispelling the transformation once this effort fails. Still other users may, when they seem to be dispelling the transformation, actually take another transformation altogether, confusing opponents as to their true identity. Seemingly the only way to reliably find out if somebody is using the Transformation Technique is to knock them unconscious, which will cause the transformation to dissolve. Tsunade uses the Transformation Technique to constantly appear several decades younger, keeping it active regardless of where she is or what she's doing. She only reverts to her original form when she no longer has the chakra to maintain her transformation. In the anime, Kagerō also keeps her Transformation Technique active for long periods of time, taking the form of a buck-toothed, hunchbacked man. In Akatsuki Hiden, the citizens of Shangri-la use the Transformation Technique at all times in a concerted effort to make new lives for themselves; their transformations only dispel when they die.

name: True Eight Trigrams Sixty-Four Palms
description: Neji leaps forward and strikes the opponent several times in the back before dashing in front of them. He strikes several more times until using an Eight Trigrams Palms Revolving Heaven-like strike to launch the opponent into the air. There, Neji strikes the opponent before several more times hitting them once more at light speed, blasting them into the air in a beam of chakra.

name: Towards the Setting Sun
description: Lee opens several chakra gates and dives into the opponent. He carries them through several mountains before focusing his remaining chakra to brutally drive them through a valley wall.

name: True Rasengan
description: An enhanced version of the Rasengan, where the user draws more power that lasts for a longer period of time. The Rasengan increases in size to a bigger larger version. When used, the user slowly moves around the area dealing damage to any target in his path. In addition, it absorbs chakra from the user.

name: Turning into a Frog Technique
description: By touching the forehead of a target and then, according to a mental image the user forms, the target changes into a tree frog. This is mainly used for interrogating several prisoners of war. Seeing their comrades changed into a frog before their eyes, the prisoners of war will cave in, becoming what could be described as a "frog chorus", sonorously chanting information. This terrifying technique will, without a doubt, make an "information leak" open up.

name: Trump Card of Pair
description: Naruto creates several shadow clones to charge towards and beat the opponent before kicking the opponent into the air. Naruto and Sasuke each form a Rasengan and Chidori that they both use on the falling opponent.

name: Transparent Escape Technique
description: This technique has never actually been seen in the manga, but it allows the user to spy on others without being noticed. It was invented by Jiraiya during his youth to allow him to spy on girls bathing without the risk of being caught. In the anime, the technique is shown to render the user invisible, allowing them to either make stealthy strikes on their opponent or escape from the opponent's sight. Hayate Gekkō was adept at using this technique, utilising it in a similar manner to the Hiding with Camouflage Technique; his entire figure became transparent to mask his appearance.

name: Twin Rising Dragons
description: The Twin Rising Dragons is a technique created by Tenten that takes advantage of her pinpoint accuracy. Tenten places two scrolls on either side of her in an upright position. After completing the necessary hand signs, the scrolls rise up and spin around each other cloaked in smoke shaped like a dragon. When the smoke disperses, Tenten jumps in between the scrolls and starts to unseal and throw weapons at her opponent in quick succession. If her opponent deflects or dodges the attack, she can use the wire strings attached to the weapons to recover them for another attack. During the time-skip, Tenten made some improvements to this technique. She no longer has to waste her time grabbing and throwing the weapons, as she can send them flying with just a movement of her hand. As such, she can unseal more weapons at a time, allowing her to attack at a much faster rate. She also adds explosive tags to her kunai to make her attacks more lethal.

name: Transformation: Adamantine Staff
description: The user transforms into a staff for their summoner to use as a weapon; Enma's staff form was the preferred weapon of Hiruzen Sarutobi, whose heavy use of it through decades of warfare contributed to his reputation as a "God of Shinobi". The staff is as hard as diamond, making it very destructive. This also renders it largely impervious to damage, making it useful as a defence; despite this, Enma still feels pain from clashing with the Sword of Kusanagi. The staff dimensions can be altered, becoming wider or extending to great lengths, enough that, in the anime, it could push the Nine-Tails beyond the borders of Konohagakure. The user can produce any part of his regular body from the staff, such as his claws or fangs, to surprise opponents. Enma is shown to clone himself while in his staff form for use in the Adamantine Prison Wall.

name: Transcription Seal: Amaterasu
description: This is a technique that seals the technique Amaterasu within the Sharingan of another person. After being sealed within the person, it is involuntarily activated (indicated by the person's Sharingan taking the form of the sealer's Mangekyō Sharingan) when the eye sees its target, which is predetermined by the user.

name: Tsukuyomi Mode
description: This technique is a variation of Tsukuyomi, a high-level genjutsu. The user transforms the Tsukuyomi into a barrier that slows the opponent down. This does not happen physically but rather mentally. It makes the opponent think they are being held back by a barrier. While using this technique, Itachi's health and chakra slowly drain.

name: Twin Pole Heavely Drop
description: After separating, Sakon and Ukon place themselves so that their opponent is in between them. They both lunge at the opponent, switching places and knocking them into the air. While the opponent is airborne, they jump into the air, and both grab an opponent's arm. They then both spin rapidly until the opponent's head makes contact with the ground.

name: Tree Climbing Practice
description: Tree Climbing Practice is a training method used to gain more skills with chakra control. This training involves focusing a fixed amount of chakra to the bottom of one's feet, and using it to climb a tree without using one's hands. If the stream of chakra is too weak, the user will lose their footing on the tree and fall off. If it is too strong, the user will be pushed away from the tree, causing the tree to fracture around the point of contact and the user will fall. The concept of this exercise is similar to magnetics. This is evidenced when Sasuke was able to attract a kunai Naruto threw his direction to his feet and then throw it at an enemy by kicking the kunai while releasing his chakra's hold on the kunai.

name: Twin Metal Rods Shootdown
description: Tenten summons a twin-ended Wolf Teeth Mace that is the size of a human.

name: Torsion Flower
description: Kimimaro (when in his cursed seal level two form) attacks the enemy repeatedly with alternate strikes from his hands and tail and then finishes off with a powerful strike from his bone drill, knocking the enemy backwards.

name: Tornado Rasengan
description: The Tornado Rasengan is a Rasengan formed from the released chakra of Kurama. The Rasengan formed is red similar to the Demon Fox Rasengan from Naruto the Movie: Legend of the Stone of Gelel, but with several streams of red chakra spiralling around the sphere. The Rasengan can then be further compressed giving the sphere more power.

name: Torpedo Nails
description: The user throws nails into the air. Upon impact on the ground, they dig themselves into the earth. When the opponent walks over the ground where the nails dug themselves in, nails pin their feet stopping their movement. Then, the user forms a hand seal and hundreds of nails shoot out of the ground at the opponent.

name: True Sand Waterfall Funeral
description: Gaara encases himself in a huge amount of sand, thus creating a giant clone of himself out of sand that will do everything that the engulfed Gaara does. The giant Gaara holds the opponent down and implodes, crushing them. The implosion is so great that it sends a shock wave through the battlefield.

name: Tsuchigumo Style: Forbidden Life Technique Release: Creation of Heaven and Earth
description: This technique releases the seal on the Fury technique and then accumulates natural energy from the earth and atmosphere to be used for the technique. The bearer of the seal acts as a passive vessel, continuously gathering natural energy, which makes it possible to use Fury without their cooperation.

name: Torrent: Hydrification Technique
description: Suigetsu transforms into a wave of water which crashes into the opponent. He then rushes behind the opponent with the lower half of his body still being waves and slashes them in half with the Kubikiribōchō.

name: True Sickle Weasel Technique
description: Temari summons Kamatari, who then creates a stronger and larger version of her Sickle Weasel Technique. The wind vortex can reach opponents farther away from her than her original technique.

name: Twin Rising Dragons: Second Scroll
description: Tenten jumps in the air and opens her giant scroll, releasing a smoke dragon hiding a large number of weapons that she rains down on her opponent.

name: True Reverse Lotus
description: After unlocking the sixth of the Eight Gates, Lee pummels his opponent.

name: True Shadow Seizing Technique
description: Sending his shadow towards his opponent, it will then crawl up the opponent's body until a shadow-hand reaches the opponent's neck, and breaks it.

name: Truth-Seeking Ball
description: Truth-Seeking Balls are orbs of malleable black chakra, which can alter their form and characteristics in various ways. Though only the size of a fist, each hides within it the power to obliterate an entire forest. Those who awaken Six Paths Senjutsu are able to wield Truth-Seeking Balls. Hagoromo and Hamura Ōtsutsuki appear to have possessed this power naturally, (possibly through their kekkei mōra, which their mother also possessed for her own) whereas others may obtain it by becoming the jinchūriki of the Ten-Tails, or by receiving it directly from Hagoromo. Entering Tenseigan Chakra Mode also grants the user Truth-Seeking Balls. The number of Truth-Seeking Balls acquired varies from user to user. Acquisition method may determine the number, as both Obito Uchiha and Madara Uchiha gained ten orbs upon becoming the Ten-Tails' jinchūriki; Obito initially only formed two, obtaining the other eight upon gaining control of the Ten-Tails' power. Upon receiving power from Hagoromo, Naruto Uzumaki, instead gained nine orbs, while Asura Ōtsutsuki only showed five orbs, nine orbs in the anime. Toneri Ōtsutsuki is depicted with an inconsistent amount. Due to having previously been the Ten-Tails' jinchūriki, Obito was able to manifest a single Truth-Seeking Ball after absorbing some of Madara's power. When not in use, Truth-Seeking Balls generally float behind the user's back in a circular formation, though two of Obito's float behind his hands, Hagoromo's float beneath him while levitating, and Hamura's instead form a sigmoidal formation. The orbs are always on standby once created, and users cannot create additional orbs after the initial acquisition number; thus, orbs that are lost for whatever reason cannot be replaced. In Naruto's case, the orbs currently under his control disappear and reappear alongside his chakra cloak, while the orbs he has discarded remain active. Clones are not created with orbs of their own, though the user can temporarily transfer them to a clone. Truth-Seeking Balls encompass the power of all five basic natures, and as such they surpass both kekkei genkai and kekkei tōta. By combining the various natures inside the orbs, it is possible to produce a variety of effects. They are capable of instantly turning anything they touch to dust in a manner similar to Dust Release, though this does not always occur. If imbued with a certain Yin–Yang Release jutsu, the orbs can nullify any ninjutsu they touch and thus become impervious to it; this includes negating the regenerative qualities of Impure World Reincarnation, making it possible to permanently damage and kill those reincarnated by the technique. However, the orbs are incapable of nullifying senjutsu, as according to Naruto, natural energy can be used to combat itself. Naruto can use Truth-Seeking Balls to create his Tailed Beast Ball Rasenshuriken. Similarly, Obito was able to convert one of his orbs into black receivers, allowing him to use the Six Red Yang Formation. While in their default sphere form, the orbs can be launched as high-speed projectiles, expanded to enormous sizes in an instant. Whatever their shape, users can only control the orbs within 70 metres of their location, allowing opponents to disable them by transporting them elsewhere. If the user is killed or similarly incapacitated, their Truth-Seeking Balls will disintegrate alongside any black receivers they created. Truth-Seeking Balls can be controlled individually or combined together; in both cases, by understanding the power of , the orbs can be shaped into a variety of forms. Because the high-density chakra is in a condensed state, it can be pulled and stretched into a smooth and flat consistency, as well as freely manipulated into any other shape. Hiruzen Sarutobi theorised that there is a limit to how long the orbs can maintain a certain shape, though this was never confirmed. Most users are able to reshape their Truth-Seeking Balls without any special effort, though Obito does so by passing them through holes that temporarily form in his hands. The orbs can also wrap around the user's body to form a protective shell. Though highly durable, this defence can still be broken by attacks that cannot be nullified, such as powerful senjutsu and taijutsu. While in Tenseigan Chakra Mode, Toneri could enhance his Truth-Seeking Balls by infusing them with glowing green chakra. Rather than simple black constructs, Toneri demonstrated the ability to transform one of these glowing orbs into an ornate golden cage. He could also combine them to create a massive vortex capable of blasting through the moon's surface and a giant sword capable of cutting the entire moon in half.

name: Transcription Seal: Izanagi
description: This is a Mangekyō Sharingan technique that seals the technique Izanagi within the Sharingan of the target. After being sealed within the person, it is involuntarily activated when certain requirements, which are predetermined by the user, are met. Madara Uchiha used this on his own right eye, to trigger after he dies in order to rewrite his death into a mere dream.

name: True: Supreme Ultimate Rasengan
users: Naruto Uzumaki~~with~Minato Namikaze and Kushina Uzumaki
Minato Namikaze~~with~Kushina Uzumaki and Naruto Uzumaki
Kushina Uzumaki~~with~Naruto Uzumaki and Minato Namikaze
description: Naruto hits the opponent with a Rasengan, with Minato and Kushina adding their chakra to Naruto's palm to enhance the strength of his Rasengan which pushes the opponent far away, resulting in an explosion.

name: Turbulent Four Seasons
description: Itachi and Shisui both attack their opponent with Fire Release: Great Dragon Fire Technique. Through the blazing fire, Itachi launches a barrage of kunai at them. Afterwards, Shisui appears behind the opponent, grabbing one of the kunai and in unison with Itachi launch a flurry of attacks with a kunai each in hand.

name: Transmission Wood
description: After turning a wood clone into a seed, the seed can be used to track a target by either planting it on them or having them ingest it. Only the user of this technique can detect the seed's transmissions.

name: Trinity
users: Kakashi Hatake~~with~Minato Namikaze and Obito Uchiha
Minato Namikaze~~with~Kakashi Hatake and Obito Uchiha
Obito Uchiha~~with~Kakashi Hatake and Minato Namikaze
description: Obito uses Fire Release: Phoenix Sage Fire Technique and Minato throws Flying Thunder God Kunai at the opponent. Kakashi then forms a Chidori and Obito activates his Sharingan and Minato teleports them to the opponent using Flying Thunder God Technique. Kakashi strikes the opponent with Chidori and Obito kicks the opponent, with Kakashi rushing and striking the opponent with Chidori yet again. Minato then teleports to the opponent. The three then strike the opponent, with Obito stabbing the opponent with a kunai, Minato slashing with a kunai and Kakashi slashing with a White Light Chakra Sabre.

name: Truth-Seeking Scorched Earth
description: Obito merges his Truth-Seeking Balls into a single sphere in front of himself, and unleashes a beam at his opponent.

name: True: Chibaku Tensei
description: The user claps both hands together, forming a black sphere between them, and launches it. The black sphere will then expand and encase a large area. Upon which, it draws in a large quantity of the earth around, effectively creating a "moon" that hovers high in the sky with the consumed area inside. Slowly after, the structure will begin compressing itself, crushing everything within. The structure is very powerful as even an Eight Gates-enhanced attack could barely scathe its surfaces. By performing a Snake handseal, the technique can be released, safely returning the entrapped area back to its proper location.

name: True: Tailed Beast Rasenshuriken
description: Naruto punches his opponent with a tailed beast chakra arm, sending them up in the air and putting some distance between them. He fully manifests Kurama, and creates nine shadow clones, each creating a different Rasenshuriken. The shadow clones throw the Rasenshuriken, while the real Naruto sends a Tailed Beast Ball, all attacks converging on the opponent.

name: True Fire of Samadhi
description: This Fire Release technique appears to be initiated remotely upon placing the target in contact with a physical object such as a kunai or even a small toad, and can cause the target to spontaneously burst into flames. Regarded as the , they are said to be inextinguishable by wind or rain, and burn so quickly that regenerative techniques cannot keep up with them, leaving the victim's body completely charred in mere moments. The flames can, however, be absorbed and sealed away. The jutsu is named after and inspired by the True Samādhi Fire (Chinese: 三昧眞火, Sānmèi Zhēnhuǒ) featured in the Chinese classical novel Journey to the West. In the novel, the character Red Boy (Chinese: 紅孩兒, Hóng hái'ér) developed the ability to create True Samādhi Fire after 300 years of self-cultivation on the Flaming Mountains. This magical fire proved inextinguishable, with heavy rainfall summoned by the Dragon Kings only intensifying Red Boy's blaze, as if the water were oil. Even the Monkey King was almost burned to death by the True Samādhi Fire.

name: Tracking Technique
description: Upon activation, the user's pupils glow yellow. This allows them to see the lingering energy traces left from a person's footsteps.

name: Twin Fangs Slash
description: Using their Kunai Blades, Izumo and Kotetsu attack the enemy from two sides and pierce them through.

name: Truth-Seeking Kick
description: Naruto combines his Truth-Seeking Balls and kicks the single large ball towards the opponent with great force.

name: Truth-Seeking Ruined Earth
description: Madara sends out three Truth-Seeking Balls in front of him to shoot beams of chakra at the opponent.

name: Truth-Seeking Chaos Bullets
description: Hagoromo uses his Truth-Seeking Balls to shoot bright blue bullets of chakra at the opponent.

name: True Several Thousand Hands: Spiralling Praying Palms
description: Using a massive wooden statue, Asura generates several Amenomihashira on its many hands and unleashes them upon his opponent.

name: Truth-Seeking Body Flicker
description: Obito forms one or two blades from his Truth-Seeking Balls attached to his hands and instantly passes through the opponent.

name: Truth-Seeking: Shining Deity
description: Obito forms four large interconnected arms that spin around shooting beams of chakra.

name: Truth-Seeking: Pure Shadow
description: Obito encases himself in a Truth-Seeking Ball shelling, which he uses to hit the opponent numerous times.

name: Truth-Seeking: Sever
description: Obito forms two scythe-like weapons from the Truth-Seeking Balls to swipe at the opponent.

name: Truth-Seeking Umbrella
description: Obito uses a Truth-Seeking Ball to shape it into a spear-like weapon, impaling any far off opponents.

name: Truth-Seeking: Saving Light
description: Obito fires a Truth-Seeking Ball at the opponent, which lights up and expands, releasing a large explosion. Once released, the ball returns to him.

name: Tracking Crimson Bullet
description: Kawaki uses his Kāma to gather chakra to fire blasts of red energy. Unlike the beam variation, these blasts are not normally lethal and use less chakra.

name: Truth-Seeking Ball: Cycle
description: The user encases themselves in a Truth-Seeking Ball shell to protect them from any incoming attack. They can also control the shell to ram enemies around them.

name: Triple Strike: Breaking Through the Clouds
description: Asuma delivers three powerful blows to the enemy with his chakra blades, after which he releases a cloud of ash that explodes and burns the enemy.

name: Time Reversal Technique
description: This technique is used by the Anbu to pull out forgotten memories. After forming the appropriate hand seals, the Anbu will put the target into a state of reverse hypnosis, allowing them to remember details that they otherwise would not. The target will comply with interrogation, but seems to retain his or her personality while under hypnosis. For example, when the Anbu used this technique to bring back Naruto's memories about his conversations with Gennō, Naruto was more specific about the ramen he shared with the old man rather than their conversations, which the Anbu were asking about. The technique was also used, without success, by Mitate to attempt to reverse Menma's amnesia. Menma's memories eventually returned without the aid of the Time Reversal Technique after the Konoha hospital was struck by lightning.

name: Toad Sword Beheading
description: A toad, using its naturally strong hips and legs, leaps precisely at a target. Toads can cover a great distance by doing this, shifting from a remote location to close range suddenly in order to catch targets off guard. The toad then just as quickly swings with their sword, before the target can react, shifting the power of their leap into the strike. When used by Gamabunta, the slash is powerful enough to sever the arm of Shukaku's Tailed Beast Mode.

name: Thousand Flying Water Needles of Death
description: The user creates a thousand long needles from the nearby water, which surround the target. The user carefully aims the needles at the target and fires them at rapid speeds. Targets who are struck by the needles suffer significant injury. When Haku uses this technique against Sasuke Uchiha, Sasuke is able to escape harm by leaping directly upwards.

name: Thorn
description: Kimimaro delivers a series of slashes to the opponent with two bone swords until he sends them flying into the air, where he delivers a series of slashes at lightning speed.

name: Three-Tailed Rasengan
description: While in his three-tailed form, Naruto creates a shadow clone that charges a Nine-Tails-enhanced Rasengan that implodes in on the enemy who is attacked by it.

name: Toad Flatness — Shadow Manipulation Technique
description: The user first infuses a target's shadow with their own chakra. The user then flattens themselves to paper-like thinness and merges with the target's shadow, giving them complete control over the target's mind and body. The user must hold their breath in order to maintain this control. Jiraiya uses this technique on Ryūsui with the intention of exploring Amegakure and gathering intel, but he is quickly spotted by Konan speaking to a toad. Although Konan immediately knows that it's Jiraiya because of what she overhears, she focuses her attacks on Ryūsui's body, evidently believing him to be Jiraiya in disguise despite her prior knowledge of this technique. In this way, the controlled body is useful as a shield, and while it's taking attacks meant for the user, the user is able to prepare their own attacks unnoticed. To release this technique, users inhale deeply, causing their body to inflate back to its normal thickness. Their targets simultaneously regain control of their body and senses, with no apparent memory of what happened while they were being controlled.

name: Toad Oil Bullet
description: The user converts their chakra into an extremely sticky oil and spits it out as a huge mass or as a barrage of small bullets. Those caught by it will find it difficult to move, and simply washing the oil away with regular water won't be easy. Furthermore, if a Fire Release technique is launched at the target after this technique is used, they will be enveloped in flames in an instant.

name: Third Eye
description: Gaara creates an eye out of sand that hovers in the air wherever it's created. Gaara connects the eye with his optic nerve using chakra, allowing him to see whatever is in the Third Eye's field of vision. The eye gives Gaara a useful method of performing surveillance without being noticed; in Sakura Hiden, Gaara manipulates the Third Eye's sand to allow it to double as a listening device. Gaara also uses the Third Eye when fully surrounding himself with the Shield of Sand, allowing him to be protected without sacrificing seeing what opponents are doing. In Gaara Hiden, Gaara is capable of creating several Third Eyes and connect each eye to his optical nerve at once, allowing him to observe things from multiple angles simultaneously. Rasa makes his Third Eye out of Gold Dust. Rasa, like Gaara, must close one of his eyes before he can see through the Third Eye. In the anime, Shinki has displayed the ability of creating multiple Third Eyes with his Iron Sand, without the need of closing one of his, though it quickly drains his chakra.

name: Three Jewels Suction Crushing
users: Monzaemon Chikamatsu~~puppet~Ten Puppet Collection of Chikamatsu
description: This technique is a performance by puppets 6, 7, and 8 of the Chikamatsu Collection. The three puppets get into a triangular formation and by opening the mechanisms marked with "Buddha", "Dharma", and "Sangha", respectively, they invoke this technique. A terrifying tornado breaks out and sucks the targets into the centre of the formation. Everything that is sucked into the centre is completely crushed with tremendous force and shot out from the back. However, the vacuum can be overloaded, leaving the three puppets vulnerable to attacks.

name: Thousand Hands Manipulation Force
description: The Thousand Hands Manipulation Force is a technique which is used through the puppet of the Third Kazekage. From the Third Kazekage puppet's left arm opens several compartments. These compartments are prepared with summoning seals in them, which call forth a large number of long puppet arms that can bend and follow the opponent, then crush them with devastating force. The arms are modified with launchers, which can emit poison gas, binding wires with a kunai-anchor, or regular kunai. Sasori can detach the entire left arm (with the thousand arms) to regain mobility for the puppet, and a buzzsaw takes its place.

name: Tongue Tooth Sticky Acid
description: Katsuyu releases an acidic paste from the mouth that, because of Katsuyu's size and height, is spread over a wide area. The acid's concentration and density is great enough to melt stone. Katsuyu requires no preparation to perform this technique, allowing it to be used instantly, which in turn means that targets have no opportunity to dodge.

name: Tornado of Water
description: This is a technique that utilises water to create a spinning water vortex around the user. The water vortex acts both as a barrier and an attack mechanism. The power of the vortex is enough to knock an opponent unconscious.

name: Thunder Sabre
description: is a technique utilised by Ranke by drawing energy from the Stone of Gelel. Ranke collects a large amount of lightning energy into her hand using the Gelel source in her body, balls her hand into a fist and strikes at her opponent. It was powerful enough to punch through Gaara's Shield of Sand and send the young shinobi crashing through a wall.

name: Tornado Lightning
description: is a technique utilised by Ranke by drawing energy from the Stone of Gelel. With the power of the Stone of Gelel, Ranke generates electrical energy in her palms that she can whip around in order to attack her opponent, capable of striking at various angles and tearing through rock and metal.

name: Thousand Bee Stings Technique
description: The user summons bees that shoot their poisonous stingers at their target.

name: Thistle
description: Kimimaro slices upward with a sword made of bone and then extends his bones from his back to throw the opponent into the air violently.

name: Tiger Lily
description: Kimimaro, when in his cursed seal level two form, attacks the opponent repeatedly with alternate strikes from his hands and tail and then finishes them off with a powerful strike from his backbones.

name: Three-Tails Chakra: Release
description: Due to his mysterious connection to the Three-Tails, Yūkimaru is able to at least partially control the Three-Tails. At first, Yūkimaru can only make an apparition of the beast appear, after taking some of Kabuto's pills. Later, after taking a larger dosage of the pills (combined with Guren's Crystal Release technique) he is able to make the beast fully appear, but couldn't control it. Later, when Guren is in danger of being harmed by the Three-Tailed Beast, he is able to halt it completely without Kabuto's pills. When Guren seemingly sacrificed her life to save him, Yūkimaru lost control of himself and used his powers to the fullest which enhanced the Three-Tails strength and rampage enabling it to break through the Four-Corner Sealing Barrier. This could mean that, like Naruto's jinchūriki forms, this ability is tied to his emotions. Shizune concluded that due to the extensive toll this ability took on Yūkimaru's body, his lifespan was shortened, and he lost the ability altogether.

name: Thousand Needles of Death
description: Kin Tsuchi controls a vast amount of needles at once using strings, and attacks the enemy. When shown in the game, this technique resembles a white version of Haku's Thousand Flying Water Needles of Death.

name: Three-Tails Mini Clone
description: When the Three-Tails devours anything, its body produces thousands of smaller clones of itself with its gut. These antibody-like clones attack and devour the invading organism, presumably to aid in digestion and destroy any potential hazards. The Three-Tails has the ability to create different sizes of its mini clones: from the size of a hand to the size of a human being, and they are resilient enough to resist Guren's crystal techniques and kunai.

name: The Immortals Rushing Madly Ahead
description: Taking advantage of Hidan's immortality, Kakuzu uses the Fire Release: Intelligent Hard Work and Wind Release: Pressure Damage techniques to engulf Hidan in flames, propelling him towards the opponent, while Hidan slashes them continuously with his Triple-Bladed Scythe.

name: Thunder of the Dead
description: Orochimaru summons snakes, with Sasuke using Chidori Current on them, that spiral around them both hitting anyone nearby.

name: Thick Steam Flow Technique
description: This is a cooperation ninjutsu where one Fire Release user attacks the enemy from one side and a Water Release user attacks them from the other. The collision of these two naturally opposing natures create a devastating attack as well as a great deal of water vapour.

name: Time-Release Technique
description: By placing a mark on a person in a ritualistic method, this technique will activate as timed even if the person is tortured or put under a trance. This is meant to catch an enemy when their guard is down. Sai mentions that this is used as a last resort technique by the Anbu, and as such, is rare; Sakura likens it to a living time bomb. When Kakashi Hatake requested Tsunade to use it on him, the technique would activate Kakashi's Mangekyō Sharingan technique, the Kamui, upon Hiruko's attempt to assimilate him.

name: Tonton Combo
description: Shizune transforms Tonton into a copy of herself who uses chakra scalpels to stun their opponent. Tonton changes back and jumps up as Shizune slices though the opponent, side-to-side with two chakra scalpels herself. However, she caught the tip of Tonton's tail while the pig was doing a flip; the opponent collapses. Shizune then notices Tonton's tail is burning and begins healing her as an angry Tonton repeatedly hits her.

name: Three-Seal Barrier
description: Similar to the Five-Seal Barrier technique, instead the user places three sealing tags around their location. If any one manages to enter through a secret entrance of the protected hideout, a deep mist is created and the only way to get rid of it is remove the tags around the protected area.

name: Thousand Flashes Beheading Dance
description: The user slashes at the opponent with very sharp senbon exactly a thousand times in multiple different directions, leaving the opponent with plenty of slashes and senbon pierced into their body.

name: Torii Seal
description: When Naruto first obtained Nine-Tails Chakra Mode, his previous seal's outward appearance had changed into a shape of a magatama, along with a swirl design that resembled Uzushiogakure's symbol. By using the seal's key, he can create several massive interlocking torii that can even immobilise and imprison Kurama with ease. Naruto then isolated Kurama's chakra in another part of him away from the fox itself in between four torii, so he could access it freely. It was later revealed that Kurama isn't always bound by the torii and has freedom of movement behind its cage, but Naruto can enter the cage without breaking the seal and still manipulate the torii to immobilise the fox if he wants.

name: Threaded Tree
description: Hashirama creates two rising wood pillars that intertwine with each other from the ground and lift the opponent into the air. He then creates two more pillars of intertwining wood, striking the opponent further into the air.

name: Three Colouring
description: Kurenai Yūhi releases a pillar of cherry petals at the opponent sending them flying.

name: Thunderswords Technique: Thunderbolt
description: Holding the Kiba swords over their head like birch rods, the user summons a bolt of lightning from the sky to shock anyone in their immediate vicinity.

name: Top Transformed Buddha
description: After creating a gigantic wooden statue that possesses hundreds or thousands of hands, the user utilises all of these hands simultaneously to deliver powerful blows to the target. Due to the sheer volume of the punches involved, defending against the entirety of them is nearly impossible. This can be used as a one-shot technique, increasing its destructive power but also resulting in the hands behind the statue's back being destroyed. Afterwards, Hashirama discards the back of the statue to increase the mobility of the True Several Thousand Hands statue. It can also be used more conservatively as seen in Tobi's usage, preventing the hands from being destroyed and enabling another usage of the technique, but results in less destructive power. depicts the manifestation of a Nyorai that has transformed into another body, represented alongside an associated Buddha or bodhisattva. In practical terms, this means a smaller Buddhist image attached to a larger one. Such depictions serve as an example of the many forms Buddhist deities can assume in order to save sentient beings. They are found most notably within the statues of Kannon, where a small image of Amida is placed atop Kannon's crown or held in the hands of Thousand-Armed Kannon.

name: Thousand Hands Manipulation Force: Thrust
description: Sasori attacks his opponent using his Third Kazekage puppet, causing multiple arms to erupt from seals in its left arm, reaching for a mid-air opponent.

name: Torn Castle
description: Zabuza kicks his opponent, delivers some side slashes with Kubikiribōchō, kicks them once more, and finishes with a forward stab, knocking his opponent far back.

name: The Red-Hot Habanero
description: Kushina, while in her awakening state, delivers a series of powerful punches to the opponent.

name: The Inheritance of the Will of Fire
users: Hashirama Senju~~with~Hiruzen Sarutobi and Tobirama Senju
Hiruzen Sarutobi~~with~Hashirama Senju and Tobirama Senju
Tobirama Senju~~with~Hashirama Senju and Hiruzen Sarutobi
description: Hashirama, Tobirama and Hiruzen use a combination of wood, water and fire to push away the opponent. Hashirama uses Wood Release Secret Technique: Nativity of a World of Trees to create a forest in which Tobirama and Hiruzen strike the opponent using a fire and water combination. The three Hokage then strike the opponent, with Hashirama using Chakra Enhanced Strength, Tobirama kicking the opponent and Hiruzen summoning Monkey King: Enma and striking the opponent with the adamantine staff. The force of the attacks explodes the forest in the process.

name: Tight Binding Golden Chain Technique
description: These chains formed by a member of the Uzumaki clan are used offensively rather than the ones used for sealing purposes. Using this technique, Karin manifested chakra-based chains from her body which she can use to attack and pulverise a target. Despite these chains having been stated to being an incomplete version of the Adamantine Sealing Chains, Karin was able to use this technique to destroy most of Tobi's giant wooden statue and its many hands. While said to be incomplete, in the anime, Karin later showed the ability to not only attack with the chains but neutralise her target by binding and nullifying their chakra with the chains. When used against Suigetsu Hōzuki, it sent him flying some distance away, leaving him incapacitated and his body in its jelly-like state. Karin also seems capable of manipulating the size of her chains to fit the situation.

name: Toad Three Slashes
description: The user coats their weapon with chakra and swings it at the target, releasing three sharp crescent-like waves.

name: Three-Tails' Rampage
description: Isobu takes over Rin Nohara, causing her to manifest a chakra cloak, and slam the opponent with a chakra tail. Isobu fully manifests itself, slams the opponent underwater, and sends a Tailed Beast Ball their way. Rin manages to suppress Isobu with memories of her team, as a slight shower from the explosion rains down on her.

name: Thunderclap Drill
description: Sarada delivers a Lightning Release-enhanced, super strong punch on her opponent.

name: Thunderswords Technique: Remote Control
description: This technique allows the user to manipulate Kiba independently from afar. This allows the user to keep their hands free for combat and also attack from multiple angles at once. The user can also manipulate the blades to strike in a variety of manners.

name: Three Demon Gods
description: Momoshiki grabs his opponent, throws them up in the air, and consumes a chakra edible, changing his appearance. Transformed, he sends five dog avatars which converge at his opponent, biting at them, before a fire pheasant crashes through them. Finally, Momoshiki punches his opponent back at the ground with a giant rock monkey.

name: Tornado High
description: Boruto and a shadow clone string a series of attacks at an opponent, finishing by creating a small tornado that lifts the shadow clone as it performs an upper kick.

name: Toad Spying Technique
description: Koji links with his artificial toad to access their point of view, seeing and hearing everything around the toad. This can be done via special software or through Koji directly, in which the latter case his pupils will become toad-like. It allows for more discreet surveillance and intel gathering. He can also use two toads to communicate with others if one is left with the person they are in contact with. The connection can even be maintained between separate dimensions.

name: Toad Smoke Technique
description: The user produces a burst of a smoke from their body, forming a thick smokescreen to mask their movements. It can also produce a denser smoke within shaped like the user for an additional distraction.

name: Thorn Explosion
description: The user punches the opponent and follows up with impaling them with their modified flesh.

name: Time Reservoir
description: A member of the Ōtsutsuki clan can manipulate the mental space of an individual to send their conscience to a certain point back in time. The user creates a doorway which will enable an indictable to travel to the past. The individual sent back in time can only observe past events, they can not interfere or make changes. However, under three conditions, the individual can be sent back in time, both mentally and physically: The user must use an unstable space that could control the principles of time, such as the genjutsu Tsukuyomi. The technique must be performed on the night of a full moon, in order for there to be a natural ley line flowing through the earth. The individual being sent back must have an object that has a strong connection between them and the person they are looking for in the past, containing both their chakra mixed together. Once these conditions are met, the user can perform the time travel. The individual sent back only has a limited amount of time in the past before they are returned to their original time. If they make any changes in the past, events in the future will change and the individual will not have any recollection of their time in the past.

name: Thrusting Shark
description: While merged with Samehada, Kisame forms a water shark around him and charges at the opponent, with the shark biting down on them.

name: Tornado of Water Technique: Magnum
description: Gengetsu forms and sends out a vortex of water, then shooting a bullet of water to massively increase the size of the vortex, swirling around the area.

name: Thunder Laser Scan
description: While in flight mode, Mecha-Naruto scans the area with a special blue laser, identifying its target.

name: Young Spirited Embrace of Youth
description: Guy punches the opponent aside, only to apologise and embrace them, fracturing the opponent's back and doing liberal damage.

name: Yin Seal: Release
description: The Strength of a Hundred Seal - which takes the form of a diamond on the user's forehead - is used to gradually build up and store the user's chakra over time. Yin Seal: Release opens that seal, giving the user access to the accumulated chakra. Upon release, a pattern starts to appear from the diamond shape, spreading out across their forehead and potentially the rest of their body; by spreading the seal's pattern to another, the user can transfer the seal's chakra to them instead. The stored chakra amounts to far more than what the user has on their own, allowing them to perform chakra-demanding jutsu that they wouldn't be able to use otherwise, such as Creation Rebirth. If not all of the chakra ends up being used, it can be stored in a new Strength of a Hundred Seal.

name: Yin Healing Wound Destruction
description: Kabuto analyses an opponent's facial expression, movements, and the properties of their jutsu to anticipate where and how he will be attacked. He then gathers chakra to the area of his body where the attack will strike, preemptively starting medical treatment in order to minimise the damage he'll receive. The more extensive the damage, the more chakra it takes to heal; the damage from Rasengan is so great that Kabuto lacks enough chakra to fully recover. In addition to needing to correctly read the opponent and react in time, users require great resilience in order to perform the jutsu, traits that only Kabuto possesses.

name: Youth Full Power
description: The user begins with kicking the opponent into the air. Once airborne, the user will then kick the opponent in the face before finishing with a powerful drop kick that will send the opponent back down to the ground, emitting a light of "youthful" energy.

name: Wooden Puppet Manipulation Technique
description: By placing a charm onto the puppet beforehand, this technique allows the user to control its movements through will alone. Alternatively, the puppets can attack the opponent on their own, though the ability to react to their opponent's movements is limited. If the tag is removed, then the technique can then be disabled. Genshō Ryūdōin was able to use this technique on a massive scale, forcing hundreds of puppets upon his opponents. Additionally, he was able to break them apart and fuse them together. Together, they created a massive wall capable of holding someone back as strong as Might Guy.
