name: Wooden Men Possession Turnover Manipulation Technique
description: This technique forces two opponents to fight each other through wooden training dummies, with the intent of tricking them into fighting each other until all but one of them is defeated. The only way to break the technique is to have fast and strong taijutsu, by utilising speed so extreme that the wooden training dummies are unable to keep up and thus break apart, effectively breaking the technique. If the victims are familiar enough with one another they will be able to tell who their opponent is. They can also communicate through non-verbal means such as Morse code.

name: Zelkova
description: Kimimaro knocks the opponent into the air and then appears above them before extending a large number of spikes from his arm to stab the opponent.

name: Yosaku Cut
description: Using his giant axe, Sabu strikes the opponent with a low, lateral blow.

name: Youth Leaf Lotus Attack
description: Lee activates the Eight Gates, delivers a barrage of punches and kicks, and delivers one final kick on the opponent.

name: Yellow Flash (jutsu)
description: Minato blasts the opponent into the air with a Rasengan and then proceeds to throw one of his Flying Thunder God Kunai behind them. As he teleports behind them, he strikes them in the back with another Rasengan that expands to a larger size before exploding and sending the opponent back to the ground.

name: Zeus
description: The technique consists of striking the opponent into the air with a Lightning Release-infused uppercut palm attack.

name: Yellow Flash Rasengan
description: Minato kicks the opponent in the air, throws his Flying Thunder God Kunai, teleports to them, and kicks them again, ending the combo with a Rasengan while on the ground as the opponent falls down on the attack.

name: Yasaka Magatama
description: Yasaka Magatama is a technique that Susanoo users can use from any of its hands. Due to its structure, it acts in a similar manner to that of a shuriken when thrown by Susanoo — rapidly spinning towards the intended target — and results in an explosion upon impact. The size of these projectiles are dependent on the user, with smaller variations often used when fighting in close quarters or confined spaces. While all operate in a somewhat similar manner, the technique can assume multiple forms that differ slightly both in appearance and use. These range from: Three magatama bound together by a single, circular thread that are created either between two of Susanoo's hands or from just one, which are then propelled towards the target as a single combined projectile. A considerable number of magatama strung out between two of Susanoo's hands, using an interconnecting thread. These then detach themselves from one another once propelled towards the target, so that each magatama becomes a separate projectile. The is one of the , together with the and the .

name: Young Lightning
description: Kakashi whilst in the air will drop down on his opponent with a lightning-charged hand strike.

name: Yomito's Transformation Technique
description: Yomito activates this technique by placing the mask he keeps strapped to his right arm on his face. Once activated Yomito transforms into an oni-like creature. His body greatly grows in size and becomes very muscular, his skin becomes grey and his hair becomes crimson. The only clothes that remain are his pants. He also gains a necklace of large, dark green beads and a crimson marking on the back of each arm, right above his elbows. In this form Yomito makes use of the enormous fists it grants him, using them to smash the ground or chuck rocks out of it to attack from a distance. The only vulnerable spot seems to be his head and he has to somehow be knocked down for it to be reached.

name: Wood Stab Palm
description: Yamato strikes the opponent with a series of punches and kicks leading to him jumping into the air and releasing a wooden spear from his palm that is directed into the opponent and used to drive them into the ground.

name: Wrapping Flame Cat Fire
description: Transforming into Matatabi, Yugito runs towards the opponent in a fiery tackle.

name: Zero-Tails Sealing Technique
description: This technique is a unique form of sealing which was passed down in the Land of the Sky and used to restrain the Zero-Tails. This technique is designed to use dark chakra generated by the Zero-Tails rather than to seal it. It would appear to be a complex sealing technique, given the many sealing formulas in surrounding sealing room, as well as a rather large tablet, which is actually used to restrain the beast. The exact mechanics of this technique are unknown, however, after the Zero-Tails was sealed, the beast became encased in a tan coloured cocoon-like structure, with the addition of several tubular attachments, which allow the beast to channel its dark chakra through the Ancor Vantian. The technique also acts to protect the Zero-Tails by absorbing any chakra from external sources which pose a threat.

name: Yomotsu Hirasaka
description: Yomotsu Hirasaka is a [[kekkei mōra]] technique used by members of the Ōtsutsuki clan, which is said to be the progenitor of all space–time ninjutsu. The user is able to open rifts in the fabric of space that allow them to instantaneously transport themselves to another location. The openings can be used to connect two different spatial locations within the same dimension, or to create a pathway that links two dimensions together. By entering these spacial tears, the user is able to retreat, disorient enemies, or execute ambush attacks at a moment's notice. Kaguya Ōtsutsuki used this technique to travel between her six dimensions. These portals can be used to transport only sections of the user's body by partially entering them, allowing the user to grab their opponents and drag them into the portal, sending them to another location. Kaguya can also open rifts to transport her attacks through the portals, relocating projectiles and ultimately taking the enemy down by surprise. The portals are manifested at such speeds that even a shinobi as fast as Sasuke Uchiha was caught off guard. However, evading the portals is still possible. In the anime, the technique can also be used as a viewing window across dimensions to desired locations.

name: You Won't Get Away!
description: Kushina jumps and delivers a series of strikes with her frying pan, chasing the opponent. Then, she hits her opponent with a pan, knocking them into the ground.

name: Yellow Flash (Naruto)
description: Channelling Kurama's chakra, Naruto performs an enhanced Body Flicker Technique to instantly cross vast distances.

name: Ōtsutsuki Teleportation
description: This technique is a Space–Time Ninjutsu used by the Ōtsutsuki clan. The user creates a rift, which allows anyone enveloped to transfer to a chosen location including foreign dimensions. The rift's formation is fast enough to catch targets off guard and transport them alongside the user, as well as to evade attacks from enemies at the last moment. An Ōtsutsuki can synchronise the technique to a recipient of their Kāma, allowing the member to transport themselves to the host's location through the mark. Two Kāma recipients can collaboratively manifest the rift from their marks to bypass fūinjutsu. Even if the target recipient does not possess Kāma, if the user can track down the chakra of the target, it is possible for them to create the rift to drag said target to their location, as Isshiki teleported Kawaki via Naruto's chakra, which was being used to powerup the latter's artificial arm.

name: Youth Roar
description: Guy lets out a loud shout, made to intimidate opponents and invigorate teammates.

name: Yachihoko
description: Yachihoko is a Mangekyō Sharingan dōjutsu. Tied to the usage of her Engraved Tsukuyomi, it allows Nanashi to control the mind and the chakra of any individual linked with an Engraved Tsukuyomi branding. Yachihoko is a powerful Genjutsu, and works by erasing the memories of any individual it targets, creating puppets that Nanashi is able to manipulate. The Genjutsu itself is powerful enough that even a perfect Jinchūriki, such as Naruto Uzumaki, was unable to have it dispelled by his Tailed Beast, Kurama. Yachihoko also allows for the manipulation of chakra from to and from the user via those marked with the Engraved Tsukuyomi blemish. Merz was able to absorb the chakra of a vast portion of the Shinobi World using Yachihoko. Additionally, Nanashi could transfer chakra this way, giving it to Boruto on two occasions to allow him to fight. Like other Mangekyō Sharingan abilities, this one takes its name from ancient Japanese myth. is a name adopted in the Kojiki by the Shintō god , the head of the kunitsukami who governs the earth, nation-building, and agriculture, among other domains.

name: Yachihoko no Kami
description: Kaguya opens numerous small portals to shoot hazards from her dimensions at the opponent.

name: Yasaka Magatama: Tailed Beast Noka
users: Itachi Uchiha~~with~Killer B and Naruto Uzumaki
Killer B~~with~Itachi Uchiha and Naruto Uzumaki
Naruto Uzumaki~~with~Itachi Uchiha and Killer B
description: This Cooperation Ninjutsu is a collaboration technique using the user's strongest long ranged techniques including Naruto's Wind Release: Rasenshuriken, Itachi's Yasaka Magatama, and Killer B's Tailed Beast Ball. The combination was only used once against Nagato, during which the users took advantage at not needing to aim their jutsu towards the target due to its gravitation pull. On impact, the collaboration technique was strong enough to destroy Nagato's Chibaku Tensei.

name: Yakusaikazuchinokami
description: Momoshiki first calls forth several lightning bolts to strike the ground before him, then releases a powerful tidal wave of water over the area, forming a large, electrified whirlpool.

name: Ōhirume
description: Ōhirume is a dōjutsu that can be used with Sarada Uchiha's Mangekyō Sharingan. Ōhirume allows Sarada to create up to a maximum of four black spheres, each of which has a diameter ranging from 5 to 250 centimeters. These spheres have a gravitational pull disproportionate to their mass, allowing them to generate a powerful gravity, which Sarada can freely control to attract matter, including weapons, jutsu, and living beings. By altering the gravitational force she can pin enemies against the spheres and crush them, or even detonate the spheres to produce an explosion. The technique's range of affect is proportional to the user's range of vision. Only targets directly targeted by Sarada's gaze are affected by the gravitational force, though if the target is a living being then she is susceptible to the gravitational pull as well. To combat this drawback, Sarada can control each of the four spheres to balance the gravity applied to her, allowing her to levitate. By moving in synch with the spheres, she can also fly at high speeds, similar to the Ōtsutsuki. The major drawbacks of the jutsu are that it consumes a tremendous amount of chakra and, like other Mangekyō Sharingan abilities, causes eyesight deterioration and eventual blindness. Amplifying the gravitational forces of a sphere places significant strain on Sarada, causing her used eye to bleed. The first time she used the technique, she fell unconscious from the exertion. Ōhirume or is one of the many names that, in the Nihon Shoki, is ascribed to Amaterasu, the Japanese goddess of the sun and chief kami of the Shintō pantheon. This makes this technique the second Mangekyō Sharingan ability named after said deity, following Sasuke and Itachi Uchiha's Amaterasu.

name: Yin–Yang Release (jutsu)
description: Obito uses Truth-Seeking Balls to block an opponent's attacks, shaping the Truth-Seeking Balls into a different defensive shield each time. After blocking several attacks in this way, he forms a spike from one of the shields to pierce the opponent, creating an opening for him to attack the opponent with chakra arms and his staff.

name: Yachihoko: Dazzling Flames of Rebellion
description: Using Yachihoko to boost her abilities, Hikari dashes around slicing the opponent with her kunai, kicks them up in the air, spews a a fireball and Amaterasu, causing it to burst into towering pillars of blazing fire and black flames.
